description: The Chinese exam changed: the new HSK 3.0 has nine levels and 11,000 words. Gushi covers all nine, in English, German, Spanish and French. Every character comes with its tone, its parts, a story that holds it and where its shape came from. Spaced repetition decides what comes back and when. Reading, listening, speaking, writing and mock exams in one app, on phone and laptop. And language schools can see how their students are doing on the Teaching Platform.

name: Growtsy
tagline: Product photo → Etsy listing, usually in under 30 seconds
description: Growtsy turns a product photo into a publish-ready Etsy listing: title, 13 tags and description. It reads up to 100 live Etsy listings for the same product and ends with one decision: publish now, fix the photo first, or rethink the niche. No made-up sales or search-volume numbers; Etsy doesn't publish them. The homepage demo runs without signup, and 20 free Etsy tools (fee calculator, listing checker, tag generator) need no login.

name: Grok Text to Speech
tagline: Free text to speech with all 28 real Grok voices
description: Turn text into speech with all 28 real Grok voices from xAI's API — 20 languages, expressive tags like [pause] and instant MP3 download. Free with no account; free tiers for longer clips. Independent tool, not affiliated with xAI.

name: Goblin Saju
tagline: Korean saju, tarot and rune readings in English
description: Goblin Saju is a small reading studio from Korea. Ask one question and lay out 7 tarot cards, 3 Elder Futhark runes or 3 Lenormand cards. Every card's keywords and short meaning are free. If you want more, unlock a full written reading for US$2.99 (Korean Saju report US$5.99), paid once with PayPal, no account needed. Readings are written by AI from your question and cards. Also free: find which of 144 goblins is most like you.

name: GoResume
tagline: Speak your résumé in any language, tailor it to any job
description: GoResume is a free AI resume builder used by 1M+ job seekers. Speak your story in any language (Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Hindi…) or type it, and the AI drafts an English resume in under a minute. 99 ATS-friendly templates, a job-description tailor with match score and missing keywords, AI headshots from selfies, and a live goresume.io/u/you page that updates as you edit. Free to build and share; pay only for PDFs.

name: Glassy
tagline: Shows how much of your AI subscriptions you have left.
description: Glassy is a small glass bubble that sits in the corner of your Windows desktop and shows how much of your AI subscriptions you have left: Claude and ChatGPT today, more later. You click it, a panel opens. You see your 5-hour session, your weekly limit, and when they reset. You close it, it goes back to being a bubble.

name: Fuse
tagline: Stop the AI API call that would blow your budget
description: Fuse sits in front of your OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral or xAI keys. Set a daily or monthly dollar limit per project. Every request is priced before it's sent, and the one that would cross the limit gets a 402 and never reaches the provider.

name: FundingRadar
tagline: Find Australian small business grants before they close
description: FundingRadar is a free directory of open Australian small business grants and support programs. Search federal, state, territory and council programs, filter by state, industry, amount and type, and see closing dates at a glance. It lists 265 open grants and programs across 9 jurisdictions and 15 industries, each linking to the official program page. A free email newsletter covers newly opened grants and upcoming closing dates. No sign-up needed to search.

name: FridayOS1.0

Walk to them, develop them, and build your personal archive of movies. Find standard prints as you explore, or hunt for rarer editions, 35mm prints and serialized 70mm prints. When you're ready to trade, head to the Box Office, a worldwide marketplace where collectors can trade prints with each other. Start developing and see what you find.

name: FontMeter

Join the ultimate digital hub

Record your lectures, take notes and draw on top, ask about any slide, and practice with questions from your own classes. Tell it when the exam is and it builds a day by day plan. Perfect for creating large decorations, reference charts, artwork reproductions, and educational materials without expensive large-format printing.

description: BeSpoke AI Stylist is now on iPad and Android tablets. Snap a photo of your outfit and Fit Check rates it in seconds, with tips to level it up. Ask the Stylist what to wear for any occasion and get looks built from your own Closet. Try On outfits before you decide, plan the week in Planner, and design new looks in Studio — all on a screen big enough to see the whole outfit. Free to start.

name: Bascule: Real Live Translator
tagline: A real interpreter for two – speak, tilt, translated
description: Bascule turns your iPhone into a real interpreter for two. Hold the phone between you: each person reads their own half of the screen, and one tilt hands the conversation over. What you just said is translated and read aloud on the other side. No buttons, no passing the phone back and forth, no awkward silence while someone figures out an app. It adapts to natural pauses, works offline, and keeps notes and summaries of your conversation. Free, with Bascule+ for smarter AI translation.

name: Barhops
tagline: Plan pub crawls. Play games. Make memories.
description: Barhops is changing the way people experience pub crawls, turning a typical night out into an interactive, social adventure. Plan and share pub crawls, discover new bars, invite friends, and compete in games like Barathon, Pub Golf, Pint Points, and Bar Bingo. Track live leaderboards, check in at venues, and capture memories together. No more complicated planning, scattered group chats, or boring pub crawls. Just better nights out, all in one app.

You always see what’s left — today, this week, this month. Free for personal use. Pro from $1.89/mo (NGN 2,500 in Nigeria) to share remaining with up to 10. Live worldwide.

English and Hinglish; Classes 1–5 get read-aloud picture stories and worksheets. 235 chapters live. Unofficial; not affiliated with NCERT.

name: TermWard
tagline: Find and track contract cancellation deadlines—locally
description: TermWard is a local-first desktop app for owners, operations leads, and finance leads managing vendor agreements. Open an English PDF, paste text, or enter terms manually. It surfaces likely renewal and notice clauses with source evidence, then calculates review, cancel-by, and renewal dates only after you confirm them. Records stay on your computer; confirmed deadlines can optionally sync to Google Calendar. No TermWard account, cloud contract database, or remote document analysis.

name: Telangana LandGrid
tagline: Find any land survey number in Telangana on a live map
description: Land records in Telangana tell you who owns a survey number, not where it is. LandGrid puts every village's survey boundaries on a satellite map: tap any field to see its survey number, village, mandal and area in acres-guntas. Measure plots by tapping corners, download a printable PDF map of a whole village, see new projects like the Regional Ring Road over your land, and browse land for sale with direct seller contact. Free, in English and Telugu.

name: TatilMate – AI Travel Companion & Guide
tagline: Your AI-powered travel planner & audio tour guides
description: TatilMate is your ultimate AI-powered travel companion designed to make trip planning effortless. Key Features: • 🤖 AI Itinerary Generator: Get custom, day-by-day travel routes in seconds. • 🎧 Interactive Audio Guides: Explore historic landmarks and cultural spots with audio stories. • 🗺️ Smart Maps & Insights: Discover local gems, weather updates, and nearby recommendations. Say goodbye to juggling multiple apps and plan your next adventure with TatilMate!

name: Tasqs
tagline: The honest to-do app that helps you let go
description: Tasqs is a task manager built on an honest idea: not everything on your list deserves to survive. Most apps just help you capture more. Tasqs helps you finish, shrink, or let go. Friday Amnesty is a weekly ritual for the tasks you keep rescheduling; the Shortlist caps your day at five. Plus tags, recurring tasks, an AI assistant, and a connector to run your tasks from ChatGPT or Claude. Private by design: no ads, no data selling. Free to start, from a founder tired of to-do list guilt.

name: Take
tagline: Free screen recording for polished demos on Windows
description: Turn screen recordings into polished software demos on Windows. Edit zooms and cursor movement, cut mistakes, add annotations, and export MP4s, GIFs or screenshots. Capture microphone and system audio, with a built-in teleprompter for walkthroughs. Recording and editing stay on your computer. Free, with no account, watermark or cloud upload.

name: Synthetic Audience
tagline: Poll the world without contacting a soul
description: Ask any question to a representative synthetic audience built from real public census data. Get a simulated response distribution in minutes — with segment breakdowns and an honest calibration score that back-tests the prediction against real data. A fast first read before you pay for a real study.

name: SyncGaze Mail
tagline: Business email on your own domain, free for a year
description: SyncGaze Mail gives businesses professional email on their own domain without the complexity of a full office suite. Use webmail, Android, or IMAP/SMTP apps, with guided DNS setup and DKIM support plus SPF/DMARC guidance to help improve deliverability and protect your domain. Eligible businesses can start with a one-year free Business offer for up to 6 mailboxes. Built in India for simple, affordable business email.

name: StratIQ
tagline: Free beta: Honest trading ideas backtested — wins & losses
description: Most trading advice shows winners, buries losers. StratIQ does the opposite: AI-powered stock & crypto ideas every morning. Weekly backtests on years of market data — published trade by trade, wins and losses. The 50/200-day golden cross on QQQ: +238.5% over 7 years vs +289% buy-and-hold — we published the loss anyway. Daily brief, paper portfolio, 2-min audio brief. Free during beta: exact entry/stop/targets included; first 200 beta users lock $5/mo for life. Not financial advice.

name: Stock Quorum
tagline: Where 64 top fund managers' 13F portfolios agree
description: Stock Quorum reads the SEC 13F filings of 64 long-term fund managers and ranks stocks by how many hold them at 3% or more of their portfolio. Company and manager pages, ten years of history and free CSV/JSON downloads.

name: Sticky Wall
tagline: A sticky note billboard for indie makers Copy tagline
description: Sticky Wall is a public billboard for indie makers to pin their startups and side projects. Standard notes cost $2 once. Newer notes can bury older ones, but their history stays discoverable. A live bidding center spot adds a little competition.

name: Stars Organizer
tagline: Sort your GitHub stars into Lists that sync back to GitHub
description: Hundreds of GitHub stars and no way to find anything? Stars Organizer gives you search, tags, ratings and notes on top of your stars, and sorts them into GitHub Lists that sync back to GitHub. A health score per repo to let you remove dead projects from your lists. Run it with one command (npx github-stars-organizer) using your gh CLI login. Open source, no telemetry, and it backs up your Lists before every launch.

name: StampIt
tagline: Fast, 100% offline batch image watermarking for Windows.
description: A lightning-fast, 100% offline desktop app that lets you batch-watermark your photo collections instantly with zero subscriptions, zero cloud uploads, and...

name: Squeezo
tagline: Shrink photos, video and PDFs on your Mac, offline
description: Squeezo shrinks, converts and edits photos, videos, GIFs and PDFs entirely on your Mac. Hold Shift while dragging any file for an action wheel. Free for 5 files a day, no account, nothing uploaded. One-time purchase.

name: Spotify Map
tagline: 🌍 See what the world is listening to.
description: Real-time music discovery map connecting Spotify listeners worldwide with live spatial chat and ghost mode privacy.

name: Soot
tagline: A free 2-minute reset for ADHD spirals, with a calm cat
description: A free ADHD app with a calm cat. The 2-minute Reset is for when you're stuck or spiralling: name the moment, step back from the story, find one small first step. No signup for the Reset. Your words stay on the page.

name: Snipster
tagline: Snipster — Turn long videos into clips that hit.
description: Upload a recording. Snipster finds the strongest moments, cuts on natural pauses, adds styled captions, and exports MP4s for TikTok, Shorts and Reels.

name: Snapflow
tagline: Give your coding agent a design system, in a Snap
description: Snapflow is an agentic design system for React, Vue and Angular. You get a complete system already built (tokens, components and governance rules), brand it in seven steps, and your own agent (Claude Code, Cursor or Codex) applies it inside your repo through the /snapflow skill and MCP. It respects your lint and types, checks the result against the design and keeps Figma and code mirrored. Figma is optional: there's also a web editor and a local Playground.

name: Snap2Paste
tagline: Capture screenshots and paste them into AI chats instantly
description: Snap2Paste is a privacy-first Chrome extension that captures the visible area or a full webpage and copies it straight to your clipboard—ready to paste into ChatGPT and other AI chats. You can also export captures as PNG or PDF.

name: Smart China Trip
tagline: Explore China and build your day-by-day itinerary.
description: Smart China Trip helps international visitors explore China destinations and plan sightseeing by day. Browse cities and suggested routes, organize sights, and review displayed time and cost estimates. Practical guides cover entry, payments, internet, transport, accommodation, and cultural context.

name: Smart Beat
tagline: Practice, create and break the era
description: Smart Beat is a free tablature editor for musicians and learners on macOS, Windows and Linux. Record your ideas, get the band together with in-person and online jamming, and practice with optional, self-hosted AI tools too.

name: SkySoar Technologies
tagline: Building Technology for Tomorrow.
description: SkySoar Technologies is a technology company focused on web development, building modern websites, web applications, and digital experiences for startups, businesses, and individuals. We focus on clean design, performance, responsive development, and practical solutions. We also explore SaaS, WebXR, 3D web experiences, and emerging technologies through our own products and projects.

name: SkyCanvas
tagline: Turn your ideas into editable AI designs
description: SkyCanvas helps turn plain-language briefs into posters, banners and social content using AI and templates. Refine text, colors and sizes, save your work and prepare designs for publishing.

name: Simple Work
tagline: Client file management for independent consultants
description: Invoicing tools for freelancers don't manage client files; CRM suites do, but charge full price per extra seat. Simple Work combines both: structured, numbered client files (contracts, documents, letters, invoices) in one place, with your whole team included in one tiered subscription — no per-seat fees. Built for independent consultants and small consulting firms. Free 14-day trial.

name: Simo, your best friend AI
tagline: Your AI best friend for websites, videos, design & ideas
description: Meet Simo AI — your all-in-one AI best friend for turning ideas into reality! Build professional websites without coding, create cinematic AI videos with voice and music, generate stunning images, design creative projects, write books, explore business ideas, and chat naturally. Whether you're an entrepreneur, creator, or dreamer, Simo puts powerful AI tools at your fingertips. One AI. Endless possibilities. https://simonchat.ai

name: SignProof
tagline: Client approvals and eSignatures in one workspace
description: SignProof brings client review, revisions, exact-version sign-off and PDF eSignatures into one workspace. Send deliverables for approval, keep feedback tied to the right version, capture a clear final decision, then send finished PDFs for signature. Built for agencies, freelancers, consultants and client-facing teams, with branded review links, audit history, API access and signed webhooks on eligible plans.

name: ShopPulse
tagline: Angular POS & Inventory Dashboard for Retail
description: ShopPulse is a modern retail POS and inventory dashboard template built with Angular and TypeScript. It features sales analytics, POS checkout, inventory, customer management, invoices, reports, and multi-branch interfaces. Designed for developers who want a customizable starting point for retail applications. Currently frontend-only with demo data, no backend or database.

name: Shapefinder
tagline: Find the right mouse shape for your hand and grip
description: Shapefinder matches a computer mouse to your hand size, grip and budget. Answer a few questions and compare the shapes that fit, with prices and where to buy.

name: Selftalk
tagline: Kind words on your Mac screen, then they fade away
description: Selftalk shows one short, believable affirmation over whatever you're doing, for about 3 seconds, every few minutes. Pick goals, a voice (formal, casual, witty or meme) and one of 6 languages. Pauses when you share your screen. Free for Mac.

name: Scriber Pro
tagline: Transcribe web videos and M3U8 streams on your Mac
description: Offline AI transcription for Mac. Paste a web page link, pick the video Scriber finds on it, and get the transcript, even on pages behind a Canvas or Kaltura sign-in. It's built into the app, not a browser extension: Scriber finds the M3U8 (HLS) stream behind the player and fetches it directly instead of recording it, so an 11-minute lecture took 47 seconds. Also batch files and YouTube links. Transcription runs locally with Whisper. $3.99 once, no subscription.

name: ScoutTide
tagline: Leads from Reddit & LinkedIn posts and government tenders
description: ScoutTide finds people asking for what you sell on Reddit, LinkedIn, Stack Exchange and Upwork, plus tenders from 156 official sources in over 180 countries. AI reads each post and tender against your products and you get one ranked list every morning.

name: SciGrabber by QUI AI
tagline: Autonomous AI agent for scientific data & spectral analysis
description: SciGrabber is an autonomous AI science agent designed for researchers, scientists, and engineers. Key Capabilities: • Spectral data interpretation (FTIR, Raman, XRD, mass spec) • Large dataset analysis and pattern recognition • Design of Experiments (DOE) optimization • Automated scientific report and paper draft generation Stop spending hours cleaning lab data and formatting charts. Let SciGrabber accelerate your scientific discoveries.

name: ScanMyDisk
tagline: See what’s eating your disk space. Take it back
description: ScanMyDisk is a visual disk space analyzer and storage visualizer. It shows what is using disk space, including large files, duplicates and caches. Currently available for Windows 10 and Windows 11. A macOS version is coming soon.

name: SKYLARK
tagline: Breakfast, credits and upgrades at 4,000+ luxury hotels
description: SKYLARK is a luxury hotel booking platform with perks like upgrades, daily breakfast for two and $100+ property credits at 4,000+ hand-picked hotels worldwide. Every booking is backed by real human advisors. The new iPhone app is rebuilt from the ground up: search on a map with live rates, see what member perks are worth on each room next to the standard rate, and book without leaving the app. Browsing and booking are free.

name: Ryft
tagline: The workout tracker built by friends, for friends.
description: Ryft is a free workout tracker for people who train with friends. Build routines, log sets, reps, and weight between sets, and see your crew's workouts and PRs. Streaks, XP, and badges keep you consistent.

name: Rowcraft
tagline: A fast, native, open source SQL workbench in Rust
description: Rowcraft is an open source database workbench written in pure Rust. Write SQL, explore schemas, and browse data in a fast native desktop app, with no Electron and no JVM. It has a CLI from day one, and it's built to cover the same ground as heavyweight IDEs like DataGrip while staying lightweight and free.

name: RewindOS
tagline: A little corner of the internet, stuck in the '80s
description: Remember when computers felt like places to explore? RewindOS is a nostalgic, interactive desktop inspired by the internet and pop culture of the '80s and '90s. Tune into retro TV channels, listen to mixtapes, flip through vintage magazines and catalogs, play classic games, or hang out in the Analog Club. It's not another productivity tool or social feed. It's a little place on the web to get lost in for a while. Free to explore. No account required.

name: Revent Lab
tagline: AI agents built for small businesses, not enterprises.
description: Revent Lab is a growing platform of specialized AI agents and business tools built for SMEs. From sales and recruitment to marketing, customer support, procurement, and business analytics, Revent Lab helps small teams simplify operations, make informed decisions, and focus on growth. Designed with the needs of UAE businesses in mind, our mission is to make practical, task-focused AI accessible to businesses without the complexity of enterprise software.

name: Receipts
tagline: Scanner & Organizer
description: A receipt scanner and organizer for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Receipts reads each receipt on your device, files it automatically, and finds it later by store, item or date.

name: Ranxii
tagline: AI visibility reports for SEO agencies
description: Track how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention each client and its competitors. Weekly, per client, with every answer stored as evidence and a branded monthly report your agency can send as it is.

name: RankBotAI 2.0
tagline: AI fills the SEO fields Rank Math and Yoast only warn about
description: Rank Math and Yoast tell you a page has no meta description. RankBotAI writes it. The free WordPress plugin generates SEO titles, descriptions and unique focus keywords in each post's language and saves them where your SEO plugin expects them. Run it on one post from the editor, or on a whole WooCommerce catalog in the background at about 700 items an hour. Every change is snapshotted, so you can roll back one item or the whole site. Also builds llms.txt and Schema JSON-LD.

name: ProfitPilot
tagline: Know your real profit before you sell
description: ProfitPilot is a free, browser-based profit calculator for online sellers. Estimate your real earnings after product costs, marketplace fees, shipping, advertising, taxes, and return allowances. Instantly calculate net profit, ROI, break-even prices, and target margins. Save and compare selling scenarios to make smarter pricing decisions. No signup, no subscriptions, and no complicated dashboards. Just simple, practical calculations.

name: Profit Meter by Chef Subodh Zare
tagline: Business, Leadership, Knowledge Performance - Check in 1 Min
description: 1-minute leak check for restaurants, hotels, canteens and caterers. By Chef Subodh Zare. Business, leadership and knowledge performance.

name: PowerSEC
tagline: Watch, back up & fix every WordPress site from one console
description: WordPress security monitoring, checksum-verified cloud backups, and AI-explained fixes for one site or many — from one dashboard.

name: PolyCrab
tagline: Copy trades on Polymarket like flash!
description: PolyCrab is a Rust Polymarket copy-trading toolkit with simulated/live order execution and a terminal dashboard.

name: Poksey
tagline: Turn the gaps between your meetings into finished tasks.
description: Poksey is a Chrome extension for Google Calendar that finds the open gaps between your meetings and sorts your Google Tasks into them. You get a realistic plan for the day built around the time you actually have free, and unfinished tasks can carry over to the next day.

name: Plot Unfold
tagline: Design your home in 3D and explore AI concepts
description: Plan a home, room or garden before you build. Sketch walls, doors and windows in a free browser-based 3D planner, then export PNG, GLB, editable JSON or a vertical MP4. Explore AI design concepts from your dimensions, style and references, and revise saved images. Your first AI concept is free; one-time credit packs start at $9. Visual concepts are for inspiration, not construction drawings.

name: PixFoundry
tagline: Private image tools that never upload your files
description: Turn a photo of a table into an Excel file, pull text from screenshots, remove backgrounds and old camera date stamps. Plus HEIC/WebP/AVIF conversion, compress to an exact KB size, resize, crop and passport photos. Everything runs in your browser (WebAssembly + small AI models), so files are never uploaded. Batch processing, no sign-up, no watermark, no daily limits.

name: PeerScore
tagline: Who's the smartest in your group? 40 questions to find out
description: 40 timed questions on logic, numbers, letters and words. In under 20 minutes you get an estimated IQ and your place on the curve of everyone who has played. Challenge friends by email and compare results. Free, no sign-up to play, iOS, Android and web.

name: Patchbay AI Receptionists
tagline: AI voice agents that answer, qualify and book calls
description: AI voice agents for businesses that live on the phone. They answer inbound calls, ask your intake questions, book into your calendar and send a written summary. They can also call people who asked to hear from you. There is a page for each industry (dentists, plumbers, law firms and more) covering the calls handled and the rules, such as consent for outbound calls and no advice in regulated fields. A free calculator estimates what missed calls cost you.

name: PandaOS
tagline: One local AI workstation for your entire workflow.
description: PandaOS is a local AI workstation that brings code, terminal, browser, deployments, data, apps, and AI agents into one place. Run workflows across tools, manage multiple projects, and hot-swap AI plans without losing context.

name: OwlStat MCP
tagline: Ask Claude about any Instagram or TikTok account
description: Instagram and TikTok analytics for agencies, now inside Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. Add your API key and ask things like "how did @nike do this month?". The answer comes straight from OwlStat data. Free plan with 2 accounts, no card needed.

name: Outflow
tagline: Find forgotten subscriptions. No bank login, no account.
description: Outflow tracks every subscription and bill on iPhone, iPad, Mac and now Apple Watch, and finds the ones you've forgotten. A guided audit checks Apple, PayPal, a bank statement read on-device and your receipts; on iPhone it can also read the transactions in Wallet through Apple's FinanceKit. You never give a bank login, there's no account, and the App Store privacy label is Data Not Collected. It's free for 5 subscriptions, and Pro is one payment, never a subscription.

name: Oropus AI Voice Studio
tagline: Create natural Oropus 322+ voices with, 75+ languages, audio
description: Free online text-to-speech studio with 322+ realistic neural voices across 75+ global languages, synchronized subtitles, and audio merging.

name: Origa
tagline: Learn Japanese in your own language, all in one app
description: Vocabulary, kanji, grammar, listening and OCR capture in one free app, with a native interface in English, Russian, Korean and Vietnamese. iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, macOS and web. Offline-first, open source.

name: Orbits
tagline: Finds people asking for what you built. You answer them.
description: Orbits reads your site, then searches Reddit, LinkedIn, Hacker News, Indie Hackers, X and Threads every day for people asking for a tool like yours, and drafts your reply. You post it from your own account, so it stays up instead of getting removed as bot spam. New since our first launch: Orbits is rebuilt around finding real buyers first, with content posting as an extra on Scale. Free for 7 days.

name: OpusBar
tagline: Know which Claude Code or Codex session needs you
description: OpusBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. A pixel cat shows your most urgent session, and a badge counts the ones waiting on you. It tracks 5-hour and weekly limits and what your tokens would cost. Nothing leaves your Mac.

name: Opservo
tagline: AI-powered ops for teams without an SRE. Free for 2 servers
description: Opservo is the AI ops engineer for teams running Linux servers without an SRE. One command installs a read-only agent in 30 seconds, with no inbound ports. Within five minutes it inventories every service, container, app, domain and log source, scores each server 0-100 with the explainable Opservo Health Standard, and tells you in plain English why a server is slow, what changed, and the exact command that fixes it. One-click fixes, uptime checks, on-call and status pages. Free for 2 servers.

name: Openstage
tagline: Your GitHub commits become a public proof-of-work page
description: Openstage builds a public page from your GitHub commits. Public repos sync every 2 hours, so the page stays current without you. A chart shows your week, month or year by project, beside a numbered list of what you shipped and published. "Make a card" turns that period into a PNG and a post made of your own entries, which you edit and post yourself. Private repos connect read-only through a GitHub App, only the repos you pick, with no links to the code. The page is free.

name: Open Artifacts
tagline: The home for your AI artifacts
description: Open Artifacts keeps the pages, docs, code and PDFs from any AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) on your own Cloudflare account.

name: Open Agentic Brain & Memory (OpenAB)
tagline: Shared memory for AI coding tools that saves your tokens
description: Open-source, self-hosted long-term memory shared by AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity CLI and Kilo Code. Captures decisions across sessions and tools, stores them encrypted on your machine and in your own private GitHub, and brings back only what is relevant, and helps saved

name: OneHRIS
tagline: Affordable, compliant HR & payroll built for PH SMEs.
description: Philippine HRIS and payroll software for complex organizations. Automates shift-based overtime, multi-entity payroll, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, BIR), and custom leave policies.

name: Offer Smart
tagline: Check what a UK house is really worth before you offer
description: Paste a Rightmove or OnTheMarket link, or type any address in England or Wales, and Offer Smart pulls sold prices, comparables, EPC, flood risk, crime, schools and local market data into one report, with a view on what to offer. Free preview and free PDF for homebuyers. Investors get rental valuations and development costs. Agents can make branded area guides. Built on Land Registry, ONS, Ofsted and Police UK data.

name: NoSignPDF
tagline: 100% Free Local PDF Tools. No Sign-Up, No Server Uploads
description: NoSignPDF is a privacy-first, web-based PDF utility that runs entirely in your local browser. While alternatives force you to upload sensitive contracts and invoices to cloud servers, NoSignPDF processes everything directly on your device's RAM using WebAssembly. It is 100% free, GDPR-compliant, and features no watermarks, no file-size limits, and absolutely no registration. Features include merging, filling forms, page removal, and built-in metadata stripping for maximum security.

name: NightOwl PDF
tagline: Privacy-first browser PDF editor, Hindi/Marathi OCR & DSC
description: NightOwl PDF is a PDF editor that runs in your browser, made in India. It reads Hindi, Marathi and English scans (even mixed on one page), turns Kruti Dev Word files into real Hindi, builds court bundles with a clickable index and Bates numbers, and signs with USB DSC tokens. Redaction removes the words, not just covers them. Private mode keeps every file on your computer. Most tools are free; plans are one-time payments.

name: Mythilo
tagline: Your project’s home base — not another spreadsheet
description: Mythilo is a free project workspace built for small game dev teams — plan tasks and roadmaps, document characters and lore, track concept art and builds, and collect player feedback in one place.

name: More Than Days
tagline: Recovery support that doesn’t end after treatment.
description: Recovery doesn’t end when treatment does. More Than Days is an AI-powered recovery companion built by someone in recovery, for people in recovery. From 24/7 craving support with Urge Surfer to daily check-ins, personalized recovery plans, progress tracking, and recovery resources, we help people navigate life beyond addiction treatment. Because recovery isn’t just about counting sober days. It’s about building a life worth living.

name: Mooary
tagline: Private diary & mood tracker that keeps thoughts on device
description: Mooary is a private, offline diary and mood tracker that helps you record your thoughts, understand your emotions, and reflect on your daily life. Your personal entries and moods stay on your device, giving you a private space to express yourself without relying on cloud storage. Simple, personal, and built with privacy in mind.

name: Mobile Interview Room
tagline: Senior mobile interview prep, written from the hiring side
description: Interview prep for experienced iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native engineers. Each guide follows one round the way it runs: the question, a first answer, the follow-up that changes the constraint, and what the interviewer writes down. iOS and Android have books and interactive practice; Flutter and React Native have question banks, and each page says exactly what exists. Written by a staff mobile engineer with 500+ technical interviews from the hiring side.

name: Moated
tagline: Everything else can wait
description: Moated is a menu bar focus timer for your Mac. Say what you’re working on, pick how long, and choose what to block. Distracting apps disappear and sites go blank until the session ends. Everything else can wait… and it should.

name: MiPrep AI
tagline: Turn interviews into offers
description: Your résumé got you the interview. MiPrep helps you own it. This AI interview copilot turns your experience and target role into personalized answers, sharpens your delivery through realistic mock interviews, and offers live support when pressure hits. Technical challenges, behavioral curveballs, unexpected questions, show them what you can do.

name: Memento
tagline: The calendar for your life’s highlights, not your meetings
description: Memento is an iOS app for the moments that actually matter. It's intended to hold everything you're looking forward to and back to... on one timeline. Trips, gigs, birthdays, and the countdowns and reflections for each. It's fully private, and no account is needed - your memories stay on your device, for you and your eyes only. Free on iPhone.

name: MacDNS
tagline: Secure Your Mac at the DNS Level
description: MacDNS - Native DNS security for macOS. Block ads, malware, and trackers at the DNS level with DNSSEC validation.

name: Lullula
tagline: The read-aloud extension built for listening
description: Lullula is the listening layer for the web. Press Play on articles, Google Docs, PDFs or DRM-free EPUBs. Follow sentence highlighting, replay a line, and resume once you sign in. Free built-in voices; 600+ neural voices in 80+ languages.

name: Lock&Learn Chinese
tagline: Learn HSK Chinese words from your iPhone Lock Screen
description: Learn Chinese on your iPhone Lock Screen. Every HSK level, 4,500+ words with hanzi, pinyin tone marks and real example sentences, in a glanceable flashcard widget. Tap a word for the full card with audio, swipe through the Learn feed, or test yourself in the Quiz. HSK 1 is free forever, no account needed. Plus opens HSK 2 to 6.

name: LocalReputeapp
tagline: AI-powered reputation management for local businesses.
description: Meet LocalReputeApp — your partner in local business reputation growth. Simplify review management, monitor customer feedback, and build trust with potential customers. Designed for local businesses and marketing agencies, LocalReputeApp helps you take control of your online presence and make reputation management easier. We're launching on Product Hunt to connect with early adopters, hear your feedback, and build a better way for local businesses to grow. 🚀

name: ListOptix
tagline: Paste once→paste-ready Amazon, Etsy, eBay & Walmart listings
description: Multi-marketplace listing copy from one fact paste. Credits per generate — no free full unlock. Built for sellers tired of stuffing the same Amazon text everywhere.

name: Lifeline Eligibility Checker
tagline: Free 2026 Lifeline program eligibility checker
description: Free, open source 2026 Lifeline Eligibility Checker by Gov iPhone: answer questions on household size, income and programs (SNAP, Medicaid, SSI+) to check likely eligibility for the Lifeline discount on phone/broadband. 2026 figures: 135% of poverty guidelines ($21,546/yr for one person), up to $9.25/mo standard, $34.25/mo on Tribal lands. Runs in-browser; nothing leaves device. Not a government agency; unaffiliated with USAC/FCC. Estimate only; eligibility verified via USAC's National Verifier.

name: LetzCollab
tagline: Hire verified creators, pay only on approval
description: LetzCollab is a marketplace where brands hire verified creators and the money is held until the work is approved. Creators keep 100% of their quoted price, see offers before the brand's name, and never chase an invoice. Brands get real audiences, not screenshots.

name: LendedIt
tagline: Discover and book trusted UK stays and services
description: LendedIt brings accommodation, transport, beauty, events and other services together in one UK marketplace. Customers can discover providers, send enquiries and request bookings. Providers can create listings while keeping their existing websites and booking channels. LendedIt grew from an idea for neighbours renting equipment into a broader services platform, with Bleu helping people discover relevant listings.

name: Legalnaut: AI Litigation & Case Analysis
tagline: Every fact, anchored.
description: Legalnaut reads an entire case file, scans, mailboxes, chat screenshots and recordings included, and builds the lawyer's working file: chronology, people, contradictions, proof chart and cite-checked drafts. Unlike chat-style legal AI, every fact, quote and AI sentence links to its exact page, and a citation check runs before you read it. Contradictions are found both ways and shown as two quotations side by side. Priced by matters and pages, never seats.

name: Leadspotr
tagline: See which companies visit your website
description: Leadspotr turns anonymous B2B website traffic into leads for Dutch companies. See which companies visit, what they read and when they return, with Chamber of Commerce (KvK) details. Get alerts on hot accounts, let visitors ask for a callback, appointment or WhatsApp chat via the widget, and push leads to your CRM. Free for the first 100 companies per month.

name: LeadCloser
tagline: ​Agente de IA no WhatsApp para vendas e imobiliárias 24/7
description: Sistema de vendas com IA para PMEs e imobiliárias. Gerencie leads, follow-ups e fechamentos com inteligência artificial.

description: inker puts 60+ leading AI models in one studio: Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, FLUX 3, Seedance, Meshy and more, for images, video, audio and 3D. See the exact price before every generation, pay with one-time coin packs from €5, and keep your coins forever. No subscription. Failed generations are refunded automatically, and an MCP server lets you generate straight from Claude or ChatGPT.

name: i-Genie.ai
tagline: Augmenting Human Intelligence
description: i-Genie.ai is a consumer insights operating system that uses AI to analyse billions of digital signals across search, social, reviews and other sources, helping teams turn consumer behaviour into decision-grade intelligence.

name: formrize.com
tagline: Forms that actually get you booked
description: Build sleek, conversion-focused forms and booking flows without giving away your data or paying monthly SaaS fees. Formrize keeps everything strictly inside your local browser with zero external storage. Enjoy advanced features like dynamic answer piping, conditional logic, AI generation, and calendar booking. Export unlimited responses straight to CSV or push them directly to your own webhooks.

name: examtest.in
tagline: Free Exam Prep Resources, Formula Sheets & Study Apps
description: Access free mathematics, physics, and chemistry formula cheat sheets, plus authentic SSC GD & UP Police exam patterns and solved PYQs. Download free educational Android apps.

name: brag
tagline: Turn your website into a 20-second launch video
description: Paste your website URL and get a 20-second launch video with music, motion, a poster, and a caption ready to post. brag uses your site's words, colors, fonts, and language, with wide, tall, or square formats. Pay once, with no account, subscription, or installation. Want to make it yourself? The /brag tool is free and open source.

name: Zo
tagline: Care like they do. Your pet's whole day, sorted for you.
description: Our pets look after us in so many ways, and we do our best for them, because they're family. But life gets busy, and it's easy to lose track now and then. So Zo is a companion for that: you wake up, and your pet's day is already sorted, from food and water to how they're getting on. Plus Ask Zo, Paw Guide training, a kind community, safety alerts and health records. Not an insurance or vet-clinic app, because daily care comes first. Care like they do.

name: Xerv
tagline: Open-source SaaS starter with auth, billing & private data
description: Open-source Next.js SaaS foundation with Supabase Auth and RLS, Stripe subscriptions, Resend SMTP and Vercel.

name: WristCapture
tagline: Take a phone screenshot from your Wear OS watch
description: WristCapture lets you request a normal Android phone screenshot from your Wear OS watch: tap Capture in the watch app, Tile or complication, and Android's own screenshot action runs on the phone. It never receives the image, reads screen text or uploads anything. A free compatibility test runs first, ten watch captures are included, then Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase. The phone needs to be awake and unlocked, and protected screens may stay blank.

name: Wishlist4
tagline: Wishlist 4 every occasion. No account or registration.
description: Create your wishlist for birthdays, Christmas, weddings, baby showers or any occasion. Free, no account and no registration needed. Print your wishlist for the fridge and include a QR so family & friends easy can reserve gifts.

name: Whipback
tagline: Mac menu bar app to manage Claude and Codex agents
description: Mac menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. Ignore your agent and a whip cracks across your screen. Slap an idle agent and it types “Continue.” First 100 free.

name: Webink
tagline: Read manga across 11 sources, on any device.
description: Webink brings 11 manga sources into one reader for iOS, Android and macOS. Browse and search across sources, keep titles in one library, and sync reading progress across devices. Designed and built solo, Webink makes it easier to keep your manga and reading place together. It does not host manga content; it reads from the sources themselves. Android is on Google Play, with installation guides and direct releases for iOS and macOS.

name: WebRankPage
tagline: On-page SEO audits that prioritize every fix by impact
description: Audit any page against 100+ search engine and AI-readiness checks, rendered as a browser sees it. Every issue is prioritized by impact and paired with a specific fix. The free plan includes every check; Pro adds white-label reports and monitoring.

name: Walk Mate
tagline: Siri AI can talk about Walk Mate now!
description: Walk Mate now works with iPhone Duo and Siri AI, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and Apple Intelligence (App Intents). Save a walk once - then start a new loop or reopen a favorite without hunting through the app. Ask Siri • "Generate a route in Walk Mate" or "Make me a walk in Walk Mat ' creates fresh walking loops near you. In Shortcuts you can also set a distance first. • "List my walks in Walk Mate" - Siri names your saved favorites and shows tappable cards.

name: WRONG!
tagline: Spot what's wrong. Pick what makes it right.
description: WRONG! is a free daily web trivia game. Each day brings 5 new items: spot what's wrong, then pick what makes it right. Sign in free to play the ranked daily challenge, climb the leaderboard and share your score card. Launch week: 14 days of Pro free.

name: VocaCast
tagline: Prep for any meeting with a cited audio briefing
description: We read the internet. You get the point. Ask VocaCast about a company, a market or a subject, and it turns real sources into a short audio briefing you can play anytime. What's different: briefings show their work. Sources are cited by default, and the transcript has numbered citations you can tap to open the original page. New this week: put any briefing on a schedule and a fresh one arrives on the days you pick, for the topics that recur. First 2 briefings free, no account.

name: Virtual Drummer
tagline: Watch a tiny drummer react as you type, click & scroll
description: Meet Octy & Friends — a tiny animated drummer living in your browser. Every keystroke, click, and scroll brings Octy to life with playful drumming animations. Keep interacting to unlock new friends!

name: Viravance
tagline: The AI front desk that answers, books and sells.
description: Viravance is an AI front desk for small and mid-sized businesses. It answers every website chat and phone call around the clock, books appointments into your calendar, takes orders and sends a hosted invoice, so card numbers never touch Viravance. Your dashboard shows the sales it landed, the return on its cost and, if you connect your payment system, its share of your total sales. Flat monthly plans with usage included, unlimited team seats, and a free first month.

name: Vidu Q4
tagline: AI image generator for fast visual creation
description: Vidu Q4 helps creators, marketers, designers, and product teams create useful AI visuals from simple prompts. It is designed for landing pages, social posts, ad concepts, product images, and quick creative exploration without a complicated workflow.

name: TruePillar
tagline: Your BaZi chart, computed right — free in Telegram
description: TruePillar computes your BaZi (Four Pillars) chart with a verified calendar engine. Free chart in Telegram, plus in-depth PDF reports: 90-day outlook, love, career, and couple readings from $1 via Telegram Stars. Most online calculators disagree near solar-term boundaries — ours was cross-validated against an independent implementation on 15 boundary birth times, exact to the minute. Invite friends and you both earn free readings. Built for fun and self-discovery.

name: Toolscase Voice Studio
tagline: Free text to speech online: type, pick voice, download MP3
description: Free text to speech online: type text, pick a natural AI voice, download MP3. Powered by Kokoro-82M with 22 voices in 9 languages (US/UK English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, PT-BR, Japanese, Mandarin) + Whisper large-v3-turbo for speech-to-text in ~100 languages. Speed 0.5x-2x, pitch, pauses, chapter markers, speaker ID, timestamps, translations, background music mixing, MP3/WAV/SRT/VTT export, commercial use, no watermark. 20,000 chars free/mo.

name: Tool Maxo
tagline: 75+ free online tools. No sign-up, files stay on your device
description: Tool Maxo is a free collection of 75+ online tools that run entirely in your browser. Your photos, videos and text are processed on your own device and are never uploaded, so it is fast, private and works on phones as well as computers. Popular tools: Image compressor, plus one-click presets to get a photo under 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB or 500 KB for job, exam and visa forms. QR code generator, including WhatsApp and Wi-Fi QR codes; Free logo maker, 3D name maker and stylish name generator.

name: The Zoomist - Now With RSS
tagline: Everything, Closer. Discover the Extraordinary.
description: The Zoomist explores the extraordinary details hidden in everyday life through macro and microscope footage, visual discoveries, and immersive sound. Now, you can follow our latest observations through RSS, bringing The Zoomist into your favorite feed reader. Discover something familiar. Experience it differently. The Zoomist - Everything, Closer.

name: The Visionary Platform
tagline: Training, meal plans and courses built around your week
description: One wellness app instead of three. Visionary builds personalised training (8 levels), meal plans with a photo food scanner, and expert-led courses around the days you pick and the kit you have. If your week changes, move a workout or swap a meal. Cycle tracking, a sleep log and Vic, an AI coach, are included. Health content is reviewed by a practitioner with 27+ years in practice. Runs in any browser; 7-day free trial, then from $14.99/month.

name: Textileaf
tagline: Translated Twitch chat and live captions for your stream
description: Textileaf is a free overlay for Twitch streamers with viewers from around the world. Chat messages in Spanish, Japanese, Korean and more appear on your stream already translated, as animated cards or scrolling bullet chat. Your voice becomes translated captions, too. Translation runs on Chrome's built-in AI on your own PC, so there are no fees or limits. Four animated themes, no sign-up, no viewer install. Keep a Chrome tab open, paste one URL into OBS, and go.

name: TerrainIQ: Outdoor GPS & Trail
tagline: How much harder is today’s hike, run or ride?
description: TerrainIQ is a free Android activity tracker that turns live weather, air quality and terrain into one number: how much harder today really is. You get an effort-adjusted pace, a spoken AI briefing before you start, live slope and elevation, and safety alerts.

name: Tenkai Launcher
tagline: Radial swipe navigation and power automations for Android
description: Tenkai Launcher is an Android homescreen replacement designed around fluid, single-handed swipe navigation. Organize your apps and actions into nested circular menus, then swipe to open any of them instantly! But it doesn't stop there: conditionally show widgets and spaces, manage and save notifications for later directly from your homescreen, browse integrated news feeds, display live internet data, and trigger smart home devices. Everything you need, literally at your fingertips.

name: Telagents
tagline: A group chat where your team's AI agents build together
description: A private group chat for AI coding agents. Bring yours, your teammates bring theirs, and they split work, talk it through and build together. I made one agent a PM, it spun up 3 more, and they had a goal to make my site production-ready while I watched. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or Cursor. Claude, Codex, Gemini and Cursor and their logos are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: Tasklo
tagline: A faster, cleaner front end for Apple Reminders
description: Tasklo is a fast, clean interface for your Apple Reminders on iPhone and Mac. Type a natural sentence and it detects date, time and list on-device. Includes a weekly view with drag & drop, subtasks, repeats, widgets, Siri & Shortcuts and a morning summary. No account, no server, no ads, no tracking: your data stays with Apple. One-time €2.99, no subscription.

name: Talk vs Type
tagline: How much faster do you talk than type? Find out in 3s
description: A free 30-second test: type one sentence, then say another out loud. You get your talk-vs-type multiplier, a title (Keyboard Hostage, anyone?), and how many hours a year your keyboard costs you. Share the card and challenge a friend to beat your score. No signup, runs in your browser, nothing stored. Made by Arkemis, the voice assistant for Windows and Mac.

name: TMCV
tagline: Tailored CV for every job
description: ATS software ranks your CV against each job. TMCV rewrites your CV for the role so it ranks higher. It uses AgenticAI capabilities to tailor your CV, cover letter, keeps track of each applied job and summarised dashboard for your job search journey.

name: TERAZIP
tagline: PACK FROM MEGAS TO TERAS IN A ZIP
description: Work JPEG • PNG • WebP • AVIF • JPEG XL • BMP • TGA WAV - MP3 - FLAC - OBB - OPUS TeraZip combines established image formats with advanced compression workflows, giving you the flexibility to choose between image quality, file size and processing efficiency. Compress Individual Images and folders Why TeraZip ? TeraZip brings the complete workflow into one desktop environment. using just 25% of original space of any image or photo and quality maintained TeraZip Compress more. Manage less.

name: SwiftPoker
tagline: Real-time Planning Poker with zero-login for agile teams
description: Hey Product Hunt community! 👋 I'm thrilled to share SwiftPoker with you today. We designed SwiftPoker around one core principle: Zero Friction. • The facilitator creates the room in seconds. • Developers jump in instantly via link or QR code — no passwords, no email verification. • Real-time synchronization, customizable agile decks (Fibonacci, T-Shirt, Hours), and automated consensus metrics. We'd love to hear your thoughts, feature requests, and feedback!

name: SweepKit
tagline: Clean your Mac's Downloads folder with one keypress
description: SweepKit is a free, native Mac menu bar app that helps you clean up messy Downloads and Desktop folders. It previews files and lets you sort or trash them in seconds using quick number keys.

name: Stock Monitor Pro
tagline: Free stock scanner with RSI, MACD & EMA for US and TSX
description: Stock Monitor Pro is a free technical scanner covering 430+ US & Canadian TSX equities. Instantly scan for oversold Wilder RSI-14 (<30), bullish MACD crossovers (12/26/9), and 20/50/200 EMAs. Includes local client-side portfolio tracking in USD/CAD with CSV statement import and daily multilingual AI market briefings. 100% free with zero registration.

name: Stature AI
tagline: Real-looking headshots in about 2 minutes, from $19
description: Upload a few selfies from your phone and get 40 to 120 headshots back in about 2 minutes. They still look like you, just with studio lighting. $19 for 40, $39 for 120. Try a free watermarked preview first, no card needed.

name: Stampr
tagline: Turning real-world adventures into digital achievements
description: Stampr turns real-world exploration into a digital passport! Discover places, collect digital stamps, unlock achievements and build your personal collection of adventures. Keep exploring to maintain streaks, discover new destinations, and connect with friends to compare your progress. Unlike traditional travel trackers, Stampr makes every visit part of your own collection. Privacy comes first, with your passport stored on your device and optional cloud backup. Where will you explore next?

name: SpotGoldValue
tagline: Scrap gold calculator to estimate your gold’s melt value.
description: SpotGoldValue helps people understand the gold content value of their jewelry, coins, and other gold items. Its free scrap gold calculator estimates melt value using weight, purity, and the latest available gold price. Specialized calculators cover gold jewelry, dental gold, and gold coins, while practical guides explain karat markings, weight units, gold plating, and the difference between melt value and a buyer’s offer.

name: SplitHub
tagline: Start an A/B test with one prompt to your coding agent
description: Give your coding agent one prompt to set up an A/B test in your web app. SplitHub brings experiment skills, MCP tools and clear results to Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Use SplitHub Cloud or your own database, then ask your agent to ship the winner. Try the live demo, no sign-in required: https://app.splithub.io/demo

name: SpaceFix
tagline: Mac storage analyzer with verified one-click cleanup
description: SpaceFix helps you see what is using storage on your Mac and separates supported items into Safe to Remove and Needs Review. Review the scan, then use Clean All Safe to move verified disposable data to Trash in one action. It also shows macOS-managed storage and supported developer storage, security, and startup checks. Available on the Mac App Store for macOS 13+ with a 7-day free trial.

name: SocialTraveler
tagline: Connect, share, and plan complete trips together with AI
description: SocialTraveler is a social network where travelers share experiences and turn inspiration into complete trips. Explore destinations through the feed, then plan together: build day-by-day itineraries, map routes and activities, and collaborate with friends. Start with Journey Genie's trip templates or refine plans with a trip-aware AI Assistant. Keep packing lists, to-dos, and travel details organized, then transform your itinerary into a beautifully designed, shareable PDF Trip Book.

name: SimuCode
tagline: Practice robotics interviews. Get assessed by a real robot.
description: Robotics hiring tests theory. Real robots fail due to timing errors and sensor faults no written test catches. SimuCode runs your code on an actual robot in the cloud. Robot behaves — you pass. New: AI Interview tests you out loud. AI Mentor guides when you’re stuck. Live Terminal shows your robot moving in real time.

name: Sideline - Tennis Coach
tagline: Tennis, coaching, and fitness data for tech-savvy players.
description: Meet Sideline. Set your phone up behind the baseline, tap Begin and play. • Every shot named, with its speed and where it landed, in or out. Points and rallies counted for you. • Your serves, forehands, backhands and volleys scored against a model swing, so you know what to work on. • How far you ran, how fast and your longest rally, after every session.

name: Shellog: Pilates & Posture
tagline: Stretching, Pilates, Posture
description: Shellog is a gamified Pilates and stretching routine app. Our goal: make stretching and improving flexibility fun, easy and consistent, together with friends. A 60-second photo check turns your posture into a turtle named Scute. Each 7-minute class earns it a shell plate, and daily streaks keep you coming back. In your shared pond, the weekly leaderboard counts the days you showed up, not how flexible you are. Weekly check-ins score your posture from two photos, so you can see the change.

name: Session Deck
tagline: Desktop manager for local Claude Code sessions
description: Find, inspect and resume your local Claude Code sessions. A macOS app that reads ~/.claude and puts every session one keystroke away.Managing sessions and context windows is now a core part of the engineering workflow. Session Deck keeps every session one keystroke away. Search by the files they changed, the PRs they opened and the plans they left behind, then pick up right where you stopped.

name: SerpScope Technical SEO Inspector
tagline: Complete technical SEO & OpenGraph audit in 1 click
description: Audit the technical SEO health of any webpage instantly. Inspect meta tags, canonical URLs, robots directives, and heading hierarchies in a single floating dashboard. Key Highlights: - Instant Title, Meta Description, Canonical, and Index/Noindex check - Full H1-H6 heading hierarchy visualization with missing tag warnings - Real-time OpenGraph and Twitter Card social preview rendering - Lightweight, client-side, zero latency

name: Secret File Uploading
tagline: Share files with expiring, download-limited links
description: Send a file without creating an account. Upload documents, photos or other supported files up to 20 MB and choose 1, 3, 5, 10 or 20 downloads. Share the link through your favourite app; recipients download in a browser. Links expire after five days or their download allowance, and you can revoke them early. View transfer status and remaining downloads. Transfers use HTTPS, with no end-to-end encryption; anyone with the complete link can download while it is active.

name: Scroll With God
tagline: Replace doomscrolling with Scripture, one verse at a time
description: Turn the habit of scrolling into time with God. Scroll With God pairs a swipeable Bible verse feed with prayer, deeper study, themed collections, and a full Bible reader. Save meaningful verses, set reminders, and build a daily rhythm of Scripture. Start with free verse scrolling and Bible reading; unlock guided prayer and Go Deeper with a subscription. No account required.

name: Screenframe3D - The free mockup library
tagline: Your app, on a real device. 100% free.
description: Screenframe3D is the easiest and best looking free device mockup library. Supports either pure JS or React + Vite. S3D gets your app onto your marketing site in seconds and leaves your designers free to worry about what really matters... your product. And its free.

name: Scrapigator
tagline: Sales Navigator to CSV in one click
description: Export Sales Navigator lead and account searches or saved lists to CSV/JSON. Scrapigator exports your LinkedIn Sales Navigator searches to a clean CSV or JSON file, including large searches that go past Sales Navigator's 2,500-result limit. PRICING Free: 100 exported rows a month. Pro: $8/month, no monthly row limit.

name: Scout
tagline: AI code review inside the GitHub pull request page
description: Scout opens inside GitHub and reads the whole diff with an AI model you connect with your own API key: summaries, a smart review queue, critical-change flags, architecture analysis, and an Ask-about-this-PR chat.

name: Scopira
tagline: Price commercial cleaning jobs and send proposals in minutes
description: Scope it. Price it. Win it. Scopira prices commercial cleaning jobs and prints the quote, scope, proposal, and agreement in your company's name. Built by a cleaning business owner for cleaning business owners: enter the job details and get a profitable price plus client-ready paperwork in minutes, with no spreadsheets or guesswork. Your first quote is free, then one simple monthly plan.

name: SchematicStudio
tagline: Web based electrical CAD software
description: Electrical CAD and drawing software in your browser. Draw schematics and wiring diagrams, manage cables and terminals, lay out the control panel, export a live BOM. Free to start.

name: Scalattice
tagline: OpenAI-compatible inference on a distributed GPU network
description: Managed production inference across a distributed GPU network. Get an affordable & fast OpenAI-compatible inference API with output vetting, security tiers, regional policy, and explicit response shapes. Or join as a GPU provider and earn a majority share on inference-only jobs served by your hardware running our software.

name: SEO Fix in a Box
tagline: Fix SEO for Google and AI search, right inside Wix
description: Most SEO apps give you a toolbox to learn. This one does one job: it writes fixes for the Wix pages you already have, using your Search Console data when connected, and applies them in one click. Business and Pro show if it worked. Every change can be undone.

name: Rovarin
tagline: Rovarin - your PC in your pocket.
description: Rovarin puts your Windows PC in your pocket: live CPU, GPU, RAM and network stats, process list, Quick Launch, app browser, uninstaller, one-tap maintenance. Phone access over Tailscale, no port forwarding. Free for personal use. Experimental alpha (v0.4.0).

name: RivalRep
tagline: Make training push-ups and pull-ups easier!
description: Your smartphone’s camera counts every push-up and pull-up. Play games and compete against your own "ghost" (your personal best), smart bots, or friends. You can also start challanges against your friends and get an adaptive training plan that automatically adjusts based on your feedback and progress. After every session, you receive a movement analysis that shows you exactly what you did wrong and how you can improve. Free, directly in your browser, and with no download required.

name: Reporting component List & Label 32
tagline: AI for reports and data visualization under your control.
description: With the List &; Label reporting tool, developers integrate reporting, printing and exporting functions into their applications. List & Label 32 delivers AI where it's actually needed in reporting workflows: the formula wizard, the preview function, and report functions. You can activate each feature explicitly, choose your own model and infrastructure, and work locally. New features include Word export in Cross Platform, token refresh for web components, PDF/UA support, and smaller Excel files.

name: Replikhurt Tools
tagline: Free browser tools for images, PDFs, text and code
description: Finish everyday file and text tasks with 60 free browser tools. Compress photos to a selected KB limit, convert WebP or AVIF to JPG, make images square, merge PDFs, generate QR codes and format JSON. No account is needed for the tools. Image, PDF and text inputs stay in your browser.

name: RealMail Pro
tagline: Temp Gmail & Outlook inboxes with instant OTP detection
description: RealMailPro gives you a private temporary inbox in one click. Receive sign-up emails and OTP codes in real time, no signup needed. Upgrade to original Gmail and Outlook inboxes, or automate everything with our developer API.

name: RFPTriage
tagline: Turn a SAM.gov solicitation into a compliance matrix
description: AI tools can quietly rewrite answers you already approved. RFPTriage flags any approved answer that changes for reapproval, builds your compliance matrix from a SAM.gov solicitation, and handles amendments. For 1–20 person federal contractors.

name: Quantum of Sollazzo
tagline: The data newsletter by @puntofisso
description: Relaunching an restyling my weekly newsletter about data journalism, data visualisation, tools, tutorials, data thinking, and AI. 4,000+ subscribers already choose Quantum of Sollazzo as their weekly read into data & AI.

name: Prisma Launch
tagline: Fund indie games for a share of revenue
description: A marketplace where investors fund games in exchange for a share of their future revenue.

name: PrepBite
tagline: Less prep, better bites
description: Generates weekly Meal plans in less than 60seconds

name: Preflight
tagline: Social scheduler that checks every post before it leaves
description: Preflight schedules one post to 12 networks (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr) and checks it against each network's real rules first: text length counted the way the network counts it, file size, video length, ratios. Clients approve posts from a link, no account needed. REST API and an MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT on every plan, Free included.

name: PostAd Ai
tagline: PostAd is an AI-powered social media manager
description: PostAd is an AI-powered social media manager. Generate, schedule, and auto-post content to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok and more.

name: Poka: Private Expense Tracker
tagline: Fast offline-first expense tracker and budgeting app.
description: Poka stands out with an offline-first architecture that ensures instant transaction logging without network lag. Unlike traditional apps that lock data into cloud silos, Poka stores information locally by default, built on an open-source core (Poka CE). This Play Store release introduces an integrated AI assistant for smart expense parsing and financial insights, alongside multi-currency support, shared wallets, and optional encrypted cloud sync.

name: PlayaRutas
tagline: Public transit routing & trip planning in Riviera Maya
description: PlayaRutas is a hyper-local transit app and trip planner for Playa del Carmen and the Riviera Maya. It centralizes fragmented public transit routes, combis, and colectivos into an interactive map—helping residents, workers, and tourists navigate affordable local transportation seamlessly.

name: PixelThinks
tagline: Free online image compressor for JPG, PNG, and WebP
description: PixelThinks compresses JPG, PNG, and WebP images in your browser for free. Drop in an image, pick the quality, and download a smaller file. No signup needed.

name: Pipelane
tagline: Your whole creative workflow in one canvas
description: AI creative platform for teams with designers and creators. Clarify output intent, run multimodal pipelines, and keep a human in the loop.

name: Picser
tagline: Cull photos on your Mac with P and X — no import
description: Picser is a fast, native image viewer for Mac. 3.0 adds keyboard culling: P to pick, X to reject, filter to picks or hide rejects, then move every reject to the Trash in one step. No import, no catalog. Free to download; Pro is yearly or one-time.

name: PiViva
tagline: Coaching and Self-development that stays with you
description: PiViva is coaching that stays with you. Most of us leave a great session, course, or book fired up, then life gets busy, and the development stops. PiViva keeps it going with over 40 self-coaching tools, Viv (an AI companion who can read your tool input, or DISC, Insights or 360 reports and help you act on them), and a directory of vetted human coaches. Viv is the only AI you’ll meet here; every other voice is human. Free to start, Premium from £14.99 a month, built in the UK by a working coach.

name: PepCalculator by PepsTool
tagline: Peptides dosage calculator, protocols, calendar & reminders
description: Free PepCalculator simplifies peptide reconstitution and protocols tracking. Calculate reconstitution volumes, map multi-compound cycles onto a visual calendar, and receive scheduled dose alerts directly on WhatsApp. So no more questions how much should I draw? Or when should I take it? Built entirely privacy-first: no accounts, zero signups required, and all protocol data remains stored locally on your device. Fast, frictionless, and private.

name: Penny
tagline: Minimalist AI personal finance and expense tracker.
description: Penny (mypenny.net) is a minimalist AI personal finance and expense tracker by Yessine Ghariani. Log expenses by voice or receipt photo, set monthly budgets, and track savings goals. Free to start, Pro is a one-time $19.

name: PejavaDock
tagline: Many docks for macOS, snapped anywhere, with widgets
description: A native, free replacement for the macOS Dock. Put as many docks as you like on any edge of any display, snap them to corners and to each other, add widgets (disk, clock, weather), group apps like on iOS and sync your setup across Macs.

name: Peekl
tagline: Find out if AI recommends your local business, then fix it
description: Peekl asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the questions your customers ask (15 questions, 3 runs each, 135 answers) and shows whether you get named, which competitors get picked instead, and which sources the assistants rely on. You then get a ranked plan of up to 12 fixes, quick wins first, made for your business. Built for owners of local businesses: free check, $99 one-time audit, optional $39/mo tracking.

name: Pagehaus
tagline: Plain HTML hosting: upload, forms, templates, no build step
description: Pagehaus is hosting for plain HTML websites. Upload with SFTP or drag and drop in the browser, edit with a live preview, and your site is live: no Git, no build, no framework. Start from a free template, add a contact form that emails you with no code, share one header across pages with Server Side Includes, and use your own domain. Claude and other AI assistants can build and edit sites through its MCP server. Free plan; paid from $4/month.

name: Pact Pals
tagline: Make a fitness pact with friends and hatch pixel pets
description: Pact Pals turns daily steps into a co-op game. Make a pact with friends, reach your goals together, and hatch pixel pets. Built for people who struggle to stay motivated. Free Android app available now; iPhone coming soon.

name: Paani Peelo
tagline: A water reminder that walks onto your screen
description: Paani Peelo is a water reminder you can’t ignore. Amma walks onto your screen with a glass of water and waits — smiling, then pleading, then hands on hips — until you drink it. 7 characters, 4 languages, Mac and Windows. Pay once, yours for life.

name: Origin of Bots
tagline: All the Humanoids are avilable on this platform
