description: Parley Notes records your meetings on your phone, your computer or in the browser, and writes notes that fit the conversation: a sales call gets next steps, a lecture gets a study guide, a team meeting gets decisions and owners. No bot joins your call. Ask questions across everything you have discussed and find any meeting in seconds. Works in 12 languages on Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac and the web.

name: Paperwing
tagline: 33 free PDF tools that never upload your files
description: Most free PDF sites upload your files to their servers. Paperwing does everything inside your browser, so contracts, IDs and payslips never leave your device. 33 tools: merge, split, compress, PDF to/from Word, Excel, PowerPoint and JPG, OCR in 12 languages, sign, fill forms, AES-256 protect and true redaction. No sign-up, no watermark, no limits. Available in 12 languages with proper Arabic and Urdu support, plus a free ISO gap-assessment tool for 50+ standards.

name: P-urpose
tagline: Yoga class planning and sequencing tool for teachers
description: P-urpose is a yoga class planning and sequencing tool for yoga teachers. Choose a purpose (e.g. hip opening, back care), style, duration (30–90 min) and level, and it builds a complete, timed class from 126 curated poses: warm-up before effort, left and right balanced, a calm ending. Edit it, teach from your phone in Teacher Mode, save it, export a PDF. Rule-based sequencing, no generative AI. Free: 3 classes/month. Pro: €8.99/month or €69/year. English and German. Made by Ichii GmbH, Berlin.

name: Orka
tagline: Turn your notes into courses, quizzes and flashcards with AI
description: Orka is an AI-powered learning platform that turns your notes, PDFs, documents, and ideas into interactive courses, summaries, quizzes, and flashcards. Learn at your own pace, practice with AI, and make studying more effective. Built for learners everywhere, with a dedicated learning path for Morocco's Baccalauréat.

name: Open Lingo
tagline: Learn Korean, Japanese, French, and Spanish for free
description: Open Lingo - A free to use language learning app, teaching: Korean, Japanese, French, and Spanish My brother and I have been working on Open Lingo for a while, after deciding Duolingo did not offer good vocab & grammar practice, and was really expensive. We're a transit themed, SLA science (second-language acquisition) based language learning app. Our courses are authored with word frequency in mind so you can learn words you're likely to hear.

name: Offline Audio Tagger
tagline: Edit music tags and album artwork on your Android phone
description: Edit music tags and album artwork on Android. Save up to 20 tracks per free batch and check the result. Optional online name suggestions are reviewed before saving; audio stays on your device.

name: OVI-CODE
tagline: An extendable coding agent for your terminal.
description: OVI-CODE is a C++20 terminal application that connects to OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI/Grok. It can inspect a workspace, read and edit files, and show every model response, tool call, result, and diff in a full-screen interface. Built-in techniques are just the starting point. Native C++ plugins let you customize how the agent approaches a task, runs model/tool passes, and verifies its work without rebuilding OVI-CODE.

name: Not yet.
tagline: Beautiful countdowns, free widgets, and memories
description: Count down to trips, birthdays, and the days you can't wait for. Not yet turns each moment into a personal countdown with different faces and your own photos. Every widget and size is free, with no ads or account needed for local use. Save photos and notes while you wait, import dates from your calendar, set reminders, and share a countdown with friends. Available on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android. Optional Plus unlocks all faces and more cloud photo storage.

name: Nodezed
tagline: Deploy your cloud infrastructure in a single click.
description: Cloud infrastructure shouldn't be complicated. Nodezed brings servers, object storage, CDN, and DNS together in one developer-friendly platform. Deploy infrastructure in a few clicks, manage everything from one console, and keep control of your servers without the usual cloud complexity. Built for developers, indie hackers, and startups who want the power of cloud infrastructure without the steep learning curve.

name: NeverLackSMM
tagline: Social Media
description: Introducing **NeverLackSMM**, a next-generation SMM panel built for individuals, businesses, and resellers worldwide. Our platform offers a wide range of social media marketing services for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and more. With competitive pricing, a user-friendly dashboard, automated ordering, flexible payment options, API integration, and 24/7 customer support, NeverLackSMM delivers a faster, simpler, and more efficient experience for managing social media neverlacksmm.com

name: NeuroPathways
tagline: Care that works beyond the therapy session
description: NeuroPathways is launching a caregiver support platform that gives parents and families simple, practical strategies they can use in everyday situations. The app combines personalized support, goal-based guidance, and easy-to-understand tools designed to help caregivers feel more confident, less overwhelmed, and better supported between clinical sessions.

name: Net Pay Calculator
tagline: See your real take-home pay after federal and local taxes
description: Estimate your 2026 take-home pay after federal, state, local, and payroll taxes. Free paycheck calculator for all 50 states plus DC.

name: MyPetHQ
tagline: Book trusted pet sitters, walkers & groomers in one app
description: MyPetHQ connects pet owners with trusted local pet sitters, dog walkers, and groomers — all in one app. Unlike marketplaces that just list providers, MyPetHQ gives independent sitters and multi-person pet care businesses real tools: scheduling, invoicing, team management, waitlists, and secure in-app messaging. Clients get real-time updates and photo check-ins during every visit. Built for solo sitters and growing pet care businesses alike.

name: Mole Personal Safety Engine
tagline: An invisible AI bodyguard in your pocket.
description: Mole is an offline personal safety engine by Modach Technologies. Using 0 MB of data, it converts smartphone sensors into a security grid. Mole automatically detects device thefts via motion tracking and screams via acoustic analytics. Vocally confirmed emergencies instantly trigger an automated voice call to 112 and activate an offline Bluetooth tracking mesh showing nearby helpers landmark directions.

name: Meteor
tagline: The AI agent that finds jobs, tailors resumes, and applies
description: Meteor turns repetitive job applications into one connected workflow. Find roles that fit your profile, tailor your resume to each opportunity, apply through supported employer portals, and track submissions and responses. Built for students, recent graduates, international students, and professionals who want more time for networking and interviews. Start with a free plan.

name: Metapad AI
tagline: Model, simulate, query your enterprise — together, with AI
description: Metapad gives your people — and your AI — one shared context to work from: a living, computational knowledge graph of how your enterprise works. Model together in real time. Query, simulate and run scenarios: models that compute, not static diagrams. Every model has its own AI assistant and is accessible via MCP, so Claude and other assistants work from the same context as your team. Start from a template or let the AI build a first model from your documents. Free to try.

name: Merging Games
tagline: Find game mashups, creators and download status
description: Discover game mashups and crossover mods with original creator links, platforms and setup requirements. Status labels distinguish author downloads, showcases with unverified playability, and projects in development. Free to browse, with no account required. Merging Games is a directory, not an AI game generator.

name: MenuPlan AI
tagline: Weekly meals and a shared grocery list for your household
description: Save your recipes, plan lunches and dinners with your own rules, and turn the menu into a shared grocery list. MenuPlan AI is a free Android app in six languages. AI helps import written recipes, draft preparation steps and suggest shopping aisles. Try guest mode on one device, or sign in for household sharing and AI. Our website also includes a separate free weekly planner.

name: Memento
tagline: Encrypted notes, passwords & links. Only you hold the keys.
description: Memento is a privacy-first workspace for notes, passwords, bookmarks and AI prompts. Notes, vault items, prompts and attachments are encrypted on your device with XChaCha20-Poly1305 before they sync, so our servers never see that content in plaintext. One app instead of three: Markdown editor, credential vault and smart link previews. Free during public beta. Next up: Claude-powered semantic search, summaries and tag suggestions that run on client-decrypted content.

name: MeadHall
tagline: A Viking-inspired social network with RPG adventures
description: ⚔️ **Welcome to MeadHall!** MeadHall is a free Viking-inspired social network with a built-in fantasy RPG! 🌍 Create profiles, share posts, photos, and stories 💬 Chat, make friends, and connect worldwide ⚔️ Create characters, battle, and level up 🏰 Explore Valdyr, join clans, and complete adventures 💕 Build relationships and get married in-game 🚀 Still growing! Join our first members, explore the platform, and help shape its future! 🌐 https://meadhallonline.com

name: Manifold MCP
tagline: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent
description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

name: Majlis
tagline: Guest lists, seating and WhatsApp invitations for the majlis
description: Majlis is an event planner built for Gulf hospitality: Arabic-first, and made for how gatherings are actually hosted in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and across the region. Build the guest list, arrange the seating of the majlis itself, and send a designed invitation card straight to WhatsApp: Sadu weaving, a majlis arch, the eight-point star, or a plain card for condolences. Runs in Arabic, English, Urdu and Hindi, and the card can go out in any of the four, so it matches the guest, not the phone.

name: MITA? 見た？ — your anime watch log
tagline: Build for tracking your anime Wishlist
description: I'm building it as 「見た？」(MITA? — "Have you seen it?"), a Japanese-poster-styled watch log with cream paper, ink, and vermillion — manga panel borders, hanko stamps, halftone textures, and a nagging TV mascot named TV-kun whose entire job is asking "Hey… have you watched [anime] yet?" until you do.

name: Luniko Balloons
tagline: Pop balloons, rescue heroes & explore magical worlds
description: Luniko Balloons is a cozy, colourful balloon-popping adventure for iPhone and iPad! 🎈 Explore 60 Journey levels, rescue adorable animal heroes, discover Party adventures around the world and build your own magical Sky Kingdom. Enjoy relaxing gameplay, fun challenges, beautiful themes and different balloon styles. Created with love by a solo indie developer. ✨

name: Looking for a Genuine Connection,
tagline: Looking for a Genuine Connection, Not Just Chats ❤️
description: I’m tired of shallow conversations. I’d love to meet someone kind, honest, and fun. You can learn more about me on my website and reach out through the contact page.

name: LocalSheet
tagline: Free, private spreadsheets that work offline
description: LocalSheet is a free spreadsheet editor that keeps your files on your device. Create sheets or import CSV/XLSX files, edit and format cells, use formulas and dropdowns, and drag-select ranges for quick Sum, Average, Count, Min and Max. Export XLSX, CSV or PDF. Local autosave and offline support keep everyday spreadsheet work simple, with no account required.

name: Lean Upskill
tagline: Visual Stories on Business, UX, Growth, & Product Management
description: Lean Upskill provides short visual stories on Business, UX, Growth, and Product Management. The aim is to upskill busy professionals on the go. Stories can be accessed in user dashboard, and are also delivered to your inbox daily. 1) Choose a weekly ($1) or monthly plan ($3.5) All plans are pre-paid and do not auto-renew. INR plans @ ₹10/day, ₹65/week, ₹250/month. 2) Get one short visual story delivered to your email inbox every day. 3) Log in anytime to view all published stories in one place.

name: Lavvi
tagline: Never hold it in again.
description: Lavvi helps you find public washrooms and check their cleanliness and usability before you visit. Whether you're travelling, exploring a new city, or out for the day, Lavvi makes it easier to find a washroom when you need one. Our goal is to make access to public washrooms less stressful through community-powered information.

name: LaunchHere
tagline: Open Windows apps on the monitor whose taskbar you click
description: LaunchHere opens apps on the display whose taskbar icon you click. Free for Windows 10/11 (64-bit), with app exceptions, quick launching, and installer or portable downloads. No accounts or analytics. Internet is only used when you press Check for updates.

name: Later
tagline: Save it now. Find it later.
description: Later is a minimalist bookmark manager built around one simple idea: saving links is easy, finding them again should be too. With a clean interface, quick search, personal collections and a frictionless way to get started without an account, Later helps you keep useful links organized without the complexity of traditional productivity tools. Less clutter, fewer distractions, more time to focus on what matters.

name: LandmarkGuessr
tagline: Free Daily Landmark & Geography Guessing Game
description: Guess famous landmarks around the world in this free daily geography game. Test your knowledge, explore iconic places, and challenge friends online!

name: Kudos 3.0
tagline: The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back
description: Most money apps show you charts. Kudos does the work. Your home shows Your wins, one number for everything Kudos has earned or saved you, and your next best money move. Most people don't know their cards come with personalized offers they have to turn on by hand. Kudos activates them for you: about $800/yr in offers in early testing. Our AI also calls providers to lower your bills ($216/yr per negotiation) and cancels subscriptions you forgot ($247/yr each). You keep 100% of the savings.

name: Knocket
tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
description: Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

name: Kasane: 3-Year Photo Diary
tagline: One photo a day, stacked with last year. Temp included.
description: A private 3-year photo diary for iPhone. Add one photo a day; the day's high temperature and weather are attached automatically. See today stacked with the same date last year and the year before, and search your past by temperature when you can't decide what to wear. Import your camera roll once and last year fills in within minutes. Photos stay on your phone. No account. Free for 2 years of history; Pro is a one-time purchase.

name: Kaidn
tagline: Stop fake accounts before they cost you money
description: Fraudsters farm signup bonuses using Gmail dot tricks, plus tags, VPNs, and multi-account devices. Kaidn catches them in one API call. Send a signup, login, trial, or cashout and get back allow, review, or block with plain-English reasons. Rules decide, AI explains. Built for rewards sites, affiliates, games, and small fintechs that big fraud vendors ignore. SDK, REST, and MCP server included. Free for 10,000 events/month, no credit card required.

name: KATALOK.ID
tagline: Bisnis butuh katalok, katalok terbaik ada di katalok.id
description: Semua bisnis butuh katalog. Buat katalog digital interaktif dalam 5 menit untuk katering, bakery, toko kue, frozen food, hingga resto & kafe. Kirim link via WhatsApp atau scan QR, terima pesanan rapi tanpa potongan komisi. Coba demo gratis 14 hari! KATALOK.ID dapat menyambut pembeli dengan etalase elegan, mencatat dan merapikan antrean pesanan, dan menghitung laba usaha secara otomatis di balik layar. Anda nyaman, pelanggan Anda puas.

name: Jhalmuri.ai
tagline: Plain-language AI for Indian learners and local shops
description: Indian AI platform: learn AI in plain language (free, in English, Hindi and Bengali), plus free tools and done-for-you AI systems for local small businesses.

name: JDWIN AI
tagline: Find the investor's sixth sense
description: JDWIN System: A proprietary AI engine and economic decision-maker for projects and investments in Saudi Arabia and globally. It begins with your actual location and market rather than just an idea and delivers a single, clear decision backed by its sources.

name: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner
tagline: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents
description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

name: InMyEar
tagline: Your second opinion before you send.
description: Paste a conversation or upload screenshots for an AI second opinion on tone, effort, mixed signals, and what to say next. Try it free, or use Unpack This to explore the wider situation. Available on the web and iPhone.

name: Impossible Adware Remover
tagline: Find the hidden app behind pop-up ads on Android
description: Full-screen ads over your home screen, over WhatsApp or the moment you unlock come from an installed app, often one with no icon or hidden inside a QR scanner or cleaner that still works. Impossible catches it in the act: it records which app draws each pop-up, names it after about two, then opens Android's uninstall dialog. It also scans every app against signed adware definitions. Free to find, €4.99 once to reveal and remove. No subscription, no ads.

name: ImageCompressor
tagline: Compress images, then let your AI agent do it too
description: Compress, resize, convert and clean up images in your browser. Every tool is also a REST API, an SDK and an MCP server, so scripts and AI agents can use them. Scan a whole website and fix its heavy images. No ads. Free to start.

name: Image to Image
tagline: Refine photo edits in chat, then generate. No signup
description: Upload a photo and refine the same edit brief in chat before you generate. Choose the original or a completed version for the next edit, then compare and download the reviewed result. No account required. Chat uses no image credits; each generated image costs 1. One free trial edit per day, subject to capacity; one-time pack: $14.99 for 100 edits. Tab history clears on refresh. For adult creators; no face swaps or deepfakes.

name: Humanizely
tagline: Helping you build better foundations
description: Build professional academic papers, organize thesis chapters, and enhance your scholarly writing with Humanizely. Trusted by researchers and students for structure, formatting, and writing refinement.

name: HostAxe Terminal
tagline: Fast, reliable control of every server in any situation.
description: • Automated command scenarios — run complex workflows in one action • Multi-terminal orchestration — open, split and control multiple sessions instantly • Global & server-specific aliases for faster daily work • Built-in commands for tabs, splits, focus and scenario control • Local & remote CPU/RAM/Disk monitoring • SSH, CMD, notes and password tools in one workspace • Prebuilt workflows for debugging, recovery and critical situations

name: HideNStick Notes
tagline: Sticky notes that hide on your Windows screen edge
description: Most sticky notes cover your work. HideNStick Notes lives in a slim rail on the edge of your Windows screen instead. Hover a tab to write, pin notes over any app, then tuck everything away. Hide the rail completely and bump the edge twice (or press Ctrl+Alt+N) to bring it back. Grab text from any app with Ctrl+Alt+C and search every note with Ctrl+F. No account, no cloud, works fully offline. Early bird: 50% off at launch.

name: Hexis Cloud
tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

name: Heads or Tails - Flip The Coin For Me
tagline: The most satisfying 3D gold coin flip on the internet
description: Every coin flip site online looks like it was built in 2003. Flip The Coin For Me is different — a realistic gold coin tossed in true 3D with physics, sound, and haptics. Instant heads or tails result, true 50/50 randomness, sound, slow-motion replay, and customizable labels. No app needed. Works on any device. Features: Three.js physics arc Editable labels (Heads/Tails → anything, up to 10 chars) Light/dark mode, no signup, no ads Dedicated pages for Heads or Tails and Yes or No

name: HUNT
tagline: Job hunting is a second job. GoHunt does that one for you.
description: HUNT finds roles, handles the application forms and keeps track, so you can spend your time on interview prep and talking to people. Free to start.

name: HR Co-Pilot AI
tagline: AI-powered assistant for fast CV screening & interview prep
description: HR Co-Pilot AI is a privacy-first B2B web app for HR managers and recruiters. Screen CVs against job descriptions, generate tailored interview questions, and access salary benchmarks in seconds. It runs 100% client-side in your browser with no server data storage, zero monthly subscriptions, and BYOK (Bring Your Own OpenAI Key) privacy. Try demo version; https://earnest-pavlova-57fe94.netlify.app/ Gumroad link; https://gumroad.com/products/enham/edit

name: HOAFineCheck
tagline: Dispute and dismiss abusive HOA fines in 90 seconds
description: Over 82% of HOA fines violate state procedural laws. Instead of paying a $2,500 lawyer retainer for a $150 citation, HOAFineCheck analyzes your notice and generates litigation-grade statutory defense packages in 90 seconds. Features: • All 50 US states & DC statutes covered • USPS Certified Mail dispute brief • 3-min executive board hearing script • Mandatory books & records audit demand • Freezes fine accruals under state law • 7-day 100% money-back guarantee

name: GitHub
tagline: Create AI assistants tailored to your needs
description: GenesisAI is a platform for creating AI assistants tailored to your needs. Build AI-powered solutions, experiment with various use cases, and turn your ideas into practical tools. Our goal is to make working with AI more accessible, flexible, and useful for handling everyday tasks and bringing projects to life. We are building GenesisAI to help people move from ideas to real-world AI applications. We would love to hear your feedback and learn what you would like to create using our platform.

name: Gildframe Creative Studio
tagline: Premium AI-powered product imagery for brands that stand out
description: Gildframe Creative Studio creates premium AI-powered product imagery for skincare, beauty, fragrance and lifestyle brands. We deliver stunning, campaign-ready visuals without the expense of traditional photoshoots. From product launches to social media advertising, we help brands stand out with luxury-quality creative at accessible prices.

name: Gift Card
tagline: Gift Card
description: Give the perfect gift in seconds. Our digital gift cards are delivered instantly via email or WhatsApp, with no shipping and no waiting. Unlike traditional gift cards, you can personalize with a custom message, schedule delivery for any date, and let recipients choose from hundreds of brands in one place. Balances never expire, redeeming takes one tap, and payments are secure with local and international options. Perfect for birthdays, festivals, and last-minute surprises.

name: GenerujTo
tagline: 12 free browser-based generators and text tools, in Polish
description: 12 free generators in one place, with a Polish interface. Everything runs in your browser: no sign-up, and passwords, PINs, texts and QR data never leave your device. The font generator keeps Polish letters (ą, ć, ę, ł), the QR tool makes Wi-Fi, email and contact codes (PNG or SVG), and the color tool shows HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK and contrast checks. Also: password, PIN and number generators, team builder, random picker, character counter. Light and dark theme, mobile friendly.

name: GOROL IPTV Player
tagline: Android TV IPTV player with your own sources
description: GOROL IPTV Player is built for Android TV and TV boxes with remote controls. Connect your own Xtream Codes, Stalker Portal or M3U/M3U8 source. Includes live TV, EPG, provider-supported catch-up, VOD, series, radio, favorites, recording and multi-view. Choose Classic or GOROL 2026. One-time purchase, no app subscription. No channels, playlists or media content are included or sold. Content, EPG and catch-up depend on your source.

name: FunGameBuy
tagline: Safe marketplace for game accounts, items and currency
description: FunGameBuy is an international marketplace where gamers buy and sell game accounts, items and in-game currency. The buyer's payment is held by the site until they confirm they received what they paid for, and only then is the seller paid. Listing is free, the deal fee is 3%. Separate storefronts for English, Portuguese (Brazil), Indonesian and Russian-speaking buyers. Games include Genshin Impact, Standoff 2, World of Tanks Blitz and 80+ more.

name: Fromerica
tagline: Find US manufacturers and check US tariffs, free
description: US manufacturers: list your company, reach importers worldwide and find export markets. Importers: search US suppliers, request quotes and check HTS tariffs.

name: Focus Hotel
tagline: Block distractions and build a cozy pixel room by focusing
description: Focus Hotel turns focus time into a place. Start a session, block distracting apps, and every minute you stay focused earns Focusines to spend on furniture, outfits and new rooms in your isometric pixel hotel. Visit other people's rooms, focus side by side and chat Habbo-style. Finish a session and you're paid in full; give up and you earn nothing. No sign-up, no account, and the focus loop works offline. Free on iOS and Android.

name: Flominzo
tagline: Agentic payment OS: execution, ledger and reconciliation
description: Connect the systems you already use, run your payments, and reconcile every one against independent evidence. Flominzo runs six products on one shared financial core: remittance, payouts, business payments, bill payments, reconciliation, and agent-initiated payments. Start with the one your team needs today, and add the rest when you're ready.

name: FinBaze
tagline: AI bookkeeping that runs while you run the business
description: FinBaze is AI bookkeeping that runs in the background. Connect your bank, shop and payments, invoices get booked, matched and chased without you chasing them. File Dutch VAT (incl. OSS) and UK Making Tax Digital from live books, ask cash and VAT questions in ChatGPT, Claude or WhatsApp, and let your bookkeeper work in the same system. Built for freelancers, SMBs, e-commerce and practices in the Netherlands, UK and EU. 14-day free trial.

name: FastAF
tagline: Free, open-source voice workspace for Claude Code and Codex
description: FastAF runs all your Claude Code and Codex sessions in one window and lets you talk to them. A voice agent writes the prompt, sends it to the right terminal, waits for the agent to finish and reads the result back. Speech in and out runs on your machine (Whisper + Kokoro). See which agent is working, waiting or done, tile up to 9 in Multiview, and review diffs and PRs. Native Rust + Tauri, ~300 MB idle. Free and open source (Apache 2.0) for macOS, Windows and Linux.

name: FX Terminal
tagline: Free forex terminal with COT, sentiment, calendar & charts
description: FX Terminal is a free forex research terminal that runs in your browser. No download, no paywall, no signup needed to browse. It replaces the tabs forex traders juggle: live forex charts, economic calendar, currency strength meter, CFTC COT report analysis, retail sentiment, central bank monitor, interest rate differentials, bond yields, correlation matrix and a strategy backtester. 22 modules on one live feed, covering all 8 major currencies, 28 pairs, plus gold and silver.

name: ExpenseVoice - Personal Finance
tagline: Track expenses with AI, voice, receipts & insights
description: Meet ExpenseVoice, your AI-powered personal finance companion. Track expenses and income effortlessly using your voice, scanning receipts, or manual entry. ✨ Speak naturally to record transactions 📸 Scan receipts with AI 💰 Manage income and expenses 📊 Visualize spending with clear insights 🎯 Stay in control of your finances No complicated spreadsheets. No tedious data entry. Just a smarter, faster way to manage your money. Available on iOS and Android!

name: ExcaliClaw
tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
description: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams. Organize them in collections, search instantly, share by link or by name, and draw together in real time. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code create and edit diagrams for you. Generous free plan: 200 drawings and unlimited AI (MCP) use, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month. Version history, trash and backup export included. English, Español, Français.

name: Errandly — Your work. Handled.
tagline: A free, local-first AI agent that handles your Mac busywork
description: Errandly is a free AI agent for macOS that handles the busywork on your computer. Tell it what you need in plain English: sort a cluttered folder, pull key points from a long PDF, or turn scattered notes into a clean report. Files are handled locally by default, so your documents stay on your Mac. No subscription. Download it and hand it your first errand.

name: Educket
tagline: Any idea you keep nodding along to, explained in 5 min
description: Educket explains the ideas everyone keeps mentioning (AI agents, RAG, credit scores, unit economics) in about 5 minutes. Each lesson gives you one picture you won't forget and real cases to try the idea on, then asks you to explain it back in your own words, so you know you actually get it. 300+ lessons across AI, money, business and security, each designed and reviewed by people. Pro members can request any missing topic. Free to try with no sign-up. On iPhone today, Android next.

name: Dropstone CLI
tagline: The self-learning coding agent for your terminal
description: Dropstone CLI is a coding agent that learns from you. It reads your repo, edits across files, runs commands and tests, and checks its work before it says it's done. Correct it once and it keeps the lesson across sessions. Pick Fast, Pro, or Heavy models, plan before it builds, and set which commands run, ask first, or are blocked. Add skills, custom agents, parallel subagents, and MCP tools. Comment on a GitHub issue and it opens a pull request. On every plan, including Free.

name: Dhanur AI
tagline: AI employees for Indian businesses, priced in rupees
description: Dhanur AI makes AI employees for Indian businesses. They answer customers in Hindi, Hinglish or English from what you teach them: chat with it, or send a photo of your rate card.
