description: Meet SaaSHunt 🚀 — where SaaS innovation meets opportunity! We're building the ultimate launchpad for SaaS founders, makers, and early adopters. Discover groundbreaking products, launch your own SaaS, climb community-powered leaderboards, and raise funds to bring ambitious ideas to life. Think Product Hunt meets crowdfunding — a global ecosystem where innovative products don't just get discovered, they get funded. **Discover it. Launch it. Fund it. Hunt it.** 🚀

name: Revenue Scout
tagline: Find social media leads, with replies ready to review
description: Find people who need what you sell across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Revenue Scout checks buying intent and offer fit, filters weak matches, and prioritizes relevant opportunities. Choose a lead and get a reply grounded in the conversation and your business, ready to review, edit and post from your own account. Start free on Reddit, no credit card or connected social accounts required. Platform coverage varies by plan.

name: ReplyKaro
tagline: Instagram & Facebook auto-DM with flow builder and AI. $3/mo
description: ReplyKaro turns Instagram and Facebook comments into DMs automatically. Build visual flows with a drag-and-drop canvas, add follow-gates, lead capture, delays and AI replies, then broadcast to subscribers. Built on Meta's official API with built-in hourly send limits to keep your account safe. A cheaper ManyChat alternative: free plan with 1,000 DMs/month, paid from $3/month. Made for creators, coaches and shops.

name: Readnauts
tagline: Help your family build a reading habit that lasts
description: Readnauts helps families build lasting reading habits. Log books in seconds, celebrate every reader with age-aware points, take on reading challenges together, and preserve a personal library of everything you've read. Private, ad-free, and made for the whole family.

name: ReadFlow
tagline: Listen to PDFs & slides while taking voice notes
description: ReadFlow lets you listen to PDFs, slides, and documents aloud while taking notes just by talking. One tap switches between listening and note-taking, and everything stays in sync across devices. Built for people who learn better by ear and think out loud. Works fully in the browser.

name: ReachlyPro
tagline: Creative Review & Approval, Without The Chaos
description: ReachlyPro helps agencies, brands and marketing teams share creative work, collect contextual feedback, manage revisions and get the final work approved in one place.

name: ReSO AI
tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

name: Rankologist
tagline: Rate your games, discover what kind of gamer you are
description: Track and rate your games with honest ratings from players: no ads, no sponsored scores. What makes it different: as you rate, Rankologist builds your Gamer Personality, a gamer DNA with ten traits, an archetype and badges (some secret), illustrated by little tiermonsters. Plus tier lists you can export, Pick My Next Game for your backlog, and friends who recommend games to you. Free, in 4 languages, installable on your phone.

name: Rankdesk AI-Writer
tagline: Scale your SEO on autopilot (Rank in Google & ChatGPT)
description: Rankdesk is the first automated SEO tool that auto-writes and auto-publishes both articles & pages based on your niche, competitors, and what actually works today to rank on Google and get cited by ChatGPT. What makes us different? ✅ Write and publish both Articles & Pages on autopilot ✅ Local SEO optimization ✅ Convert articles into optimized Google Business Profile Posts ✅ Create articles and pages you need on the go ✅ Works for every site: from Custom to Shopify, from Webflow to WordPress.

name: Rank Kiwi
tagline: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube
description: Free Chrome extension for Instagram & YouTube content research. Compare creators, analyse Reels and Shorts, track engagement, and discover outlier content worth studying.

name: Random Bible Verse Generator
tagline: Discover fresh inspiration from the Bible—anytime, anywhere
description: This is a free online Bible tool that helps Christians discover daily inspiration through random scripture generation. Users can generate random Bible verses for prayer, meditation, and spiritual growth. The platform offers four core features a random verse generator for instant scripture discovery, a Bible verse image generator for creating shareable social media graphics a complete Bible browser for exploring all books and chapters daily devotional tools for consistent spiritual practice.

name: Ramen.lol — Misery Leaderboard
tagline: Where broke startup founders flex their losses
description: Everyone else brags about their MRR. Ramen.lol is the opposite — a leaderboard where broke startup founders compete on who's lost the most money, collected the most rejections, and eaten the most instant ramen along the way. Add your own misery story, vote, and see where you rank.

name: QueryFlow
tagline: A private SQL editor for big queries and CSV files
description: A free SQL editor that runs in your browser. Drop in a CSV or Excel file and query it with SQL, or paste a 1,000-line query to see how it joins, every hardcoded value and bugs that don't throw errors. BigQuery, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server. No login, no upload.

name: QuatMusıc
tagline: Audioplayer, Music
description: Thanks to this program, you can increase your music taste by using more features than many famous programs 😎🔥 No ads ⛔ No payment required ⛔ Just import the music from your device into the program and start using it 🐦‍🔥

name: PurpleCallio
tagline: Real-Time Audio & Video Infrastructure for Developers
description: Building real-time communication shouldn't require complex infrastructure. PurpleCallio helps developers integrate voice calls, video calls, and screen sharing into their applications using APIs, SDKs, and a hosted meeting experience. Test with the Playground, manage projects and API keys, and build communication experiences tailored to your users—all while focusing more on your product and less on communication infrastructure.

name: Prime Reviews Pro
tagline: Spot fake Amazon reviews in one click. Free, no account
description: Free browser extension that scores Amazon product reviews for fake-review patterns in one click, and says why each review was flagged. Nothing runs until you click; then it sends only the review text, product title and ASIN, never your cookies or login. Works on 22 Amazon marketplaces, in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. 10 checks a day free, no account.

name: Prime Inference
tagline: Fast, reliable serving for frontier open models
description: Prime Inference is Prime Intellect's serving platform for frontier open-source models, with serverless endpoints and reserved capacity across multiple datacenters on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. It's OpenAI compatible, fails over automatically between datacenters, and offers unified billing and team usage tracking. Its GLM-5.3 endpoint went live on OpenRouter on Sept 22 with a near-zero tool-call error rate and 100% uptime since launch, per Prime Intellect.

name: PocketWebTools for Mac
tagline: Local AI chat, transcription and video tools in one Mac app
description: PocketWebTools for Mac is one app that runs open models up to 35B parameters on your Apple Silicon Mac, with the tools built around them. Chat and summarize. Transcribe files, calls and system audio with speaker labels. Cut long videos into captioned vertical clips, or edit a video by deleting words from its transcript. Upscale photos at full resolution, turn PDFs and scans into text and read any text aloud. Your files and chats never leave your Mac. No account. $99 once, free lifetime updates.

name: Playable Ad Tester by Make It Playable
tagline: Find out why AppLovin, Meta or Unity would reject your ad.
description: Every ad network wants a playable ad built differently. AppLovin wants mraid.open(), Meta wants FbPlayableAd, Google needs exitapi.js, Mintegral needs ES5 and window.install(). Usually you find out from a rejection email. Drop in your HTML or ZIP and see, for 9 networks, what would fail and how to fix it. A live preview reports JavaScript errors and which exit your CTA fires. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded. Free, no signup.

name: PixRater
tagline: Cull and rate your photos faster
description: PixRater is a fast, 100% local photo culling tool. It groups RAW+JPEG pairs, auto-evaluates face sharpness, and uses private AI for keywording. Ratings save to EXIF/XMP metadata, and an integrated local MCP server lets you connect custom AI tools.

name: PepLookup: Peptide Supplier Directory
tagline: Compare research peptide suppliers by price per mg
description: A free directory comparing 80+ research peptide suppliers by price per mg, COA links, shipping, payment options and coupon codes. Includes a price checker, calculators and a COA reader. For research use only. PepLookup does not sell, test or certify products.

name: Payly
tagline: Free eCommerce store and hosting. No monthly fees.
description: A full ecommerce platform, completely free, hosted on your own free Cloudflare account. Build your store, take payments through your own PayPal or Stripe, and pay no monthly fee, no transaction fee and no commission.

name: Pawse
tagline: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks
description: Pawse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app. A cute 3D pet walks onto your screen to remind you to drink water, keep habits like stretching every 30 minutes, and take screen-time breaks, with an optional hard block.

name: ParkPulse
tagline: Remember where you parked. Get back before time runs out.
description: ParkPulse remembers where you parked. Save your location, a photo, and garage details; set a parking timer with expiry reminders, and keep remaining time in an iOS Live Activity. See the walking distance and directions back. On-device OCR captures signs and tickets, and the app works offline without an account, ads, trackers, or collected data. Free to download, with an optional one-time ParkPulse Plus unlock.

name: PacketBreaker
tagline: Build with friends, live on packetbreaker
description: PacketBreaker is an autonomous AI-powered code builder and software engineer. Founded by Adhyatm Shaswat and Kiyoto Studios. Not a network packet broker.

name: PMWallets
tagline: Find the Polymarket traders who actually make money
description: PMWallets ranks Polymarket traders, not addresses, by realised profit computed from the Polygon chain. Each profile shows win rate with a confidence interval, style and categories, and you can stream any trader's fills in about a second for copy trading.

name: Osade
tagline: Run all your coding agents together on real repositories
description: Osade is an open-source Agentic Development Environment (ADE) built around agents doing the work while you direct, review, and approve. Open a repo, chat with agents running in terminals, and delegate parallel tasks across isolated branches. Browse files, inspect diffs, run checks, and preview your app in one window. Osade verifies changes and asks for approval before anything leaves your machine. It runs locally and drives your existing agent CLIs,without shipping or reselling models.

name: OpenKline
tagline: Canvas candlestick charts for TypeScript, React and Vue
description: A free, MIT-licensed canvas library for OHLCV charts. The TypeScript core supports candlesticks, lines, indicators and drawing tools, with React and Vue adapters. Try the hosted playground with generated candles and an SMA overlay. Your application supplies market data and transport; this is not an exchange feed.

name: Onepin
tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

name: NoteStrata
tagline: Interactive sticky notes right on your desktop wallpaper
description: NoteStrata transforms your Windows desktop into a cleaner, more productive workspace. Unlike traditional sticky notes that use floating windows, NoteStrata integrates notes and to-do lists directly into your desktop wallpaper. Key features: • Desktop Click-to-Check: toggle tasks directly on your wallpaper • Modern Color Studio, glass styling & 10 fonts • Lightweight & fast: minimal system resource usage • Free to use

name: Notchzy
tagline: Interactive dynamic island for windows
description: Notchzy is a dynamic island which is highly interactive and useful specifically for windows PC and unlike other alternatives in the market its a very lightweight app hardly using any extra power on your PC.

name: Notchorious
tagline: Put your Mac’s notch to work
description: Notchorious turns your Mac’s notch into a customizable command center for the tools you use every day. Drop files, control your music, access clipboard history, take quick notes, manage reminders, check the weather, monitor your Mac, adjust system controls, and more. It stays out of the way until you need it and works on Macs with or without a notch, including external displays. Try everything free for 7 days, then unlock Notchorious with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

name: New Windows Search
tagline: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files
description: Microsoft is rebuilding Windows Search to help you do things, not just find them. The new experience is faster, cleaner, and lets you take action directly from the search box. Switch to dark mode, toggle Bluetooth, adjust brightness, mute your PC, or arrange windows simply by typing what you need. Built on WinUI 3 with improved search relevance, it's rolling out to Windows Insiders first, with richer previews and more actions on the way.

name: Nest Savings Challenge Tracker
tagline: Run a 52-week, 365-day, no-spend or custom savings challenge
description: Nest tracks 52-week, 365-day, no-spend and custom savings challenges, goals and your emergency fund. No account, no subscription. Try the free live demo.

name: Musical Links
tagline: Share your music with one link. No signup to listen.
description: Your music deserves to be heard—even before it’s a finished release. Musical Links lets you upload a song and share it with one link. Listeners press play without signing up or hearing ads. Get timestamped feedback, split tracks into stems, polish audio levels, and create cover artwork and QR posters. Add lyrics and chords so others can follow along. Free to use, and your music stays yours.

name: Museum of Models
tagline: Every answer 371 AI models gave to the same questions
description: Every new AI model since May 2024, asked the same 85 questions. All 15,639 answers kept as they came out, on a globe you can spin and open. Nothing is ranked.

name: Move Pro Logic
tagline: Turn video walkthroughs into moving quotes in minutes
description: Move Pro Logic lets moving companies quote without in-home visits. Customers record a quick video walkthrough of their home on any phone, and you get an itemized, priced quote under your own brand to review and send in minutes, with a payment link. Booked jobs flow into dispatch, crew clock-in, payroll, digital bills of lading and QuickBooks invoicing. Add a Get Estimate button to your website to capture leads 24/7. 7-day free trial, no card needed.

name: Mise
tagline: Procurement your team will actually use
description: Replace WhatsApp groups with restaurant purchasing software: chef approvals, purchase orders, OCR delivery checks and live inventory, request to delivery.

name: Microsoft-Decision-1
tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows
description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

name: Mewvori
tagline: A digital pet that grows with your real-life habits
description: Meet Mewvori, a digital pet companion that grows alongside your real-life habits. Your pet has its own daily rhythm, little discoveries, and memories to share. As you build healthy habits and care for your companion, your stories grow together. Coming soon to iOS and Android! 🐼🌱

name: Merakk
tagline: Merakk Hydrating Breath Spray Rose Limited Edition 10ml
description: Enjoy a refreshing floral experience with Merakk Hydrating Breath Spray – Rose (Limited Edition). This portable oral care spray offers a rose-flavoured alternative to traditional mint breath fresheners and is designed for convenient use throughout the day.Its compact 10ml format fits easily into a handbag, pocket or travel kit, making it a practical option when you want a quick refresh after meals, at work or while travelling.

name: Mep design course in dubai
tagline: Mep technician course
description: Engineering Design Dubai provides learning opportunities for students and professionals interested in building services engineering. Discover Mep training in dubai to build knowledge of MEP systems, design principles, and coordination practices. Mep design engineer and Mep certification course are relevant to learners looking to improve their technical understanding and develop skills for engineering and construction projects.

name: MeowStreets
tagline: A multiplayer crime RPG where every player is a street cat
description: MeowStreets is a free-to-play multiplayer crime RPG where every player is a street cat. Run crimes across three districts, train your stats, upgrade your hideout, join crews, pull off cooperative heists, and trade in a player-run market. Jobs and courses keep progressing while you're away, and the shared city keeps running between visits. Play in your browser on desktop or mobile, with no download required.

name: MatchRadar
tagline: Your CV, matched to each weekday's new jobs, with reasons
description: Upload your CV once. Every weekday at 08:30 MatchRadar e-mails the new job postings that fit it, each with the requirements you meet, the partial ones and the gaps. Europe and the US, from employers' own career sites. Never auto-applies. 7 days free, no card.

name: Markdown Preview
tagline: Client-side Markdown editor: private, local AI & TTS
description: Markdown Preview is a free, client-side Markdown editor and live preview. Your documents never leave the browser; open sensitive drafts without uploading them to a server. Edit with on-device AI (Write, Rewrite, Proofread in supported Chrome), listen with local text-to-speech and word highlighting, and share compressed links that still process entirely on the client. Also: Mermaid diagrams, GitHub alerts, Present/Slides modes, and an installable offline PWA.

name: Maildun for Mac
tagline: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP
description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

name: MXC
tagline: Cross-platform sandbox for running untrusted code
description: MXC (Microsoft eXecution Container) is a sandboxed code execution system from Microsoft for running untrusted code such as model output, plugins, and tools. It runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS, offering nine containment backends, from OS-native process sandboxes to full VMs, under one policy-driven filesystem, network, and UI control model. SDKs ship for Rust,NET, and Node.

name: MAWSI PMS
tagline: Manage your Business in a simpler way
description: Projects, tasks, revenue, payroll and budgets for freelancers, agencies and companies.

name: Lune
tagline: The search engine built for scientific AI agents
description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

name: Loopd
tagline: Find yard sales near you and hit them all in one loop
description: Loopd is a free yard sale finder built for Saturday mornings. Enter your ZIP, tap + on the sales you want, and Loopd lines them up into one efficient loop that brings you back home, then opens your maps app one stop at a time. Spotted a sale on a sign or in a Facebook group? Add the address and it joins your loop. Sellers post free in four quick steps, no account needed. Runs in your phone's browser, nothing to download.

name: Localoy AI
tagline: Ask for anything
description: An AI that works on your computer: research, designs, websites, apps and files. It shows every step and asks first. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.

name: Live Zero Path
tagline: Plan your finances, Freedom Date, and life goals
description: Live Zero Path helps households connect everyday money decisions with long-term life goals. Enter your own figures to track cash flow, budgets, assets and debts; estimate your Freedom Date; and explore a retirement spending path toward zero or a chosen legacy. Plan goals across Money, Family, Health, Learning, Dreams and Friends. Try the public calculators or fictional demo before signing up. No bank connection required.

name: Limit Tracker
tagline: Your AI limits, visible in the Windows tray
description: Track Claude, Codex, and Gemini CLI usage in the Windows tray. Per-account percentages and circular gauges show how close you are to your limits, without opening an app. Includes reset times, optional alerts, and light/dark themes. Free for Windows x64.

name: Letra
tagline: Copy the text your Mac won’t let you select
description: A link in a screen share. Code in a video. Text in a scanned PDF. Press ⇧⌘2, drag, and paste. Letra turns on-screen text into clipboard text, entirely on your Mac. Includes QR scanning, multilingual OCR, and searchable history. $5.99 once. No subscription.

name: Lenscribe
tagline: Make images searchable. Keep the text with the file.
description: Lenscribe saves extracted text inside your images. Search it with ripgrep (rg), ugrep (ug), The Silver Searcher (ag), grep, ack, or sift, then browse matches with fzf. Free and open source for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

name: Laser Bird Repeller
tagline: Laser Bird Repelle
description: Integrates linear laser, sound, ultrasound, and strobe functions for diverse bird repelling methods. Spatial freedom scanning design with multi-point positioning and scanning. High-decibel sound with 28 built-in audio files for random playback. Radar and sound pickup detect birds and actively trigger repelling. Timed triggering of the bird repelling function. Automatic light sensing for daytime operation and nighttime shutdown protection.

name: Landscape Plan
tagline: Plan outdoor spaces with AI from a photo
description: Landscape Plan helps you explore landscape design ideas using photos of your real outdoor space. Upload a yard, garden, patio, or other outdoor area, choose a space type and style, and generate different design directions with AI. You can describe what should stay, change, or be added, then compare the result with the original photo before moving on to real planning or renovation.

name: Labrix
tagline: Write research papers grounded in sources you can check
description: Labrix is a research workspace for academics. Search papers, build a library, and draft your manuscript section by section, where every citation points to a paper in your library that you can open and check. Run a plagiarism and writing-style check before you submit, format in 10,000+ citation styles, export to Word or to LaTeX for 450+ journals and conferences, and turn the paper into slides. Free plan, no credit card. Your work is never used to train AI models.

name: Kovi
tagline: a place for kids to learn AI
description: Help your child understand AI through short lessons and hands-on projects. Kovi is a calm AI learning space for ages 5 to 18.

name: Knola
tagline: Turn what you know into a video course. No camera needed.
description: Type what you know. Knola writes the lessons, builds the slides and narrates every video in an AI voice or your own. Then it makes the ebook, sales funnel, sales page and checkout. Nothing to record. Pay once, no monthly fee. Start free, no card.

name: Kitbar
tagline: Your dev tools, in one bar.
description: A thin bar on the edge of your screen shows how your Vercel deploys, GitHub checks, Stripe payments and Claude Code limits are doing. Point at a ring for the details and act from there. No account, no server; keys stay in your keychain. Mac and Windows.

name: KitParlor
tagline: Free browser tools, toys and daily games. No sign-up.
description: KitParlor is a parlor of small things that run entirely in your browser: image and fee tools for Etsy, Amazon and print-on-demand sellers, a daily set of four quick games with one shared streak, calming fidget toys, and makers like a marble race name picker and a rangoli designer. No account, no install, files never leave your device, and it all works on a phone.

name: KernelAI
tagline: 53 open models from 15 labs, running entirely on your phone
description: Run 50+ AI models locally on iPhone and Android. Chat, read PDFs and documents with on-device RAG, understand images with vision models, and write code offline. Dictate prompts, customize responses and import GGUF models (experimental). On iPhone, use Siri, Shortcuts and Apple's built-in AI on supported devices. Add optional web search with your own API key. Free, with no account, ads or subscription. Download a model once, then use it offline. Your local chats and documents stay on your device.

name: Kasaneru
tagline: Interview-ready stories for job hunting in Japan
description: Chat a few lines about your day at work, and Kasaneru shapes it into an interview-ready story (STAR and 4 more formats). Stack episodes up and export a resume in the structure Japanese employers expect — in English or Japanese. Private by design: no account, and your records stay on your device (iCloud sync is optional).

name: Kalorilaskuri - KaloriApp Suomi
tagline: KaloriApp: Kalorit, TDEE, makrot, vesi ja paasto tekoälyllä.
description: Helsingissä kehitetty KaloriApp on tietoturvallinen ruokapäiväkirja, jolla on yli 15 000 käyttäjää Suomessa. Mukana on tekoälykuvaus, viivakoodihaku, Fineli-tuotetiedot ja Terveys-sovellusten tuki. Sovellus noudattaa THL:n, sosiaali- ja terveysministeriön ja EFSAn ohjeistuksia.

name: JoBmania
tagline: Job openings in India that are still actually open
description: Most job boards compete on listing count. JoBmania removes listings instead. Openings are read from employers' own careers pages — never rewritten, never re-dated. Apply links are re-tested through the day, and a role that closes comes down rather than sitting there collecting applications nobody reads. 341 removals are published with their reasons, so the claim is checkable. Every apply link goes to the employer. No account, no fee, ever.

name: JAYLOW TRADES
tagline: Forex Traders
description: Learn, trade, and grow with proven forex strategies, mentorship, copy trading, and signals.

name: Isly
tagline: Your MacBook notch, brought to life.
description: Isly turns the MacBook notch into a living control center: music from any app with cover art and scrubber, live timers and calendar events, clean volume/brightness readouts, and more - all without leaving your workflow. Light on resources (≈0.2% CPU idle, ~49 MB RAM), smooth animations, and a one-time €3.99 license with free updates. For macOS 14+ with a notch.

name: If Systems Worked
tagline: A sourced record of lives lost when systems fail in India
description: Explore reported fatal incidents across India through an interactive map, calendar and source-linked records. If Systems Worked documents cases where failures in infrastructure, maintenance, preparedness, enforcement or public systems may have contributed. Filter by date, place and category, and follow the evidence behind each entry. Coverage is incomplete; reported failures are not legal findings.

name: ISKRIT Rebar Cutting Calculator
tagline: Free rebar cut lists with kerf and reusable offcuts
description: Plan rebar cutting from required lengths, quantities, stock sizes and saw kerf. ISKRIT generates cutting patterns and separates reusable offcuts from scrap. Review steel utilization, export cutting maps to Excel or print the plan. Custom stock lengths and multiple bar diameters are supported. The English calculator is free to use without signing up.

name: Hypervibe
tagline: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board
description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents side by side on an infinite board. Hypervibe brings real terminals, agent status, teams, voice control and live previews into one native Mac app. Use the agent accounts you already have. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

name: HyDeck
tagline: A pixel-art music deck for your Android phone
description: HyDeck turns your Android music player into a little pixel device. Retro looks (cyan LCD, red mixer, hi-fi), your own custom themes, and the phone's volume buttons move the volume bars. It's free, with optional theme packs: MIDAS (gold and marble) and GYM (workout tasks, a timer and levels while your music plays).

name: Hushly
tagline: Get anonymous questions from friends
description: Create a Hushly link, share it on Instagram or WhatsApp, receive anonymous questions, and post answers directly to your Story. Unlike older alternatives filled with fake, automated bot engagement, Hushly focuses on 100% real, user-driven interactions. It gives you a clean, seamless web experience to see what your friends truly think without annoying ad paywalls.

name: Hotel Lobby AI
tagline: Turn two photos into a viral AI duo music video
description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two photos into a short video of you and a friend performing the viral Hotel Lobby trend in the orange COLORS-style booth, following the original moves, camera cuts and song. No prompt, no green screen, no editing. Pick 5, 10 or 15 seconds and a model (Seedance or MiniMax H3), then download an MP4 for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. The same two-photo flow also makes the APT, Alors on Danse, Rumpelstiltskin and AI Zombie trends.

name: History Monk
tagline: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete
description: History Monk replaces your browser's history page. Type a few letters and the page you want shows up. Filter by site, day or hour, see where your time goes, and clear out the clutter. 100% local and private.

name: Hiragana Chart
tagline: All 46 hiragana characters, with stroke order and audio
description: A free chart of all 46 hiragana characters, with stroke order and audio.

name: HiddenWords — Emails with Hidden Insult
tagline: Hide insults inside perfectly professional emails.
description: Ever wanted to say what you really think in a work email without actually saying it? HiddenWords turns your thoughts into professional English emails with a secret twist: the first letters of each sentence spell a hidden insult. The challenge? Making the email sound completely natural. It's free to try, with 3 generations per day. Write your message, generate your email, and reveal the hidden word!

name: HeriBase
tagline: Identify, value, and organize your coin collection
description: HeriBase is an AI-powered companion for coin and banknote collectors. Take or upload photos to identify unfamiliar pieces, explore detailed reference information and estimated value ranges, then save them to organized collections. Track records, groups, and collection progress in one place—whether you are cataloging your first coin or managing a growing collection.

name: Herbie: Cat Games & Care
tagline: Games for your cat. Shared care for their humans.
description: Three games made for cats: Mouse Hunt, Bird Watching with real birdsong, and Goldfish Pond. Keep meals, water, litter and key dates together, share care through iCloud, and bring your cat to your Home Screen as PixelHerb. Free games and care for your first cat on iPhone and iPad. No ads or subscription. Optional one-time Herbie Pro adds more cats and Apple Watch.

name: HECKLE
tagline: Catch what your AI missed before you ship
description: Your AI says the app is done. HECKLE checks. Give it your running localhost and HECKLE clicks through your app like a real user, catching broken interactions, failed requests, and screens your coding agent missed. You get screenshots, reproduction steps, and evidence you can actually act on — before your users find the problems for you. Runs locally on your desktop. No test scripts. $7 once, no subscription..

name: Gym Bloc
tagline: A simple, ad-free workout tracker for Android
description: Gym Bloc was built around one idea: workout tracking should be simple. Create your routines, organize your training days, add exercises and track your weight, reps and rest time. You can also follow your progress over time without dealing with unnecessary features or distracting ads. 🏋️ Create custom workout routines 📊 Track your progress 📝 Log weight, reps and rest 🚫 No ads 💰 Free to download ⭐ Full PRO access for a one-time payment of around $1 🔁 No subscriptions Available now for Android.

name: Grupyx
tagline: Meet new people, group to group, in real life
description: Grupyx helps groups meet other nearby groups and make same-day plans. Create a plan with friends, discover nearby groups, match, chat and meet in person. Grupyx runs daily from 12 p.m. to 2 a.m., when plans, matches and chats reset. From coffee and sports to concerts and nights out, the goal is simple: less planning, more time together. Grupyx launches first in Madrid, then will progressively expand to more cities across Spain and around the world.

name: GreySpace
tagline: Big files between iPhone, Android, Mac & PC, no internet
description: Send photos, videos and files between iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows, straight over Wi-Fi. No internet, no cloud, up to 1 GB in 9 seconds. App to app, every file is checked before it appears, and transfers resume after a drop. Free to receive.

name: GoCamo
tagline: Anti-detect browser built for webscraping & AI agents.
description: GoCamo is a privacy-first antidetect browser. Run unlimited isolated browser profiles, each with its own fingerprint, proxy and hardware identity. For Windows & macOS.

name: Global AC Guide
tagline: Size your AC, estimate costs, check installation fit
description: Global AC Guide brings three free cooling tools together: estimate room AC capacity in BTU, calculate running costs using your own electricity tariff, and find an AC type that fits your room, windows, and installation permissions. See the assumptions behind each result, then explore practical buying and troubleshooting guides. Built for renters and homeowners planning room cooling.

name: Giveaway Alert: $50 Gift Card for Grabs
tagline: Giveaway Alert: $50 Gift Card Up for Grabs
description: Enter before the deadline for a chance to win. No purchase needed, and results will be shared openly on our channel.

name: GitGlow
tagline: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship
description: GitGlow brings precise staging, clear history, and a checkout-aware terminal into one local Git workspace. Pro adds review marks and checks that become stale after edits, plus managed agent and release tools. Free for private local clones; no account needed.

name: FuelBar for Mac and Windows
tagline: Every AI coding limit, on the edge of your screen.
description: FuelBar sits on the edge of your screen and shows how much of your Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Freebuff and Antigravity limits you’ve used. It warns you at 80% and says when a session finishes. No account needed. Pay once for Mac and Windows.

name: Follow Competitors
tagline: Track competitor prices, reviews and listing changes
description: WATCH — Follow Competitors helps businesses automatically monitor competitor websites and listings. Track changes in prices, ratings, reviews, availability, titles, content and images from one dashboard. WATCH creates daily snapshots and a chronological timeline showing what changed, when it changed, and the previous and new values. Each listing receives a dynamic score, helping businesses identify important activity, respond faster and make better data-driven decisions.

name: Fluence
tagline: Listen to your documents. Nothing leaves your phone
description: Fluence. reads your PDFs, EPUBs, Word, OpenDocument, Rich Text and Markdown files aloud — in a natural voice that ships inside the app, in 31 languages, with nothing to download first. Follow the highlighted text as it plays, ask the document a question and get an answer drawn from its own passages, or record your own voice and have it read back to you. No account, no server, no subscription: one payment, and it works offline for good.

name: FitAI Coach
tagline: Your AI-powered fitness, nutrition and health coach
description: FitAI Coach is an AI-powered fitness and wellness platform that brings personalized workouts, advanced activity tracking, nutrition, AI meal scanning, personalized recipes and progress insights into one intelligent experience. It helps users train smarter, understand their health data and stay consistent with personalized AI guidance. Launching on iOS.

name: Firefox 157
tagline: A brand new Firefox is here
description: Say hello to a refreshed design and more ways to make it feel like home. Your bookmarks, extensions, and shortcuts are right where you left them.

name: FatePreview
tagline: Explore your options before a big life decision.
description: FatePreview is a deterministic decision comparison tool using fixed planning rules that helps you explore possible paths around a real-life choice, compare trade-offs and constraints, and identify practical next steps. It is designed to support reflection and planning rather than predict your future.

name: Fate & Stars
tagline: Free AI tarot readings online — yes/no, love & daily spreads
description: Fate & Stars offers free AI-powered tarot readings online. Ask any question and get instant yes/no answers, love and relationship spreads, daily guidance, and detailed meanings for all 78 tarot cards. The free plan includes daily readings; Unlimited ($4.99/month) unlocks unlimited readings with follow-ups and clarifications.

name: Exam Questions
tagline: Practice A Level exams with AI-generated questions
description: Prepare for Cambridge A Level exams with AI-powered questions, past papers, syllabus topics, practice and personalized exam preparation across 10 A Level subjects.

name: Enter to Win a $50 Gift Card
tagline: Enter to Win a $50 Gift Card (No Purchase Needed)
description: Entering takes about a minute. One winner receives a $50 gift card, chosen fairly at random.

name: DroidPass Password Manager
tagline: Passwords, passkeys and 2FA codes, offline first
description: DroidPass keeps passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, cards and Wi-Fi keys in an AES-256 vault that opens offline. Move in directly from Apple Passwords, Dashlane or 1Password - no exported file sitting in your Downloads folder. Free tier, no ads, no tracking.

name: Drobber
tagline: Feedback without the chaos.
description: Great work deserves better than vague feedback. Born from years of client frustration, Drobber makes it easy to capture comments, see what needs changing and keep everyone on the same page. Clients can show you what they mean, and you can get straight to fixing it. Less chasing. Less guessing. More time creating.

name: DoomSaver
tagline: Your Doomscrolling has a witness
description: Doom Saver helps you cut back on doomscrolling without quitting social media. A live timer sits on top of the apps you choose, so you always know how long you've been scrolling. Add the tasks you keep meaning to do like reading a book or call back mum, and it reminds you of them while you're in the apps. Stats show your time, opens and busiest hours by app, so you can see where your evenings go. It never sees your screen, and your usage stays on your phone. Free on Android.

name: Donor Ready homepage
tagline: Donor Ready builds websites that make giving simple.
description: Giving should take a few taps, not a hunt through your site. A Give button on every page Supporters see how to donate whether they land on your homepage, an event page, or a story. A form that fits on a phone Large tap targets and only the fields you need, so giving stays quick. A thank-you that closes the loop Every gift ends with a clear confirmation and a receipt donors can keep.

name: DiscreteDocs
tagline: 30+ private PDF tools that run entirely in your browser
description: DiscreteDocs is 30+ free PDF tools that run entirely in your browser. Compress to an exact size, convert to and from Word, Excel and PowerPoint, merge, split, sign, edit, OCR and truly redact. Your files never leave your device: no upload, no sign-up, no watermark. Load the page, switch on airplane mode, and it still works.

name: Dimmy.app
tagline: Turn your voice into a superpower! On your terms.
description: Dimmy is an open-source voice app for macOS and Windows. Dictate clean text into any app with local Whisper, rewrite text by voice, and turn meetings into structured recaps. Bring your own AI (Claude, OpenAI, GEmini, your ChatGPT/Claude sub, or a local model). Free from source.

name: Digi Karya
tagline: Connecting a universe of contractors
description: Digi Karya is contractor management software for India: a document vault with licence and GST expiry reminders, tender workspace, contract milestone billing, EMD & bank guarantee tracking, free contractor calculators, and a website and verified certificate for your business.

name: Decima Farm
tagline: Farm management software for every herd, flock and field
description: Decima Farm is farm management software for dairy, poultry, livestock, pig, fish, crop, bee and meat processing businesses. Staff log work from a phone in the shed, even offline. Owners see milk per cow, FCR, mortality, stock and profit live, and problems reach the right person on WhatsApp. Units, currency, tax and compliance reports switch per country. Priced per farm, not per user. Try the live demo with your own farm name in 20 seconds.

name: DealsDekho
tagline: Catch fake sale discounts on Amazon, Flipkart & Myntra
description: Indian sales are full of fake discounts: the MRP gets inflated so "90% off" looks huge, but the price is the same as last month. DealsDekho checks every product against its real price history across Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra and tells you if a deal is genuine, normal or fake. Search all three stores at once or paste any product link, see the lowest-ever price and your price after bank offers, and get alerts when it really drops. Free, no sign-up.

name: Daily9
tagline: Daily 9: one nine-hole golf course a day, same for everyone
description: Every day at midnight there’s a new nine-hole course, and everyone plays the same holes, pins and wind. Your first round counts. Takes about 5–10 minutes in your browser, no download. Share your emoji scorecard and see how you stack up.

name: DMLY
tagline: All-in-one customer engagement for local businesses.
description: DMly is an all-in-one customer engagement and business automation platform for local and service businesses. Manage WhatsApp and other messaging channels from one inbox, automate conversations with AI, send broadcasts, take bookings, collect payments, manage customers and generate reviews, all from one platform.

name: Cue
tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

name: Crypto ETF List
tagline: Find and compare crypto ETFs in your region!
description: Explore Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin exchange-traded products available in your region. Search and compare by asset, fees, AUM, strategy and issuer.

name: ContextDock
tagline: Auto-save your tabs. Restore them in one click
description: You close your laptop on 14 tabs. Tomorrow, you can't remember which one mattered. ContextDock is a Chrome extension that auto-saves every window the moment you close it. No button, no form. Copy your sessions, paste them into the dashboard, and restore any workspace in one click. Not a bookmark folder. An undo button for closing your laptop. Your data stays in your browser. Free to start. Built by a student tired of rebuilding yesterday.

name: Cohearo
tagline: Private meeting transcription, without bots joining calls
description: Cohearo transcribes meetings on your device, with no bots joining your calls. Audio stays on your device, and transcription and speaker identification run locally. Use cloud AI templates to turn transcripts into useful notes, and connect synced transcripts to your AI workflows through MCP. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux, with Android and iOS in early access.

name: Codex Window Colors
tagline: Tell your Codex windows apart with colors
description: Give each Codex Desktop window a color that follows its chat or project. Pick your own colors or use stable automatic ones, then adjust the edge thickness, fade, and opacity. A local macOS utility that runs through Hammerspoon. Requires Hammerspoon, Python 3, and Accessibility permission.

name: ClipQR
tagline: One click. Clipboard to QR. Fully offline.
description: A privacy-first Chrome extension that turns anything in your clipboard into a QR code in under a second. The extension is fully offline — no upload, no accounts. Open source, MV3, 8 languages.

name: CleanMyApple
tagline: Free up your Mac. Remove the clutter. Keep what matters.
description: CleanMyApple is a simple macOS cleanup utility that helps you reclaim storage without digging through folders manually. Find and remove junk files, app leftovers, duplicate files, large files, and unwanted apps — all from one clean, easy-to-use interface. See what’s taking up space for free, then clean your Mac when you're ready.

name: Claude Dashboards & Motion
tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers
description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

name: Clarity-Log
tagline: Document interactions. Organise records. Find clarity.
description: Clarity Log helps you document important interactions and keep your records organised in one secure place. Create dated entries, build clear timelines and attach supporting information such as screenshots, photos and documents. Whether you're navigating co-parenting challenges, workplace disagreements, tenancy issues or other difficult situations, Clarity Log helps you keep track of what happened and when. Less confusion. Better organisation. Clarity when it matters.

name: CYRKEY
tagline: Russian & Ukrainian phonetic keyboard for macOS and Windows
description: CYRKEY is a phonetic keyboard for typing Russian and Ukrainian on the physical keyboard you already know. It supports DE · QWERTZ, EN · QWERTY and FR · AZERTY on macOS and Windows, so you can type Cyrillic without relearning a completely different layout. CYRKEY includes Russian and Ukrainian profiles, keyboard-lock features, a 7-day trial and a one-time purchase with no subscription.

name: CY Calculator
tagline: Calculate Cubic Yards. Estimate Materials. Build Smarter.
description: Free cubic yard calculator. Find cubic yards from length, width and depth for any shape, in feet, inches, yards or metric, with formulas and examples.

name: Buffer
tagline: Search everything you copy, even text inside screenshots
description: Buffer 3.0 is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS. Everything you copy — text, links, images — is saved to a searchable local history, one ⇧⌘V away. It reads text inside screenshots with on-device Vision OCR, lets you edit any saved snippet inline, and organizes clips with tags, bookmarks, and multi-select paste. v3.0 adds an interactive image canvas, history tiers up to unlimited, and clipboard noise suppression. MIT-licensed. No accounts, no cloud — everything stays on your Mac.

name: BookmarkForge
tagline: Searching for privacy in a world full of banners.
description: Raindrop keeps your bookmarks on its servers. BookmarkForge keeps them on your computer — locked so not even we can read them. 59 dollars once. Free: 2,500 bookmarks.

name: Biya Upscale
tagline: Free, local 2×/4× AI upscaling for Windows
description: Free portable Windows app for 2×/4× AI upscaling of PNG, JPEG and WebP. Model download needs internet; inference then runs locally. Verified only: Windows 11 + NVIDIA RTX 2050 (DirectML). Executable is unsigned. AI may alter detail and distort small text; not for faithful document/screenshot enlargement. Free and open source. Sample image: Cleveland Mountain Landscape by Lenny K Photography, CC BY 2.0 (https://www.flickr.com/photos/57527070@N06/24007709514).

name: Big Prize Giveaway: Win a $70 Gift Card
tagline: Big Prize Giveaway: Win a $70 Gift Card
description: Our biggest giveaway yet. Enter for a chance to win $70, with a fair random draw and public results.

name: BeatName
tagline: AI band & music producer name generator
description: BeatName is a free AI-powered generator for music producers, beatmakers, DJs, and bands. Generate creative artist monikers, producer tags, and rap aliases by genre, style, and mood. Get instant inspiration and find the perfect stage name for your music projects at https://beatname.com/.

name: Beadsvenue
tagline: Swarovski Pearl 5810 – 12 mm Dark Lapis
description: product price :- A$12.93 Description :- Shop Swarovski Pearl 5810 in 12 mm Dark Lapis at BeadsVenue. Explore elegant round pearls for handmade necklaces, bracelets, earrings and jewellery-making projects.

name: Bapum
tagline: Tactile-only stress relief. No screen. No noise. Just calm.
description: The Bapum method supports the regulation of your nervous system and your emotions through a gentle physical heartbeat. The heartbeat is felt on the skin, so it needs no screen, no sound and no attention. While most apps tax your attention and mind, Bapum communicates directly with your body. You don't need to learn new techniques or actively concentrate, just feeling the rhythm is enough. No ads, no registration, no personal data collected. The Bapum method stays free, always.

name: Baby Desk
tagline: Let your baby smash the keyboard and your work stays safe
description: Baby Desk turns your Mac into a full-screen baby playground that absorbs keys and clicks, including ⌘Q and ⌘Tab, while your work stays untouched. Stars, letters, and balloons keep little hands busy. Launch offer: $1.99 (regularly $4.99). macOS 13+.

name: BMI Calculator
tagline: Free BMI calculator with CDC category and healthy range
description: Utilvance BMI Calculator works in metric and imperial units. Enter weight and height in kg and cm, meters, or pounds, feet and inches. You get your BMI, its CDC category and the weight range that fits your height. It is free and runs in your browser. The page is mobile friendly. Utilvance also offers free calculators and converters for health, finance and daily math.

name: Augustin
tagline: Your whole net worth in one number, no bank login
description: Augustin adds up your accounts, investments, home and loans into one number, kept up to date in more than 160 currencies, without ever connecting to your bank. Type your balances or import a statement, read on your iPhone. See your runway: how many months your savings would cover, with a milestone to celebrate at each step. Share a household of up to six people, or your wins with friends, never an amount. No ads, no data sold, encrypted before it leaves your phone.

name: Attendance Tracker: Check In
tagline: Take attendance in one tap, hand in the report
description: Attendance Tracker is for anyone who takes roll: teachers, coaches, club and church leaders, daycare, small teams. Everyone starts present and you tap only the exceptions (absent, late, excused). The app keeps per-person totals and the full register, and exports a PDF report or CSV whenever the office or league asks. Everything stays on the phone: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Launch offer: Lifetime Pro is free through Saturday.

name: ArcPad
tagline: A faster, cleaner Launchpad for your Mac
description: Meet ArcPad, a lightweight app launcher for macOS with a familiar twist. Your apps are arranged in a beautiful circular layout inspired by Apple Watch, making browsing feel natural and playful. Search when you need something fast, or explore visually. No accounts. No clutter. No tracking. Just a small, focused Mac app built to launch your apps beautifully.

name: Appmint
tagline: Your business, staffed by AI. It does the work.
description: Appmint is a business platform run by AI. CRM, storefront, bookings, payments and support are already built, and AI agents operate them: they answer the phone, take deposits, chase no-shows and move a job from order to invoice. Every channel writes to one customer record. One bill replaces a stack of subscriptions, with AI credits in every plan. When you need something it doesn't have, Appmint builds it from a plain-English description. Free plan to start.

name: AgentFOXXY
tagline: for coding,browser automation, parallel sub agent workflows.
description: AgentFOXXY is an open-source AI agent for coding, browser automation, computer use, and parallel sub-agent workflows. - UsmanAbid751/AgentFOXXY

name: AgentDock
tagline: Answer Claude Code & Codex from one Inbox, in any terminal
description: AgentDock keeps Claude Code, Codex and your other coding agents on the edge of your Mac's screen. See who's working, answer every question and permission prompt from one Inbox with a keystroke (typed straight into cmux, tmux, iTerm, WezTerm, kitty or herdr), and message any agent from any app with ⌥⌥. Finished work gets a recap, written on your Mac. No account; nothing leaves your Mac. $19 once, after a 7-day free trial.

name: AeroSender A1
tagline: Phone photos to Windows over Wi-Fi, without a phone app
description: Need phone photos on your Windows PC without finding a cable or uploading them to the cloud? AeroSender A1 transfers photos, videos and files from iPhone or Android over local Wi-Fi. Open the PC app, scan its QR code and choose files in your phone's browser—no extra phone app. Incoming files can save automatically to your chosen folder. Both devices need the same Wi-Fi and the PC app running. Seven-day full trial, then a one-time purchase. Speed depends on your network and devices.

name: AdsNotch
tagline: Turn your Mac’s screen into ad space and earn money
description: AdsNotch is a native macOS app that shows ads in a small, unobtrusive screen notch and shares the advertising revenue with you. Ads can seamlessly expand when relevant events happen, then disappear when you're done.

name: AVENALO
tagline: Tu bienestar en un solo lugar
description: Recetas, movimiento, hidratación, ayuno y buenos hábitos. Gratis, sin registro y con tus datos personales guardados únicamente en tu dispositivo.

name: AI Job Search Prompt Kit: 41 Prompts
tagline: AI prompts, ChatGPT prompts, resume, cover letter
description: If you've been laid off or you're job hunting while working, time is tight. I made an AI Job Search Prompt Kit to speed up the repetitive parts: 📄 Rewrite resume bullets with real results ✉️ Draft follow-up and thank-you emails 🎤 Run a mock interview with feedback 💰 Prepare a salary negotiation email 41 prompts in a PDF plus an Excel library you can search and copy from. Works with the AI tools you already use.

name: AI Hub Companion
tagline: Plan approved AI work across computers you control
description: AI Hub Companion is a free Windows app for connecting supported official AI clients and planning approved work across compatible computers you control. Provider usage, hosted service subscriptions and fleet setup are separate. A draft plan does not authorize execution. This listing covers the Microsoft Store companion; hosted AI Hub services have their own availability and terms.

name: AI Cite Who
tagline: Understand why AI recommends competitors and what to improve
description: Understand why AI answers recommend competitors. Inspect buyer-question results, cited sources and competitor evidence, then get a prioritized plan for what to improve on your website and across third-party channels. Start with a free website analysis; AI-answer audits are paid and use selected ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity search configurations.

name: 宿検索マップ（ホテル横断検索）
tagline: 【完全無料・サーバーレス】AWS Lambda ＋ FastAPI で作る「お出かけホテル検索マップ」の手順
description: 地図上で中心地を選ぶと、その周辺にあるホテルを自動で検索して一覧・マップ表示してくれるアプリです。 フロントエンド: HTML / JavaScript （Google Mapsをインタラクティブに操作） バックエンド: Python 3.11 ＋ FastAPI インフラ（ホスティング）: AWS Lambda（関数URL）＋ Mangum 外部API: SerpAPI（Google Hotels） 「サーバーレス」構成にすることで、アクセスがないときの維持費は完全0円。個人開発のサービス公開やポートフォリオにぴったりの構成です。

name: statjolt.com
tagline: A cookie-free Google Analytics alternative, hosted in the EU
description: StatJolt is a cookie-free web analytics tool built for the EU. No cookie banner, no personal data, full GDPR compliance by design. One dashboard shows visitors, sources and pages, plus funnels, Core Web Vitals and JavaScript error tracking, all included. The script is about 15 KB, a third the size of Google Analytics, so it does not slow your site down. Servers run in Germany and Finland only. Free until 2027, at any traffic volume, no credit card needed.

name: nodeXML
tagline: Turn one product feed into multiple synced marketplace feeds
description: NodeXML helps ecommerce stores, agencies and developers edit, transform and automatically sync XML product feeds. Import one source feed, map fields, apply rules and publish permanent auto-updating feed URLs. It also includes a free browser-based XML editor for quick XML changes without creating an account. Paid workspaces cost €9/month and are designed as a simpler, more affordable option for teams that need product feed automation without the complexity of larger enterprise platforms.

name: nchova
tagline: Private dictation and meeting notes, all on your Mac
description: Hold Fn, speak, and nchova types in any app: Slack, Notion, Mail, the terminal. Speech recognition runs on your Mac, even offline, and the audio never leaves it. It also transcribes your calls on Zoom, Meet, Teams or Slack with no bot in the call, tells the voices apart and writes the notes when the call ends: with Apple's model, Qwen on your Mac, or your own Claude Code or Codex. Free forever with Apple's models. Pro is €29.99 once, no subscription.

name: iwant
tagline: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command
description: Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

name: agent-identity-mcp
tagline: MCP server giving AI agents a real phone + email identity
description: agent-identity-mcp is an MCP server that gives any AI agent a real phone number and a real disposable email inbox — so it can sign up for things, pass phone/email verification, and receive OTP codes, through standard MCP tool calls. It bundles sms-florin (real UK SIM numbers) and receivemail.dev (disposable inboxes) behind one interface. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client; install via npm, or use the hosted endpoint with no infrastructure to run yourself.

name: ZetaWallet
tagline: Non-custodial crypto wallet & 500+ token swaps (NO KYC)
description: ZetaWallet is a fast, non-custodial crypto wallet built for complete privacy and self-sovereignty. Key Features: • True Self-Custody: You hold your keys, full ownership. • 500+ Token Swaps: Fast, seamless mobile swaps. • Zero KYC & Anonymous: No email registration, no accounts, and no personal data required. Take back control of your crypto assets on Android. Try it out and share your feedback!

name: Zernio
tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

name: ZeoSign
tagline: Online Document Signing, E-Signature
description: ZeoSign is an online document signing software designed to help businesses securely sign, send, and manage documents digitally. As electronic signature software and a complete document signing platform, ZeoSign simplifies contracts, agreements, approvals, and other business workflows. Its secure online document signing capabilities make it a practical e signature software for businesses looking to reduce paperwork and streamline digital signing processes.

name: Yuqelo
tagline: Powerful free tools for everyday tasks
description: Yuqelo brings useful online tools together in one simple place. Compress images, format JSON, calculate age, count words, work with PDFs, and more. Everything is free to use with no signup required.

name: Your Local Work Assistant
tagline: Local Windows office tools. Cloud AI when you want it.
description: A practical Windows assistant for working with Excel and CSV, documents, PDFs, files and folders directly on your computer. Core office tools work locally. When extra AI help is useful, connect your own OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude API key. English and Russian commands are supported. The ready-to-use version is €59 as a one-time purchase, with optional customization for business workflows.

name: YesGarage
tagline: Connecting drivers, workshops, dealers and fleets
description: YesGarage connects vehicle owners, workshops, dealers and fleets in one platform. Owners track maintenance, fuel, costs and documents, while workshops receive temporary, owner-approved access and send completed work back to the vehicle’s history. Dealers manage stock and ownership transfers; fleets track driver shifts and vehicle activity. YesAI helps read receipts and documents. The personal garage is free for up to five vehicles.

name: World Friends
tagline: Meet The People Around the World
description: Enjoy a simple and modern messaging experience designed to make conversations easy and enjoyable. Create your account, connect with others, and start chatting in a clean and user-friendly environment. Features: 💬 Real-Time Messaging Send and receive messages quickly and keep your conversations flowing. 👤 Personal Account Create your own account and manage your profile in one place. 🔐 Secure Sign-In Use secure authentication to access your account and keep your conversations connected to you.

name: WinStacks
tagline: Organize your Windows desktop into smart stacks
description: WinStacks keeps your Windows desktop organized by automatically grouping files into clean, accessible stacks. Organize apps, games, documents, images, videos and more while keeping everything right on your desktop. Customize how stacks look and behave, drag files naturally, and collapse everything when you want a clean workspace. Free to use, with optional Pro features for advanced customization.
