Its 1.5B model, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct, runs on your Mac and writes a search plan; a read-only sandbox runs it, so your files are never uploaded. It searches names, contents, PDFs and Word documents. macOS 15, Apple silicon, 16 GB. 30 free searches, then 9 USD a month or 59 USD a year.

name: Shelf
tagline: From screen to agent in two keystrokes
description: Shelf for macOS: every screenshot is already copied and waits on a shelf at the edge of your screen. Paste it into any AI agent with ⌘V.

name: Serplyze
tagline: Search Console rank tracking, grouped like your business
description: Search Console has the data, but only as a flat list of queries. Serplyze turns it into rank tracking organised like your business: keyword and page groups (rule-based or AI-suggested), impression-weighted visibility per group, alerts for rank drops and cannibalisation, click forecasts, a content decay heatmap and Google update markers. 100 keywords free, no card. 🎁 Product Hunt exclusive: 20% off any paid plan for your first 3 months. Use code [PRODUCTHUNT20] at checkout.

name: Scopa & Briscola AI
tagline: Play classic Italian card games with AI, CPU, or friends
description: Scopa & Briscola AI brings two classic Italian card games to the browser and smartphone, with several ways to play: built-in CPU opponents, multiplayer with friends, and LLM-powered opponents. Choose from regional Italian card decks, use GPT, Claude, Gemini or OpenRouter with your own API key, and even watch AI-vs-AI matches. Play with a friend on the other side of the world, or kill time on a flight. No signup required.

name: Samethru
tagline: Finds the bugs between your database, API and screen
description: Samethru checks that what your app shows on screen matches your API and your database, and shows exactly where it goes wrong when it doesn't. It plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI. Your assistant traces where each value comes from; Samethru compares it across all three and names the bug: wrong prices, dates shifted by timezones, lists cut off by pagination, stale caches and 8 more. Runs on your machine, read-only. Free.

name: Rooofread
tagline: Rent or buy? See what changes for your money.
description: Buying builds equity. Renting leaves money available for other things. What does each path look like for you? Compare renting and buying in Canada using your own costs and timeline. See cash, investments and home equity separately, with clear assumptions behind the numbers. Quick results are free without signup. Detailed modes require a newsletter subscription.

name: RoomMaroc
tagline: Find student housing near your campus in Morocco
description: RoomMaroc makes student housing in Morocco easier to find. Students can search for rooms, apartments and roommates by city, university and budget, compare listings and contact landlords directly. We’re solving a fragmented housing experience where students often rely on Facebook groups, WhatsApp and intermediaries. Starting with student housing, RoomMaroc aims to build a trusted housing marketplace for Morocco. Built in Morocco 🇲🇦

name: Reviu
tagline: The review app for code your agent writes
description: Since the first launch, Reviu was rebuilt from a Git client with an agent panel into a review workspace for coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and other ACP agents in durable sessions, inspect every diff, send inline comments back, checkpoint or undo turns, and finish the branch with real Git. Pro adds GitHub PR review, checks, merge, and notifications.

name: Resumelyn
tagline: The all-in-one platform to get more interviews
description: Resumelyn is an all-in-one job search platform to build stronger CVs, tailor every application, generate cover letters, track your job search, and get discovered by recruiters. Pro members also get AI CV optimization, recruiter visibility, Resumelyn Verification, and our Interview Guarantee: get interviews within 14 days or your money back.

name: Replayable
tagline: Save the last 30 seconds of your gameplay instantly
description: Replayable is a lightweight Windows replay recorder built for gamers who want to capture moments without recording their entire session. Save the last 30 seconds of gameplay with a hotkey, including video and audio, while keeping the experience simple and focused. Replayable is designed to stay out of your way so you can keep playing and capture the moment when it happens.

name: Remote Clipboard
tagline: Share text and files across devices, people and AI agents
description: Copy on one device. Paste on another. Remote Clipboard syncs text and files in real time through a short-lived room link. Use it from a browser or the rclip CLI on laptops, phones, servers and virtual machines. Share with people or let AI agents drop off results, pick up files and pass work between agents. Keep multiple named clipboards, restrict private rooms to invited emails, and choose when everything expires. Public rooms need no sign-in.

name: Relaxfolio
tagline: A stock screener you speak to in plain English
description: A conversational stock screener for US-listed stocks and ETFs. Ask for screens in plain English, like breakout stocks with relative volume > 1.2.

name: Reason
tagline: A coding workspace with context, plugins and skills
description: Reason is a workspace for AI-assisted coding. Start a session with files, repositories, earlier sessions or skills as context. Browse plugins for your tools and built-in instructions for issue and pull request workflows.

name: Reactive Resume v6
tagline: A free and open-source resume builder
description: This new version of Reactive Resume brings resumes, matching cover letters, and job tracking into one redesigned workflow, while staying free, open source, and self-hostable. There's AI, there's detailed customisability, there's sharing and collaboration features, and so much more. Most of all, it has built trust in the past 6 years as _the_ resume builder to go to for many users.

name: ROMBO AI for NMR Compound Identification
tagline: ROMBO AI Advances NMR Compound Identification with AI
description: ROMBO AI advances NMR compound identification by using artificial intelligence to analyze complex spectral data efficiently. Its AI-powered approach helps researchers interpret NMR spectra, identify compounds, and streamline analytical workflows. By reducing manual effort and supporting faster spectral analysis, ROMBO AI enables reliable insights for modern chemical research, industrial applications, and advanced material analysis.

name: Quota
tagline: Your Claude usage limits, always in the corner of your Mac
description: Quota is a tiny native Mac widget that keeps your Claude limits on screen: the 5-hour session, the weekly limit and the per-model limit, as rings in any corner. Hover for reset times and a forecast of when your current pace hits the wall. One click keeps your Mac awake for long Claude Code runs. Optional OpenRouter and DataForSEO balances. Sign in with the Claude plan you already have. No Terminal, no telemetry. $15 once, free updates.

name: Quiet Pomodoro
tagline: A focus app for people who hate focus apps
description: Most focus apps are cluttered enough to be a distraction themselves. Quiet Pomodoro is a clean, minimal timer for iPhone: pick a task, start a session, and it blocks your distracting apps until the break. Daily streaks show your progress. That's all.

name: PubBidder
tagline: Pubbidder advertising for publishers and advertisers.
description: Monetize your website traffic with PubBidder. Access high-paying ads, popunder, native and banner advertising with reliable publisher monetization.

name: Principal Plan
tagline: Envelope budgeting that runs on your own PC or Mac
description: Principal Plan is envelope-based budgeting software for Windows and Mac. Give every dollar a job when it arrives and see what's safe to spend before you spend it. It's a native desktop app, not a web app: it works offline, needs no account, and keeps your financial data on your own computer. Import bank files (CSV, OFX/QFX, QIF), reconcile statements, and use the optional iPhone and Android companion to check envelope balances on the go. Free 60-day trial.

name: PressDeck
tagline: Turn Android volume buttons into useful shortcuts
description: PressDeck turns supported Volume Up and Volume Down double presses and long presses into shortcuts for actions you choose, including launching apps, controlling media, opening Android settings, toggling the flashlight, or asking Android to take a system screenshot. Unlike a general macro engine, it stays focused and deterministic. A guided compatibility test checks what your device can support, and accepted button events are processed on-device.

name: Postings: Doctors Network
tagline: A professional network for doctors and medical students
description: Postings is a professional network built specifically for doctors and medical students. Connect with verified members, share knowledge, join meaningful discussions, discover opportunities, and build your professional network in one focused community. Unlike general social platforms, Postings is designed around the needs and conversations of the medical community.

name: PlayWeld
tagline: An open-source IDE for AI-assisted game development
description: Bring your game files, plans, AI conversations, and connected tools into one desktop workspace. PlayWeld keeps the context close while you build, with project knowledge search and supervised AI workflows. Open source under Apache 2.0.

name: Pixly
tagline: AI home design, video and floor plans for real estate
description: One toolkit for real estate marketing. Design an empty room in 60+ styles, declutter, restyle finishes, redo the garden, fix the sky, lawn and season, or switch day to twilight. Then turn photos into walkthrough videos and reels, add property lines to drone footage, and go from a room scan or a sketch to a 3D floor plan. 20+ AI tools and 30 free ones, with no prompts to write and no models to compare. On the web, on iPhone, and inside ChatGPT and Claude.

name: Pixerbook Platfrom
tagline: All in one workflow platform for modern photography studios
description: Leads, quotes, bookings, payments, galleries and album review — for photography studios.

name: PinBoostr
tagline: AI turns your blog posts into Pinterest pins. You approve.
description: PinBoostr turns your blog posts and product pages into on-brand Pinterest pins. AI designs each pin, writes the title, description and alt text, and picks the board. Growth Brain prepares a week of pins from your best links. You approve every pin, and approved pins publish on a paced schedule through the official Pinterest API. Analytics show which pins bring clicks. Works with WordPress or any website, and schedules LinkedIn posts too (free in beta). Free plan to start.

name: Pikstrapi
tagline: Design templates. Automate images, PDFs and videos.
description: Turn one design into every variation you need. Pikstrapi combines a visual template editor with a REST API: update text and images, generate in bulk from CSV, and receive results through webhooks. Create editable templates with AI and connect your workflows through n8n, Make or Zapier. Built for social graphics, blog covers, certificates and more.

name: Pheebs
tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

name: People Commons
tagline: Common ground for HR and AI
description: Practical AI tools, ready-made resources and curated reading for people who run HR.

name: Peekabop
tagline: Karaoke lyrics around your MacBook's notch, word by word
description: Peekabop shows the lyrics of whatever's playing right under your MacBook's camera, lighting up word by word in time. Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube and other sites in Safari, Chrome, Arc or Firefox. Pick the notch, a floating pill, subtitles or full screen, and one of 16 effects. On macOS 26 it even shifts the lyrics to match a music video's edit. No account, no analytics. €9.99 once, 7 days free.

name: Parky!
tagline: Disney wait times, dining alerts and a stamp for every ride
description: Live wait times for Walt Disney World, Disneyland and Universal, with an alert when a wait drops to your number. Every ride has a chart of its day: what it's posting now, what it usually does at this hour, and when it went down. Parky watches for hard-to-get restaurant tables, times your real queue on the Lock Screen, and fills in a hand-drawn stamp for every ride you take. For iPhone and Apple Watch.

name: Paperlead
tagline: Turn handwritten paper notes into editable docs and PDF's
description: Love writing on paper but hate retyping it? Snap a photo of your messy notes—Paperlead uses AI to transcribe them into clean digital text you can edit, finish writing, customize, and export to a gorgeous PDF.

name: PaidTaskers
tagline: A directory of verified paid tasks platforms
description: A directory of verified paid-task platforms across surveys, AI training, app testing, transcription, and chat — rates, payouts, and requirements checked monthly.

name: Orcylo
tagline: 📊 Mac vitals, 30-day history & AI limits in your menu bar
description: Orcylo is the Activity Monitor alternative for Mac 🖥️ 📦 Groups ~700 processes into the ~25 apps you actually use 📈 30 days of history: see what slowed your Mac, even after the fact 🚨 Smart alerts when an app misbehaves 🤖 Claude Code & Codex usage limits right in your menu bar ⚡ Native, lightweight, stays out of your way Stop guessing why your Mac is slow. 🚀

name: Opengeni
tagline: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents
description: Ship AI agents to production in hours. Opengeni gives you sessions that recover from failures, isolated sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals, and visibility into every step and dollar spent. Focus on your agents. We handle the infrastructure. Self-host for free, or get started on our cloud.

name: OpenRive
tagline: A local-first, login-free editor for Rive .riv animations.
description: OpenRive is a local-first, login-free editor for Riveriv animations. Design, animate, build state machines and export files that play in every official Rive runtime.

name: Oogwai Beacon
tagline: Answer Engine Optimization Audit
description: Most AEO tools score your HTML and call it AI visibility. Beacon actually asks the engines. We put unbranded buyer questions about your category to ChatGPT and Gemini (Claude on the full audit), then show how often you're named, who gets named instead, and which sources the engines trust. Two separate answers: can AI crawlers read your site (instant, no sign-up), and do the engines recommend you? Every gap comes with the fix.

name: Online Palette Generator
tagline: Create beautiful color palettes from images
description: Online Palette Generator is a free, browser-based color toolkit for designers and developers. Extract color palettes from images, pick exact HEX colors, check WCAG contrast, create gradients, shades and tints, preview colors, and export palettes. Everything runs directly in your browser, keeping your images private while making color selection faster and easier.

name: On Air: Your Apple Music Playlist Host
tagline: Voice Intros for your music
description: Ever wanted facts & info about songs/artists songs on your Apple Music playlists? Then this app could be for you! On Air gives you a short, fact-based or reflective intros before songs in your playlists. Know some facts about a song? Submit your own facts to share with others Earn badges as you use the app and share acheivements with others Website: https://onairintro.app/ $3.99 monthly or $3.33 monthly equivalent if purchase annual (which also has a 3 day free trial)

name: OmniReach
tagline: Safety first LinkedIn & Email outreach with signals
description: OmniReach is safety-first LinkedIn & email outreach with signals for founders, sales reps & marketers. Find who to contact from scored buying signals with evidence, personalize each touch with AI in your voice, & send under daily caps with warmup. Sequences, unified inbox, & a shared do not contact list in one workspace for multiple senders. Launch is $69 per sender monthly, locked while subscribed. Start free with a 7 day free trial & build your first campaign!

name: OKF Todo
tagline: Turn scattered notes into reviewed, actionable tasks
description: OKF Todo is a free, open-source task manager for Windows, built for developers and support staff. Use your own external AI assistant to turn emails, notes, spreadsheets, or screenshots into a proposed task plan. Review and approve saving it, then organize and complete the work in OKF Todo. Tasks are stored locally. AI-assisted planning uses your chosen assistant and its own account, costs, and data handling.

name: Nexus DataHub
tagline: Turn your databases into secure, usable APIs
description: Nexus DataHub connects legacy and modern databases, prepares and governs their data, then exposes it through secure APIs. Built for real-world IT environments, it runs on-premise and supports Informix, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. No Kafka, Kubernetes or Elasticsearch required, just a focused stack designed for traceability, security and operational simplicity.

name: NexoLumi
tagline: AI-powered CRM for WhatsApp, sales and customer workflows
description: NexoLumi brings WhatsApp conversations, contacts, deals, tasks and AI-assisted workflows into one CRM. Built for small teams that want less operational chaos, faster follow-ups and a clearer sales pipeline without stitching together multiple tools.

name: NeuroDual
tagline: Brain training that measures your progress out of 100
description: Brain training built around a measurement. Start with an assessment scored out of 100, train in guided 15-minute sessions, then retake the same assessment every eight sessions to see where you stand. 30+ games: Dual N-Back, Stroop, Flanker, Corsi blocks, Object Tracking, and logic puzzles like Sokoban and Untangle. No account, no ads, works offline. 90 minutes of free play, then a one-time payment. No subscription. Launch code: Android & web only; iOS doesn't allow codes.

name: NOTIVA SPACE
tagline: Everything you need. One single space.
description: Notiva is a modern workspace for organizing notes, documents, databases, projects, and knowledge in one place. Create pages, structure information with databases and views, collaborate in team spaces, and keep your work organized without jumping between multiple tools. Built for people who want a focused workspace that brings their ideas and work together.

name: MyneWallet
tagline: Expense Tracker & Budget Planner. Offline, On Purpose.
description: MyneWallet is a private, offline expense tracker and zero-based budget planner for Android. Most budgeting apps want your bank login, your transactions on their servers, and up to $15 a month. MyneWallet needs none of it: no account, no bank login, no analytics, no servers of ours. Give every dollar a job, log an expense in three seconds, and see where your money really goes. Backups are AES-256 encrypted to your own Google Drive. The core app is free, and PRO is a one-time unlock.

name: Music Guru
tagline: Hear 1,700+ scales, explore chords, and export musical ideas
description: Turn music theory into sounds you can use. Explore 1,700+ scales and a deep chord library; search by name, notes or intervals; hear ideas with different instruments; and view notes on piano, guitar, bass or ukulele. Discover chords within a scale, audition progressions, save favorites, and export MIDI or audio for your next song. Built for songwriters, improvisers, teachers and curious musicians. Available on web, iOS and Android, with a free plan and optional paid upgrades.

name: Meetly Teleprompter
tagline: Free teleprompter that keeps your eyes on the webcam
description: A free teleprompter for founder and accelerator videos, free forever. While you record, the line you're reading sits right under your webcam, so you look at the lens. It follows your voice as you read, blurs or replaces your background on-device, and downloads an MP4 in 16:9 or 9:16. Or run the teleprompter alone and record in QuickTime. No signup. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is saved on a server.

name: Marv
tagline: An AI cursor companion that shows you what to click
description: Meet Marv, your cursor’s new plus-one. Hold a hotkey and ask about anything on your screen. Marv answers out loud while drawing arrows, circling buttons and writing notes directly on your screen to walk you through it. Debug some code, work out a spreadsheet formula or find the right control in your video editor, all without leaving the app you’re using.

name: MShelf
tagline: A home for physical game collectors
description: MShelf is a home for physical game collectors. Keep track of the games, collector's editions, books, figures, and other pieces that make your shelf yours. Explore the catalog, build your collection, create sets, and share your finds with other collectors.

name: Lumrise
tagline: Your personalized 30-day glow-up plan
description: Lumrise creates a personalized 30-day self-care and appearance plan based on your goals, preferences, and photos. Choose Face, Skin, or Body and get tailored daily guidance, routines, and progress tracking. I built Lumrise to make personal appearance goals simpler and more actionable. I'm launching on Product Hunt to get feedback, improve the product, and help people build better daily routines.

name: Lodestar · Hamzzi Saju
tagline: Discover your Hamzzi through Korean Saju
description: Meet Hamzzi, your guide to Korean Saju. Find one of 60 hamster characters from your birth date, explore its story, and compare with friends. The birthday test is free with no signup; optional readings are paid.

name: Linkits
tagline: A curated directory of tools & resources
description: Discover, save, and organize the best developer tools, resources, and platforms. Your personal toolbox for building and growing projects. With 27 categories and 600+ tools to browse.

name: LevCharity 2.0
tagline: The Digital Platform for Modern Nonprofits
description: LevCharity 2.0 brings fundraising, donor CRM, campaigns, events, eCards, eCommerce, reporting, communications, and AI-powered tools into one connected platform built specifically for nonprofits. Instead of stitching together separate systems, organizations can manage donor relationships and digital fundraising from one place, with the flexibility to extend the platform through custom portals, applications, dashboards, and digital experiences.

name: Lastbrowser
tagline: Local-first AI browser for Windows with built-in terminal
description: Lastbrowser is a Chromium-based browser for Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit). It combines the Nova AI copilot (bring your own key or local Ollama models), 48 curated agentic workflows with MCP support, an embedded ConPTY terminal, isolated multi-account Spaces and Widevine DRM for HD streaming. Data stays local, encrypted with Windows DPAPI. Free for personal use, no account required.

name: Krop
tagline: All your news sources in one reader, newest first.
description: Description: Krop is a local news reader for tech and legal sources. TechCrunch, Hacker News, Ars, The Verge, VentureBeat, Wired, Axios, Semafor, Above the Law, Legal Cheek, and more live in one sidebar. Search hits every source, newest first. Feeds load as each source comes in, so the first headlines show immediately. Favourites stay on your device as title, image, and link. No account. Mac and soon on iOS. getkrop.app

name: Kiddital EBook Platform
tagline: #Kiddital #KidsBooks #ChildrensBooks #EducationalBooks
description: Illustrated children's books matched to your child's age, from 0 to 12, each set in its own dreamy world. Read a free preview of every story online.

name: Karaya
tagline: Framer template for luxury villas & boutique stays
description: Karaya is a Framer template built for single-property luxury villas and boutique stays, not hotels or multi-listing sites. Editorial layout, smooth scroll animations, and a story-first structure that makes one property feel special. Includes 8 pages (Home, The Villa, Experiences, Gallery, Journal, Contact, Privacy, 404), CMS-ready Journal & Testimonials, full responsiveness, and the complete Figma file. Remix, swap your photos and copy, and go live the same day.

name: Jobbit.uk
tagline: The AI that outsources to humans
description: Jobbit's agents build apps, documents, research and media, and when a job needs a person (a designer, an accountant, an electrician) they brief and hire a vetted expert from our own network, with payment held in escrow. Every task runs one loop: Assign, Execute, Record, Improve. With consent, each finished job becomes first-party data that Jobbit Labs turns into evaluations and world models for physical AI.

name: JobTune
tagline: Tailor your resume to the job. Keep it true to you.
description: Turn your existing experience into a clearer, job-specific application. JobTune tailors your resume to a job description, helps you review the changes, and generates a cover letter. Use it on your phone or desktop, or alongside job postings with the Chrome extension.

name: Jarq
tagline: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor
description: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text right where your cursor is — in any app on Mac. Dictate there too. No tabs, no copy-paste. Select text, hit a hotkey, and it's replaced in place. Or press ⌥` and speak in one language, get clean text in another. 13 languages. Privacy: Jarq uses cloud AI models to process your text and voice. Jarq itself doesn't keep your text on its servers, and your history stays on your Mac. Free: 5 actions a day. Pro: $4.99/mo or $39/yr. 14-day Pro trial, no card.

name: ItWield
tagline: Stop chatting with AI. Put AI to work for your business
description: ItWield is the Autonomous AI Workspace that gives startups a self-operating company. Deploy autonomous AI executives (CEO, COO, CMO) and worker agents that plan business goals, manage CRM pipelines, and execute complex workflows 24/7 in the background—all with enterprise security and human-in-the-loop control. Stop chatting with AI. Put AI to work for your business.

name: Invofox Self Serve
tagline: 99% accurate document extraction, SLA guaranteed
description: Invofox turns any document into clean, structured JSON through one API. Get 99%+ accuracy backed by SLAs. If we make a mistake, you don’t pay for that document. Invofox handles parsing, extraction, validation, edge cases, and monitoring behind one endpoint, then automatically learns from your feedback to keep improving on the documents your business actually processes.

name: InterviewCrusher
tagline: Practise interviews with your CV and job description
description: Turn a CV and job description into focused preparation, a contextual mock interview and actionable feedback. Practise in six languages, adjust pressure and duration, and export your report as a PDF. Start with fictional examples. Currently free within usage limits. Watch the 100-second walkthrough: https://interviewcrusher.com/en#demo

name: InteractInk
tagline: A fresh social network built around what people want to say.
description: InteractInk is a social media platform and online community where people can share posts discover new ideas join conversations and connect with others. Create your account. If you want to share your thoughts post an opinion talk about trending topics share something find interesting posts or just see what others talk about InteractInk gives you a place to do it. InteractInk. Share. Discover. Interact.

name: InputBuffer.io
tagline: Collect and understand feedback from users and their agents
description: Your users' AI agents hit your API, read your docs, and know exactly where things break. InputBuffer collects feedback from those agents and your own. For human feedback, embed our official widget and your users will be able to react and comment on any part of your product. Everything gets sorted into topics (custom or suggested by AI), with no manual tagging. Then ask "why are people abandoning signup?" and get an answer linked to the submissions behind it. First 250 submissions free.

name: ISO Lead Auditor Courses in Chennai
tagline: ISO Lead Auditor Courses In Chennai
description: our Fire and safety course in Coimbatore prepares you to handle disasters confidently. Join us to upgrade your safety proficiency and make a difference in your workplace or community.

name: HyperFrames Studio (Desktop)
tagline: The First Video Editor built for Agents
description: The first video editor built for agents - built by the team who open sourced HyperFrames at HeyGen Bring your favorite agent (either codex or claude code), HyperFrames Studio turn your coding agents into video editors, while you stay in the director seat. Describe a video and your agent makes it with HyperFrames, then you and your agent work on it together in one studio editor.

name: Horoscope: Personal Astrology
tagline: Deep natal charts, synastry & 28 horoscope modules
description: Most horoscope apps give generic 2-sentence sun-sign predictions. We built a deep analytical platform with 28 specialized modules covering natal chart houses, planetary transits, synastry (compatibility), and long-term career/financial cycles. Powered by precise astronomical ephemeris calculations based on exact birth time and location. Designed for users who want serious astrological insights rather than surface-level entertainment.

name: Homebase
tagline: Built to bring families closer, not just keep them organized
description: A family organization app designed for the modern, productive & successful family. Homebase brings your shared calendar, tasks, shopping lists, meal planning, and resources together in one place, centered around a unique family-focused social feed. It’s designed to encourage togetherness over individualism and meaningful connection over digital noise, helping families stay organized and connected with the people they care about most.

name: Holdly — Your speaking gym
tagline: Open and speak. Feedback after you finish.
description: No one to practice with? Holdly is voice conversation only: free-flowing, no judgment while you speak, and a clear report at the end to improve how you speak. Tap to talk, get a spoken AI reply, then review strengths, better phrasings, and vocabulary — feedback after the session, not mid-sentence. Practice English and Italian today; more languages coming soon. Any level. Start free.

name: HiddenContent.ai
tagline: Find the text in a document your AI reads and you can't see
description: An MCP/API to check Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint and web pages for hidden text before your AI reads it: white text, tiny text, text off the page, invisible characters. Shows exactly what's hidden and where. Add it to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. 20 pages free.

name: HEICCONVERTER
tagline: Privacy-first client-side HEIC to PNG converter
description: A fast, privacy-focused web utility that converts Apple HEIC photos to PNG directly inside your browser. No server uploads, no file limits, and 100% free.

name: Gridlark
tagline: Turn the sheet your team avoids into an app they'll use.
description: Every team has a Google Sheet nobody else dares to touch. Gridlark gives it an app: dashboard, search, guided forms, and Approve and Mark done buttons. The sheet stays the source of truth, and formulas are never overwritten. The app is plain Apps Script in your Google Workspace, so your data never passes through us. No AI: written rules propose every field, each with its reason, and the same sheet always gives the same app. One price per organization, never per seat. One live app is free.

name: Globalsync AI
tagline: Tools for Remote workers or freelancers
description: GlobalSync AI brings everyday tools for working across borders into one free workspace. Compare time zones, find meeting windows across your team’s working hours, convert currencies, and prepare invoices. Built for remote teams and freelancers, with no signup required.

name: Gigwork Tracker
tagline: Track earnings, expenses, mileage & taxes — free, no signup
description: GigWork Tracker is a free, privacy-first earnings tracker for Uber, Lyft, and DoorDash drivers. It tracks earnings, expenses, mileage, and hours. There is no signup, no account, and your data never leaves your phone. What stands out? It has a Day/Hour heat map showing your real $/hr by day and time, built-in Prop 22 tracking for CA drivers, and voice input for logging mileage and expenses hands-free. Pro ($25 one-time, no subscription) adds tax estimates using the IRS mileage deduction.

name: Gigai Chronicle
tagline: Git records changes. Chronicle records what was asked.
description: Gigai Chronicle is the memory and intelligence layer for AI-assisted software development. Capture AI coding sessions, prompts, responses, tool runs, file changes, and Git activity in one searchable timeline. name: Privaro
tagline: Runtime PII detection and governance proxy for LLMs
description: Privaro sits between your application and any AI model, intercepting every prompt before it reaches the model. It detects and tokenizes sensitive data — names, emails, IBANs, national IDs, medical records, contract clauses — in under 80ms. The model works on tokens, not real data. And every interaction generates a blockchain-certified audit trail. Built for teams shipping LLM features in regulated industries (fintech, legal, healthcare, insurance) who need to prove GDPR and EU AI Act compliance.

name: PowerCut.today
tagline: Live hyperlocal electricity outage tracker for India
description: Real-time electricity outage tracking across India down to local streets & pincodes. Get live power cut status, scheduled shutdowns, 24x7 DISCOM helplines (1912), and 10+ electrical calculators (inverters, solar, generators) in 10+ Indian languages.

name: Pokia
tagline: Understand AI by playing with it
description: Pokia turns AI concepts into short, interactive experiments. Fool a detector, change its training examples, and see why its prediction changes. Explore tokens, attention and neural networks, then go deeper with Advanced labs. Start the free learning path without a ChatGPT account. Built with GPT-6 Astra.

name: PokeCode Pocket Localized Vibecoding App
tagline: Localized Mobile Phone vibecoding and prompt management
description: Most mobile vibe-coding apps rely on SSH or cloud computers. Pokecode takes a different approach: it runs locally on your phone through a Linux environment, with a clean, mobile-first interface. It also includes built-in prompt management, letting you organize, version, link, and reuse prompts across projects, keeping AI-assisted development structured instead of turning into a messy chat history.

name: Plumeform
tagline: Research-grade surveys without the four-figure contract
description: Surveys with the quality controls researchers pay Qualtrics for attention checks, quotas, randomization, panel integrations, per-question timing at an indie price. 100 free responses/mo, no respondent logins, AI drafting, live results. $15 for 10,000.

name: PhoneCheckr
tagline: Bulk phone validation & formatting
description: Cleaning a phone list before a campaign? Upload a CSV and get line type, carrier, and validity for every number in under 60 seconds. No code, no account, no subscription.

name: Peptimize
tagline: World's most advanced GLP-1 tracker and peptide companion
description: Take charge of your GLP-1 and peptide routine. Track Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy and Zepbound doses, weight, appetite and side effects. Spot patterns with Pro on iOS. Built by a GLP-1 user. Health records stay on your device.

name: PawFora
tagline: Pet Shop & Grooming Salon Management Software
description: Pawfora is the all-in-one intelligent platform for pet shops — online booking, smart scheduling, grooming reports, pet profiles and reminders in one workspace.

name: Parlo
tagline: The Client portal for freelancers and creatives
description: Parlo is a client portal built specifically for solo freelancers. A freelancer creates a project, uploads their work, and sends one link, their client opens it with no signup. From there, the client can view files, approve them, leave feedback, and pay outstanding invoices, all in the same place. The freelancer's own branding logo, business name, accent color show up throughout, so the tool disappears into the freelancer's own identity rather than looking like third-party software.

name: PDFixel
tagline: Compress & edit your files without sending them to strangers
description: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs, Office files, images and video right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, so your files stay on your device.

name: PC Anatomy
tagline: Explore a PC from case to GPU core in interactive 3D
description: PC Anatomy is an open source interactive 3D explorer for computer hardware. Take apart a desktop PC, inspect its components, and dive deeper from the motherboard, CPU, cooling, storage and GPU all the way down to GPU architecture and individual streaming multiprocessors. Every component includes explanations, specifications and sources, with all 3D geometry generated directly in TypeScript and Three.js.

name: Oscar Nutrição
tagline: AI-powered personalized nutrition and meal planning
description: Oscar Nutrição is an AI-powered nutrition platform for individuals and health professionals. It creates highly personalized meal plans using user or client profiles, considering goals, age, body data, activity, budget, preferences, restrictions, habits, diseases and health conditions. With separate user and client profiles, history, favorites and professional management tools, it turns complex nutritional needs into practical, personalized daily planning.

name: Orfeo Autónomo: facturación VeriFactu
tagline: Facturas VeriFactu desde el móvil, sin servidor propio
description: Facturación para autónomos con VERI*FACTU en tu móvil. Sin cuentas, sin servidores: tus facturas se quedan en tu teléfono y solo salen hacia la Agencia Tributaria.

name: OralInsulin MCP
tagline: Evidence-backed oral insulin intelligence for agents
description: OralInsulin MCP gives AI agents and human decision-makers a structured, source-backed view of the oral and oromucosal insulin landscape. It tracks clinical programs, market estimates, regulatory developments, manufacturers, partnerships and qualified relationship signals through MCP tools and a human-facing site. Built to help researchers, companies, investors and healthcare organizations evaluate evidence, compare claims and connect. Ask it anything: GPT-6 Astra answers by querying the same MCP

name: Open a Gift
tagline: Personal cards they unwrap in the browser
description: Write a personal message, add an optional photo, and wrap it in an interactive reveal. Share the link yourself; the recipient opens it without an app or account. Free to create and open. Gifts expire 30 days after creation with a photo, or 60 days without one.

name: Octomus Agent
tagline: AI that finds repo improvements and opens reviewed PRs
description: Octomus Agent is a self-hosted repository improvement agent that finds worthwhile work before writing code. Using gpt-6-astra it studies your repo, proposes improvements, challenges them with independent reviewers, implements accepted tasks in isolated worktrees, verifies the exact reviewed revision, and opens GitHub PRs. Audit mode lets you inspect every decision first. You stay in control: Octomus never merges or deploys.

name: Nolo.Chat
tagline: Mission control for GPT-6 Astra and all your coding agents
description: Mission control for GPT-6 Astra and all your coding agents. Let Astra plan the work while cheaper models execute it: Nolo routes each task to the agent that can nail it for the least money, and you can steer or stop any run from your phone.

name: Nepotism Network
tagline: Great things start by knowing friend of a friend of a friend
description: Someone you know knows someone you wish you knew. Nepo Network maps these connections between you and the people you want to reach on X, uncovering potential paths to a warm intro. Explore ranked routes, see who connects each step, draft your ask, and track your outreach. Your network has a surprisingly useful extended family.

name: NV oOS Content Graph
tagline: Maps your WordPress site into an interactive knowledge graph
description: NV oOS Content Graph transforms your WordPress content into a visual knowledge graph — organized, searchable, & interactive. Every post, page, category, tag, & author becomes a node; every relationship becomes an edge. Click “Build Graph” and ~10-30 seconds later, your entire site becomes a visual graph. Supports incremental rebuilds and scheduled cron updates. Explore your content visually using Cytoscape.js. Search for nodes by label, click for details, zoom & pan. Color-coded by content type

name: NEXUS AI Builder
tagline: Build and deploy production-ready apps with AI
description: NEXUS AI Builder turns a prompt into a complete, multi-page application you can preview, refine, and deploy from one workspace. Build with OpenAI, Claude, Grok, OpenRouter, or your own OpenRouter-compatible endpoint. Create functional navigation, backend features, databases, and production deployments. Keep prompting to update the design, add pages, fix issues, and ship your app without switching tools.

name: MyPawBro
tagline: Local pet communities built around trust, not transactions
description: MyPawBro turns local pet care into a neighbourhood community. Create a Pawfile, discover compatible local Paws, explore paw-friendly places and connect through your local Bro. Built around trusted relationships and reciprocal support rather than anonymous pet-care listings, MyPawBro brings pets and people together locally.

name: My Own Product
tagline: Discover tools. Launch free. See what gets attention.
description: My Own Product is a discovery platform where builders can launch products for free and users can find useful tools through clear categories, capabilities, and use cases. Each listing gets a consistent visual presentation, while founders can see first-party visitor, product-view, and outbound-click analytics. No voting race, backlink requirement, analytics integration, or third-party tracking embed is needed to understand whether people are actually discovering your product.

name: Muvick
tagline: Predict what happens next in movies & TV
description: Muvick turns movies and TV into a prediction game. Join a Slate before a movie or episode releases, predict plot twists, character outcomes and more, then come back after release to see how well you did. Earn XP, build your fandom profile, and prove how well you really know your favorite franchises.

name: MosMos
tagline: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
description: MosMos goes beyond voice dictation by turning both individual thoughts and group conversations into usable writing. Speak naturally in any app, get fast and accurate text in the style you choose, or ask MosMos to search the web for current information. Its personal glossary remembers specialized terms after you add them once. In multi-speaker meetings, it tracks precise timestamps, distinguishes speakers, and creates structured notes, summaries, decisions, and action items for easier follow-up.

name: Mood Popper
tagline: Feel it. Pop it. Make a little space.
description: Mood Popper is a playful emotional check-in app for iOS. Explore your feelings through colourful mood bubbles, write in a private journal, follow breathing exercises, or take a break with fidget toys. A gentle, neurodivergent-friendly space with cosmic colour and a little play, designed to make checking in with yourself feel more approachable.

name: Mola
tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

name: Meridian Reading
tagline: Private life-path document. Not a chat.
description: Meridian delivers a private structured life-path document within 48 hours: who you are, which chapter you are in, and what tends to fit next. Unlike daily astrology apps or coaching chat, you get a finished 20-section web page with conviction labels (Full / Clear / Working), a chronological map, and high-conviction forward windows. Plain language. No mystical jargon. Cross-referenced lenses, human hand-finished. For people who outgrew notification feeds and want a mirror they can return to.

name: Mars Sandbox
tagline: Build and simulate a colony on Mars.
description: Mars Sandbox started as a fun experiment: what if I could build a little colony on Mars and then mess with it? Build Olympic City, change the time of day, throw dust storms, solar flares, meteorites and extreme cold at it, then try to recover. This is just V1. There’s a lot I want to improve, expand and polish from here. The goal is to slowly turn this little experiment into a beautiful, detailed Mars simulation.

name: MarketMate
tagline: Create ads, captions and campaigns in one workspace
description: Spend less time on marketing and more time running your business. MarketMate turns your products and ideas into complete campaigns, with image ad creatives, editable captions, hashtags and a marketing calendar. Bring the planning, writing and design work into one workspace, built to save business owners time each week.

name: Mantle
tagline: Open-source service runtime configured by agents via WebMCP
description: Mantle is an open-source service runtime and WebMCP-native Builder that turns business rules into typed schemas, views, procedures, and HTTP/MCP triggers. Design and verify a service in the browser, then hand it to a coding agent to materialize, verify, and deploy to your own Cloudflare account. The OSS, Builder, and first-class Cloudflare deployment path are live now. Mantle Cloud remains in Internal Beta with a waitlist.

name: ManageLM
tagline: The AI admin for your Linux and Windows fleet, on your LLM
description: The AI-driven management platform for Linux and Windows server fleets: assisted in the console or fully agentic with local LLM. Build-in PAM capabilities, security audits, compliance frameworks, monitoring, PKI, backups, credential rotations etc... Run the LLM yourself, zero inbound ports.

name: Makersclaw 2.0
tagline: The operating system for a company run by agents
description: MakersClaw 2.0 turns a goal into the apps, agents and automations needed to get it done. We originally launched MakersClaw as AI employees that lived in Slack, Teams and Telegram. We rebuilt it around a different idea: instead of hiring an agent for a role, tell MakersClaw what you want done. It builds the tools for the job, runs them continuously, remembers the work and operates within a budget you set. Today it starts with go-to-market

name: Maaa
tagline: A mom in your Mac’s notch, looking out for you
description: Meet Maaa, a familiar face in your Mac’s notch. Gentle reminders to drink water, eat and take a break, in 12 languages. For macOS 14 and later.

name: MULTIROADS
tagline: Serious Multiplayer Racing & Open World Adventure on Browser
description: Race seriously solo or with friends in your browser. Drive realistic circuits, endless roads and offroad trails using keyboard, controller or touch controls. Chase personal-best laps with ghost replays. Play on supported phones and computers without installing an app.

name: M9R
tagline: Multiplayer space for your AI coding agents and teams
description: M9R is the multiplayer layer for AI coding agents. Bring Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other supported agents into one shared workspace. Let them communicate across providers, hand work off, and let teammates join the same work instead of juggling isolated tabs. Not another model. A better place where agents work together and talk to everyone in the space.

name: LoopEraSell: Social Selling
tagline: Turn message screenshots into orders, on your device.
description: In social selling, orders arrive as screenshots and short texts — not a tidy checkout. LoopEraSell turns a message screenshot into an order (on-device OCR: share or camera), then keeps stock, shipping, payments, and customers on your phone. No official chat-app APIs; it works from your device share menu. Built by LoopEra Labs for social sellers who do not want a heavy e-commerce stack. Android on Google Play. Available in eight languages. No card required; the first 50 orders are free.

name: LokalBot
tagline: Find what you said or saw on your Mac
description: Find a decision from a call, a page you had open, or what you need to follow up on. LokalBot searches meeting transcripts and screen text you choose to save, with links to the source. Free and open source for Mac. Runs locally by default.

name: Loci
tagline: Open-source biomedical image analysis for every lab
description: Loci is a free, open-source desktop workspace for scientific images. View microscopy and 3D data, count cells, annotate, measure and export traceable results without a cloud account or subscription. Use built-in analysis or bring compatible model packages. Built by a researcher and shaped by real lab workflows. Currently public beta for Apple Silicon Macs; research use only.

name: LazyLord
tagline: Free Overlord alternative: Figma ⇄ Adobe, as real layers
description: LazyLord moves artwork between Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects, in any direction. Select, press Send, and it arrives as real, editable layers: Bézier paths, live text, gradients, masks and groups, not a flat image. Send again and it updates what it built before, right where it sits, and it asks before overwriting your hand edits. Live mode keeps apps in sync as you work. Everything runs on your own computer. Free and open source.

name: Layerhand
tagline: AI retouching that returns a layered PSD, not a flat JPEG
description: Layerhand retouches a photograph inside Photopea, a real image editor you watch, instead of returning a generated picture. GPT-6 Astra operates the toolbar the way a retoucher would, one step at a time, and you watch it happen. Type a mid-run correction while it still works and later steps bend around that note instead of restarting the run. The download is a layered PSD with named layers, editable masks, and adjustments still yours to change, plus a flattened PNG preview.

name: LaterGator
tagline: Schedule tabs for later, with AI that plans your day
description: LaterGator reopens tabs when you need them. Save a link, hit +10m, +1h or +1d or custom. It pops back on schedule, with daily, weekly or monthly repeats. New now: Magic AI Organizer reads every open tab, bundles related ones into tasks and drafts a schedule for your day in one click. Google sign-in with cloud sync across devices, dark mode and a rebuilt UI. Free forever for manual scheduling. AI plans from $3.99/mo, or bring your own OpenRouter key.

name: KlipZi City
tagline: Tanks. Jetpacks. Hoverboards. Sharks. 4 Player Chaos.
description: Jump into a free 3D chaos sandbox, solo or with friends. Drive tanks, planes, boats, helicopters and hoverboards. Strap on a jetpack, parachute from rooftops, swim with sharks, flip cars, shoot from vehicles, outrun cops and hunt each other in deathmatch. There’s even a flying time jump car that gets very interesting at 88 mph. No download. No account. Just play in a browser on web or mobile. Built by an Edinburgh designer with AI, then expanded into a multiplayer playground. Playing stays free.

name: Kanverse GPU Borrow
tagline: Borrow GPU compute from another device, with permission
description: Kanverse GPU Borrow demonstrates how a device can temporarily use GPU compute exposed by another machine through Blink Bridge. GPT-6 Astra acts as the orchestrator: it discovers the capability, inspects its state, requests explicit user authorization, invokes one bounded NVIDIA GPU workload, verifies the result, and confirms the GPU is released. The demo uses a real NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU and a live cross-device connection—not a simulated GPU.

name: Ink Player
tagline: Most innovative video player for WordPress
description: Most WordPress video plugins just play a file. Ink Player turns video into a channel: capture emails mid-video, run pre-roll ads with VAST tags, add chapters, timestamps, and password protection. Then stream from YouTube, Vimeo, Bunny, Cloudflare, or Mux with real analytics behind it. Built for creators who have stopped treating video as decoration and started treating it as a funnel. And it doesn't just play video. Add audio and turn it into a powerful podcast player.

name: Infowind Technologies(IT) PVT. LTD
tagline: Infowind Technologies - Turning Your Ideas into Assets.
description: Infowind is an AI-first mobile app development company delivering custom iOS, Android, and cross-platform apps. We craft high-performance, scalable digital solutions for startups and enterprises to accelerate business growth and drive revenue. Build smarter products today!

name: Ice Runner: Save Penguins
tagline: Rescue baby penguins. Bring your colony to life.
description: Every penguin you save comes home with you. Cross branching ice routes, rescue babies, and feed your growing 3D colony. Free on iPhone and iPad. Offline. No account required. Android is in development—coming soon.

name: How Many Cameras
tagline: Plan home camera placement and compare 3-year costs
description: Free planner for US and Canadian homes: pick your home layout, see where outdoor cameras go and what they miss, then compare cameras, doorbells and locks by 3-year cost with or without a subscription.

name: Habit & Goal Tracker－MicroWins
tagline: Task Planner, Reminder, To-Do
description: MicroWins helps you grow through small, repeatable wins, not overwhelming goals. Start with one simple habit. Check in each day. Watch streaks, consistency, and quiet progress add up over time.

name: GuitarRoll
tagline: Play along with animated guitar tabs at your own pace
description: Practice guitar with animated tabs, a synchronized piano visualization, selectable instrument tracks, and adjustable playback speed. Open a song and start playing in your browser. Built by a solo maker with GPT-6 Astra. Currently available in Spanish.

name: Guild Manager
tagline: Run your guild in one place, inside Discord
description: Replace the bots and spreadsheets your guild runs on. Roster, events, attendance, loot and analytics in one app, with two-way Discord role sync, DKP auctions and voice attendance. Each game gets its own setup. Free for guilds of any size. 4,065+ guilds.

name: GiveMeDocs.com
tagline: Stop chasing people for documents manually
description: GiveMeDocs turns document chasing across email, WhatsApp, and spreadsheets into one trackable workflow. Create one-time or recurring requests, share a no-login upload link, see exactly what’s still missing, and automate follow-ups. Unlike generic file storage, it tracks every requested item - so you know when the complete document set is ready, not merely when another file arrives.

name: GenioOne
tagline: The control plane for every AI agent and resource
description: GenioOne Community Edition is a source-first control plane for teams bringing AI agents into real work. Connect models, MCP servers, APIs, and knowledge; apply policy through the gateway; and give agents governed access on infrastructure you control. Join the commercial edition waitlist for broader enterprise rollout.

name: GameToMac
tagline: Play Windows games on Mac with AI-powered compatibility
description: GameToMac makes Windows games playable on Apple Silicon with smooth performance and high FPS. Built with GPT-6 Astra, it already supports Age of Empires IV, Age of Empires II, Company of Heroes 3, Counter-Strike 2, Overwatch, Red Alert 2, and Generals: Zero Hour. Thousands more Windows games will become playable on Mac very soon. Mac gaming is finally becoming a reality.

name: Galactic Receipt Scanner
tagline: Turn your phone into a hands-free receipt scanning station
description: Deploy your own private scanner on ChatGPT Sites. Capture receipts hands-free with your phone, then use ChatGPT Work to parse receipts and invoices. Stress-tested with 800 receipts so far and continuously improved through real-world use.

name: Framerly
tagline: The Fastest Way to Make Screenshots Shippable
description: Drop in any screenshot and Framerly wraps it in a browser, device, or app chrome, casts the shadow, and hands you back a PNG worth shipping. You get 75 background options directly in Framerly, it comprises of 44 Gradients, 16 Photos and 15 Radiants. Not only static screenshots, it contains 9 presets for screenshot to place at different angle. Apart from screenshots, it also contains a full fledged video editor with 5 presets.

name: Founder.page
tagline: Discover and follow the best founders on 𝕏
description: Discover and follow new founders on 𝕏 and see what they're working on. Home to over 600 founders already and growing fast. Free to list & updated daily

name: Forma-oss
tagline: urn a prompt or image into an editable hardware project
description: Forma turns a prompt or image into an editable hardware project with parts, wiring, mechanical layouts, cost estimates, and assembly instructions. Its open-source, local-first workspace connects supported AI agents to shared project data, rule-based electrical checks, and CAD tools. Generate concept renders, inspect the design, and revise your project as your idea evolves.

name: Foretop
tagline: CI-native drift scanners for AI systems
description: Foretop catches changes outside your repository that can still break it. Four Apache-2.0 scanners run locally or in CI with no Foretop account: Ebb checks model retirements, Telltale maps OpenAPI telemetry gaps, Charter reviews MCP capability changes, and Lading traces AI asset licence obligations. Every result carries evidence; unknown is never reported as clear. The optional Hub adds shared history, policies, ownership and exports—free for 3 repositories, with Team for up to 10.

name: FoodLens AI: Nutrition Scanner
tagline: Simply scan a food product barcode at home or while shopping
description: FoodLens Nutrition AI Scanner lets you scan food barcodes and get a mathematical AI-powered FoodLens Score from 1-100. Understand nutrition, ingredients, and make healthier choices.

name: Floor Planner
tagline: AI-powered floor planning, from idea to final deliverable.
description: [Floor Planner](https://floor-planner.ai/) is an all-in-one online floor planning platform offering AI floor plan generation, AI editing, a full floor plan editor, and image & CAD file conversion. Generate plans from text, edit existing drawings, fine-tune layouts manually, or convert between CAD formats like DXF/DWG and images — all in one workflow from concept to final delivery.

name: Flipns
tagline: Bring your local shop online. Reach buyers nearby.
description: Buy, sell, and explore local products. Bring your shop online with AI-assisted listings, a shareable catalogue, and nearby discovery. Built with GPT-6 Astra to connect offline sellers with online buyers.

name: FileTools Kit
tagline: Free, private PDF, image, and resume tools in your browser
description: FileTools Kit is a free collection of browser-based PDF, image, and resume tools. No file upload — work stays in the tab. Includes PDF Suite, Resume Builder, File Converter, Image Optimizer, QR Generator, and more. Operated by Souren Das in Bengaluru.

name: FamTree
tagline: Build your family tree with the people who are still here
description: FamTree is an interactive family tree built for your living family. Connect relatives across generations, preserve family memories, and keep your family history together in one private space. Free on Google Play.

name: ExamSync.in
tagline: Audio-first revision & rapid mock tests for aspirants.
description: Most competitive exam aspirants suffer from screen fatigue and burnout from reading 800-page textbooks all day. ExamSync (https://examsync.in) is an audio-first exam preparation platform designed for active recall. Aspirants can listen to bite-sized audio capsules during workouts, runs, or commutes, and instantly test retention with rapid 10-minute bilingual mock drills and real-time rank percentiles.

name: Everest
tagline: Text improvement mac app
description: Rewrite selected text across macOS with a local language model. Everest is shortcut-driven, open source, and runs the model on your Mac.

name: Edgee Codex Compressor V2
tagline: Use Codex at 35.6% lower costs
description: We benchmarked Codex alone against Codex routed through Edgee's compression gateway on the same repo, with the same model, under the same workflow. The result: Codex + Edgee used 49.5% fewer input tokens, improved cache hit rate from 76.1% to 85.4%, and reduced total session cost by 35.6%. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

name: DrawDuo
tagline: Draw and Guess game with AI bot or friends
description: DrawDuo is a free online draw-and-guess game with AI or friends. Create a room, share one link, and play pictionary in your browser — no signup, no download, works on phone & desktop. Jump into a DrawDuo room and play Pictionary with players from around the world — with AI bot joining the game too. ✏️ Draw the word before time runs out. 🤖 Guess against AI and see if you can beat its score. Whether you're an amazing artist or your drawings look like abstract art, every round is a new challenge.

name: Dikke Stift
tagline: Redact sensitive info from text and PDFs, free and private
description: Dikke Stift finds and redacts sensitive info (names, emails, IDs, addresses) in pasted text or uploaded PDFs and Word docs, then lets you restore the original data after getting a response back from ChatGPT or Claude. Everything runs client-side in your browser: nothing is ever uploaded, stored, or logged. Free, no account, no limits.

name: Desktop Terrarium
tagline: Watch your coding sessions grow into a living garden
description: Desktop Terrarium is a native macOS companion that turns real coding activity into a living, animated garden. It automatically detects work in Xcode, Cursor, Codex, Claude and other IDEs—no timers or manual project setup. Project and year progress remain visible in a slim desktop bar, while each focused session grows a richer terrarium. Built with GPT‑6 Astra as an ambitious design and engineering collaborator. One-time $19 license.

name: Croopt.com
tagline: CRO Audits of your website in seconds, increase sales.
description: Get instant AI-powered conversion rate optimization audits of your website. Identify what's blocking sales on your landing pages, checkout flows, and signup forms. Actionable recommendations in 60 seconds.

name: CourtCue · Pickleball Score
tagline: Private offline pickleball scorekeeper
description: Score singles or doubles pickleball with serving side, server number, rally history, undo, and redo kept together. CourtCue works entirely offline and exports match summaries or CSV only when you choose.

name: Compixor-Ai
tagline: Transform Your Files. Zero Server Uploads
description: Compixor AI is a 100% private, client-side toolkit developed by Haroon Ali. Compress PDFs, make NADRA passport photos, resize social media DPs, and generate QR codes instantly.

name: Commission Cycle
tagline: How to Start a 1 Person Digital Products Business in 2026
description: Explore the Commission Cycle Limited-Time Replay Library and watch all 4 Profit Engine Live sessions. The training covers the Commission Cycle Method, viral post templates, affiliate marketing strategies, and building a one-person digital products business with done-for-you tools. Access is time-limited, so check the official replay page before the replay window closes

name: Cogenius
tagline: Pitch decks & brand visuals that help startups close deals
description: CoGenius is a creative boutique agency based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, serving founders and businesses across the US and Europe. We craft investor-ready pitch decks, conversion-focused websites, company profiles, and brand visuals designed to help you win the room, not just look good in it. From first pitch to full brand identity, our team turns your story into visuals that move stakeholders to say yes. 100+ clients, dozens of countries, one focus: design that drives outcomes.

name: ClicData MCP
tagline: Chat with your company data inside Claude, ChatGPT and more
description: ClicData MCP Server: bring your BI data into any AI chat. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other MCP-compatible clients directly to ClicData. Ask any questions on live data, and pull dashboards without leaving the conversation. Phase one covers data & dashboard retrieval; next up: letting your AI client build dashboards and Data Flows on its own. No exports, no new pipelines, just your data, where you're already working!

name: ClearSayIt
tagline: Large Text, Ticker & Prompter
description: ClearSayIt turns your phone or tablet into a large text display for silent communication. Free, offline, no adverts. Show big text to anyone nearby in courtrooms, hospitals, churches, or anywhere speaking is not practical.

name: ClaimAppeal AI
tagline: Turn health insurance claim denials into clear appeals
description: ClaimAppeal AI helps people turn confusing health insurance claim denials into structured appeal letters. Enter your claim and denial details, and AI helps organize the information into a clear, personalized appeal draft that you can review and customize before submitting. Generate formal, legal-precedent and clinical-evidence backed insurance appeal letters in under 2 minutes. Overturn health insurance denials with ERISA § 503 and ACA § 2719 citations.

name: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace
tagline: From Chinese AI evidence to implementation with Astra
description: ChinaMarketing.AI GEO Workspace shows brands how they appear across Chinese AI discovery journeys, then turns evidence-backed gaps into implementation-ready action. GEO Actions uses GPT-6 Astra to create channel-specific assets from verified brand facts, check material claims against those facts, route them through human approval, and record the exact version implemented.

name: Chill :)

description: Upvoit simplifies field work with customizable field service software. Manage scheduling, dispatching, workflows, estimates and invoicing in one platform.

name: Unfiled
tagline: A Mac text workbench that understands what you paste
description: Unfiled is a native Mac text workbench for developers who constantly juggle scratch notes, logs, JSON, configs, tokens, stack traces, and temporary files. Tabs persist across restarts, and Unfiled recognizes what you open or paste, shows the right preview when useful, and brings the relevant actions to the document, from formatting and validation to structured views, compare, regex, logs, and more. All without turning into a full IDE.

name: Undine - Your mental health coach
tagline: Talk through stress, self confidence and emotions, privately
description: Undine is an AI mental health coach for iPhone and Android. Unlike a generic chatbot, it uses guided frameworks to help you work through stress, confidence, and relationship patterns, and remembers context across sessions instead of starting from zero each time. End-to-end encrypted. Free to try, no signup wall. Built as the low-stakes step before therapy, stop the emotional spiralling today. Users can delete their account instantly, directly in the app.

name: TruDrape
tagline: Your fit, everywhere you shop
description: TruDrape eliminates online sizing guesswork. Up to 40% of online clothes are returned due to bad fit. TruDrape uses your phone camera and a bank card to build a 3D body model and scan your favorite clothes to map your personal fit preferences. Our free browser extension reads size charts on any store to recommend your ideal size, completely privacy-first.

name: Trigram VCS
tagline: Start organized, stay organized; make vibe dev predictable.
description: Trigram VCS gives a new or existing codebase a durable project framework: canonical documentation, agent roles and operating rules, persistent project context, gated development phases, migration safeguards, and recovery-oriented tooling. Agents still do the coding; VCS provides structure it can return to instead of rediscovering the codebase every session. The goal is simple: start organized, stay organized, & make AI-assisted development more predictable without giving up control.

name: Torch Orchestrator
tagline: A visual Windows workspace for AI agents and terminals.
description: Torch turns AI agent terminals into a spatial Windows workspace. See live terminal output and managed-agent status, connect agents to notes, files, and shared context, and coordinate work from one canvas. Workspaces persist locally, so you can reopen the layout, connections, project files, task receipts, and bounded terminal scrollback later. This Preview release focuses on testing the core orchestration experience and learning from real workflows.

name: Tooiicy
tagline: Byinspired by artist Juicecuzz
description: Tooiicy: Born from the Culture. Driven by the Sound. Inspired by the global viral hit "I Hope The Worst," Tooiicy.com brings raw streaming energy into high-impact streetwear. We turn radio-ready anthems into bold apparel and essential gear designed for those who move to their own beat. Heavyweight quality, icy-clean aesthetics, and pure underground cred—wear the movement. Turn up the volume. Stay icy at Tooiicy.com.

name: TokenTrim
tagline: Trim your AI prompts. Same answer, 40% fewer tokens.
description: Free Chrome extension that compresses your prompt before it reaches ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. One click, see the diff, send. Runs locally, stores nothing.

name: TheGlobeScore
tagline: Explore the world through reviews and official data
description: Explore countries, regions and cities on an interactive map. Compare community reviews across 12 criteria, or switch to official indicators such as HDI and life expectancy. Share photos, reply to reviews and explore detailed local data for France. Free to use, in English, French and Spanish.

name: Tech Deck
tagline: Find business internships at top tech companies

name: Tazzo AI rececptionist
tagline: Turn Every Conversation Into a Sale.
description: 🚀 **Meet Taazo AI — Your AI Voice Sales Agent** Taazo AI helps businesses automate sales calls, follow-ups, lead qualification, and customer conversations with an AI voice agent. 📞 Make calls 🎯 Qualify leads 💬 Answer questions 🔄 Follow up automatically 📈 Turn more conversations into sales Let your AI agent handle conversations while your team focuses on closing deals. **Taazo AI — Turn Every Conversation Into a Sale.**

name: TattooPreview AI
tagline: From tattoo idea to stencil and placement preview
description: TattooPreview AI turns a written tattoo idea into a connected planning flow: generate a tattoo concept, turn it into stencil-style linework, and check approximate scale and placement on a synthetic canvas. Compare different directions before your appointment and bring a clearer visual reference to your tattoo artist. Built for tattoo planning and exploration—not as a replacement for professional tattoo design or judgment.

name: TabeMemo
tagline: Type "3 cookies." Your calorie budget drops. That's it.
description: TabeMemo is a calorie wallet. Type or speak something casual like "3 chocolate cookies" and Claude estimates the items and kcal, so the balance on your home-screen widget (remaining kcal today) drops instantly. No photos, no macro tracking, no scoring — just the fastest way to log a meal. Syncs across devices via iCloud. Built for people who quit calorie apps because logging felt like a chore. Free to use and ad-supported; a one-time purchase removes ads.

name: Subscription Tracker & Manager
tagline: Offline subscription manager and recurring expense tracker.
description: Clean and secure offline subscription tracker built to monitor recurring bills, streaming services, and membership renewals. Track payment cycles, get local reminders before bills are due, and manage your monthly budget locally on your device without linking bank accounts or creating online accounts.

name: SubRunGear
tagline: All your Fitness Gear in one AI Operating System
description: SubRunGear is a gear locker for runners, with the goal of being the Wellness operating system. Log your shoe rotation, gels, and race-day kit or any combination of gear kits. Train with our AI Coach too. Everyone has their own Locker page — one link for every "what shoes are those?". Built by a runner for the running, fitness, and wellness community.

name: Study AI
tagline: Help your child learn independently—with parents in the loop
description: Study AI is a free AI-powered tutor that helps students learn math, science, English, history and more. Get step-by-step guidance, take quizzes, and snap photos of homework for instant help. you make your account, connect your student, and send them personalized assingments talored to grow there weak subjects

name: Striv CRM
tagline: AI-native CRM

No credit card required.

name: StreamHub Live Multiplayer
tagline: Free, ad-free live streaming: fast, direct, and open.

Why Choose Us: Zero Ads: No pop-ups or video interruptions. Instant Access: No accounts required. Share the link and join in one tap. Low Latency: Smooth playback on any browser, mobile or desktop. Clean Experience: Minimalist, tracker-free interface focused on content. Stream live without limits, fees, or friction

name: StoryPress
tagline: AI turns your photos into narrated, print-ready books
description: StoryPress turns your camera roll into finished photo books — it picks your best shots, organizes them into chapters, writes the captions, and lays out every page. You get a complete draft in minutes, then edit anything: swap a photo, rewrite a caption, or ask the AI to redo a section. Making and editing your book is free — you only pay when you order a printed copy. Your photos stay yours: never sold, never used to train AI models.

name: Stone Skipper
tagline: skip stone for everywhere
description: Experience the ultimate serenity and delight of stone skipping in Stone Skipper! Pull back, adjust your aim, and watch your stones skip gracefully across crystal-clear waters, dodge obstacles, and surf through magical realms.

name: SpriteSheetMaker
tagline: AI pixel-art sprites and animation sheets for game developer
description: Create AI-powered 2D game sprites, animate characters, edit pixel art, and export transparent PNG and GIF assets for your game workflow.

name: Splity | Expense Tracker
tagline: Split expenses with friends, right inside Telegram
description: Splity is a Telegram Mini App for splitting shared expenses — trips, roommates, parties, any group cost. No separate app to install: it opens right inside a Telegram chat. What makes it different: it's built Telegram-native (same colors, same feel as the app you're already in), has a visual activity/history feed so everyone sees who paid what and when, and uses smart debt minimization so groups settle up with the fewest possible transfers.✨

name: SpendVeto
tagline: Spend governance for AI agents that pay for things
description: SpendVeto stops AI agents from overspending on x402 and MCP payments. Policy caps, human approvals, nested budgets, and a kill switch enforced before any payment settles. Open source, Apache-2.0, 280 assertions.

name: Soulo: Multi-Search Browser
tagline: One query. Search across platforms.
