The same question often belongs on several platforms: search engines find pages, video sites show demonstrations, communities surface lived experience, and AI search organizes another view. Re-copying a query between apps interrupts the work of finding an answer.

name: SolvencyBridge
tagline: Solvency II reporting software for insurance teams
description: Keep Excel. Add control to Solvency II reporting. SolvencyBridge helps insurance teams import data, trace its source, validate filings, manage review and approvals, and export supported XBRL artifacts. Scope a demo around your next reporting cycle.

name: Solos Music AI
tagline: Text-to-song AI with full stems, ready to remix
description: Create amazing music with AI. Generate songs, remix, extend, and more with Solos Music. Solos turns simple text prompts into production ready, studio quality tracks in seconds. Built for creators, producers, and artists, Solos allows users to generate complete arrangements, isolate multi track stems, and customize genres, moods, and lyrics directly in your browser. Export lossless audio instantly.

name: Social Walls by Taggbox
tagline: Create Interactive Experiences With Live Social Walls.
description: Social Walls by Taggbox is an all-in-one audience engagement platform that helps you collect, curate, and display live social media content from 15+ platforms. Bring hashtags, mentions, photos, videos, and QR code uploads together in one engaging feed for events, digital signage, retail spaces, and more. With real-time updates, moderation, customization, and GDPR-compliant data privacy, Social Walls makes it easy to create interactive experiences and showcase authentic social proof.

name: Snowballer
tagline: See the month you're debt-free — then get there faster
description: Snowballer turns your debts into one payoff plan and puts the debt-free date on the scoreboard. Add balances, pick snowball or avalanche, log payments, and watch the date move. Try what-if extras before you commit. Payoff math is free; bank sync is optional Plus.

name: SnapDo
tagline: Turn screenshots and photos into useful actions
description: SnapDo turns photos, screenshots, receipts and pasted text into editable actions on iPhone. Keep the workflow private and offline with practical templates, no account, and a one-time lifetime unlock.

name: Snalb
tagline: Real brand posts, curated into one gallery
description: You know that feeling when you have to scroll through five different brand profiles just to find one decent reference? Snalb fixes that. It's a curated collection of real social media posts from real brands — hand-picked and filterable by style and category, so you find inspiration in seconds instead of digging through endless feeds. I also built a side for designers: post your own work, get discovered by brands, and share it with the community.

name: SideYield
tagline: AI-assisted crypto analysis and signals in Telegram
description: SideYield brings AI-assisted coin analysis, multi-factor market signals, portfolio tracking, news, and learning tools into a Telegram-native experience. Instead of chasing hype or relying on one indicator, users can review structured market context, inspect data quality, and build a more disciplined research workflow in one place with a quant powered trading system. SideYield is built for clarity, not promises of profit. SideYield does not provide financial advice.

name: Shirts
tagline: Wear Your Batch. Represent Your Journey.
description: Custom Coaching Promotional Round Neck T-Shirts made for coaching institutes, batches, events, and student promotions. Add your institute logo, batch name, tagline, or custom design to create a unique identity. Comfortable, versatile, and ideal for bulk orders. Perfect for JEE, NEET, UPSC, CAT, SSC, foundation batches, orientations, seminars, and institute events.

name: Shipd's AI Team
tagline: Don’t prompt a model. Employ a team.
description: Five AI specialists, a PM, a design director, a designer, and two engineers, plan, design, and build your app in a visible pipeline you approve at every hand-off. One free run to taste, unlimited on every paid plan.

name: ShipStreak
tagline: Don't Break Your Streak.
description: ShipStreak v2: the daily shipping loop, tightened. Drop 1–3 bullets → tone polish (optional) → copy a post → paste to X, Threads, LinkedIn. ~30 seconds. We never auto-post. What's new / clearer this round: • Free 7-day streak, public calendar, no card • One grace day per streak. Pause up to 7 days on purpose • Failed streaks stay in the graveyard on your profile • Pro: up to 3 streaks, custom durations, tones, custom domain Built for indie builders who want a public habit, not a private journal.

name: SeedPix
tagline: Free AI photo editor — edit photos by typing
description: Most AI photo editors give you one model and a fixed set of filters. SeedPix pairs a text-based editor with 100+ one-click tools: type "remove the cup on the table" and it picks the best model for the job. Remove objects and people, replace backgrounds, erase AI filters, restore old photos, unblur shots, upscale to 4K — no layers, no masking, no subscription. Free to start: 5 credits on signup plus a free credit every day. No watermark, commercial use allowed.

name: ScreenRec
tagline: Free Screen Recorder for Windows, Mac & Linux. Free Forever
description: Turn lengthy messages into clear visual explanations with ScreenRec, a free screen recorder and screenshot tool for Windows, Mac, and Linux. Record your screen with audio, annotate screenshots, and use voice dictation to save time. Share private video messages for tutorials, customer support, and team updates without unnecessary meetings.

name: Screen Index
tagline: Find, Edit, Organize Screenshots on your Mac
description: Find and edit Mac screenshots by any clue you remember. Search from any app, file new captures quickly, and keep originals in real Finder folders.

name: Saeth
tagline: Your calendar upgraded for growth.
description: Saeth is a beautifully designed time tracker that works with the calendar you already use. Keep planning your days as usual while Saeth turns your calendar into insights about how you spend your time. Saeth is designed to be a lightweight addition to your workflow. Your calendar data stays on your device, while exports give you the freedom to take your data further. Saeth is a one-time purchase, so you don't have to think about another subscription.

name: STRONKR
tagline: Stop guessing your weights. Stronkr calculates them
description: Stronkr is a strength-training PWA with an RPE-driven progression engine. Rate each set 1-10 after you lift, and it calculates your next session's load automatically, target increase or deload, before you stall. Free routine generator (equipment, schedule, level), six adaptive programs (postpartum, 40+, comeback, joint-friendly), permanent exercise swaps, automatic PR detection, offline support. No app store install. Free core, forever.

name: SF Updates
tagline: Salesforce news and release notes in your browser toolbar
description: SF Updates puts the entire Salesforce release cycle one click away: daily curated ecosystem news from Salesforce Ben, UnofficialSF, SalesforceDevops.net and official channels, complete release notes filtered by your role (Admin, Developer, Flow) and cloud, and the key release dates. Available as a website with RSS and as a free Chrome extension. No sign-in, no data collection, free forever.

name: RoomAI
tagline: AI room design that keeps your walls exactly where they are
description: RoomAI turns one room photo into multiple realistic redesigns without moving the walls. Upload a photo of any room — living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or exterior — and get AI restyles from 300+ styles and 20+ room-type presets, while walls, windows, doors, ceiling height and camera angle stay exactly as photographed. Compare style directions side-by-side from one photo, use it for virtual staging (~$0.30/image vs $1,500–3,000 for physical staging), or declutter a room before listing it.

name: ReplyTime
tagline: Know your response time before your client does
description: ReplyTime sits on top of the automations you already run in Zapier, Make, or n8n and tracks how fast you actually reply to clients — no new inbox, no migration. It starts a countdown the moment a message arrives, alerts you before you breach an SLA, and hands your clients a report that proves your speed.

name: ReplyLingo
tagline: The WhatsApp voice message translator that replies for you.
description: ReplyLingo translates voice messages with AI in seconds. Get a WhatsApp voice note in a language you don't speak, share it into ReplyLingo, and it transcribes, translates, and reads it back to you — then translates your spoken reply back to them. 100+ languages, private by design, free to start.

name: Renderly
tagline: Render thousands of personalized videos from one API
description: Renderly turns one template into infinite videos. Design a video once, mark the parts that should change, then pass your data in one API call. Thousands of personalized videos render in parallel - 1080p or 4K, any aspect ratio - from $0.10/min, 2x to 8x cheaper than other video APIs.

name: ReddigInsight
tagline: AI subreddit research and sentiment reports
description: Analyze Reddit communities with AI to uncover sentiment, trending topics, keywords, and actionable insights. Turn subreddit discussions into clear reports in minutes. Describe your question in AI Chat, get suggested subreddit search parameters, and generate a report with sentiment, themes, keywords, representative quotes, PMF and influence indicators, and action recommendations. Start with 1 free report credit. Paid plans analyze up to 300 posts per report and export results to HTML.

name: Recovely
tagline: Track and recover money your business is owed
description: Businesses lose money they’re owed through supplier refunds, vendor credits, shipping claims, rebates, duplicate payments, and other recoveries. Recovely gives teams one place to record what they’re owed, attach evidence, track follow-ups, monitor outstanding recoveries, and verify when the money actually comes back.

name: ReadControl
tagline: The native macOS reading manager
description: Save any webpage to your computer, read anytime. No account needed. It’s totally free and open-source!

name: Raido — see your own patterns
tagline: When images speak, patterns reveal themselves.
description: Raido isn't a tarot deck or a generic AI chatbot. Built on 60 original archetypes developed over 15 years of hypnotherapy practice, Raido helps you explore the images and associations that emerge in your session, then tracks recurring images to surface patterns you'd miss alone. Each session ends with a resonance sound built on ANS technology, an audio anchor no one else has. Associative cards have been standard in consulting rooms since 1985. Raido brings this method into the present with AI.

name: RSE check
tagline: The easiest way to generate compliance dossiers.
description: RSE Check stands out by offering a completely friction-free, zero-code compliance workflow. While existing solutions are bloated, expensive, and require lengthy onboarding, our tool lets professionals generate mandatory compliance dossiers instantly via a clean, streamlined form—at zero cost and with total privacy

name: QualiFlow AI

description: QualiFlow AI turns website visitors into qualified leads. It answers questions using the business's own website content, helps visitors understand their options, captures contact details, qualifies and scores leads, and gives the team a live CRM with conversation history. With Google Calendar connected, visitors can also check availability and book appointments.

name: Qlynic

description: Qlynic is an AI-native EMR and clinic command center built by Arxeon in Calgary. Connect clinical records, AI booking over web and SMS, multi-branch scheduling, intake, patient communication, telehealth and payments around one patient record. Native Alberta AHCIP billing runs through Arxeon, an Alberta Health-accredited direct H-Link submitter. An optional AI Scribe drafts documentation and Alberta code suggestions for clinician review. From booking to encounter to claim, in one workspace.

name: Professional Wikipedia Page Creator
tagline: From Draft to Live. We Handle Everything.
description: Hire expert Wikipedia writers to write and publish your articles. We guarantee approval as we're the UK's top-rated Wiki profile creation agency.

name: Product Launch Checklist
tagline: Every launch step, why it matters and when to skip it
description: A free, step by step launch checklist for indie makers shipping software. Pick your launch type (SaaS, mobile app, AI tool, extension, open source) and get only the items that apply, each with the reason and a skip note. No account, no ads.

name: PricePup
tagline: Compare Australian grocery prices in one place
description: Compare grocery prices across Woolworths, Coles and ALDI. Search products, compare available retailer offers and save shopping lists to plan your next grocery shop. PricePup is built for Australian shoppers.

name: PointsFly Reward Points Calculator
tagline: See the real rupee value of your credit card points
description: Most people redeem credit card points without knowing if they're getting good value. This free calculator shows the real rupee-per-point value of any redemption, flights or hotels, across major Indian banks and their transfer partners, before you commit. Enter your bank, card, and redemption details to instantly see if it's a high, fair, or low-value redemption (under Rs.1/point is poor, Rs.1-3 is good, Rs.3+ is excellent). No signup needed.

name: PitNexus
tagline: AI race engineer, live strategy & MoTeC-grade telemetry
description: PitNexus is a Windows companion for sim racers ( Le Mans Ultimate only for the moment). Five modules: PitEngineer, an AI race engineer that talks to you live; PitAssistant for fuel and energy strategy; PitTrace for MoTeC-grade telemetry, track map and corner deltas; PitTeam to run an online team with leaderboards and anti-cheat; and PitPlanner to create a schedule of training. Core is free, Pro modules are a subscription. Built solo by a sim racer tired of guessing before every session.

name: Pingtastic
tagline: Heartbeat + uptime monitoring for devs and agencies
description: Pingtastic watches for two kinds of failure most monitoring tools only catch one of: cron jobs and background tasks that fail silently (add one curl call, get paged if a check-in goes missing), and sites or APIs that quietly go down or whose SSL cert is about to expire (we poll on a schedule, nothing to install). Alerts land in Slack, Discord, or your own webhook! Run it solo on your own projects from $5/mo, or go white-label and resell it to clients under your own brand and domain.

name: PinPoint
tagline: Visual Bug Tracking & Feedback Suite for Web Agencies
description: PinPoint is a visual bug tracking & feedback suite for web agencies and developers. 📌 Key Features: • Live Website Canvas: Click anywhere on live sites to drop visual comments with precision. • Desktop & Mobile Viewports: Toggle between 1920px & 420px views. • 1-Click Client Links: Clients review without registration or login. • Developer Panel: Track and resolve visual tasks in real-time. • AI Bug Summarizer: Auto-generate executive reports. 🚀 Special PH Deal: Grab the $49 Lifetime Pass today!

name: PikaEdit
tagline: 30+ free online tools. No uploads, no signup, no limits
description: PikaEdit is a free, privacy-focused online tool platform. Your files never leave your device — all processing happens in your browser. - PDF Tools: Merge, split, compress, edit, Word/Excel/PPT to PDF - Image Tools: Compress, resize, convert, crop, AI background removal - Developer Tools: JSON editor, QR code, Mermaid diagrams, Hash, Regex - Text Tools: Word counter, case converter, diff checker - CV Builder with ATS scoring - Encrypted note sharing (zero-knowledge, AES-256)

name: PhotoGenerAI
tagline: Create and edit AI photos, free to try without sign-up
description: Create images from text or edit your own photos in the browser. Change backgrounds, refine lighting, make product photos, or combine reference images. Start without an account with 10 free credits every 24 hours for GPT Image 2 Low. Pro settings use purchased credits.

name: Personalized Songs Gift - The Songai
tagline: Personalized Song Gifts for Every Occasion | The Songai
description: Turn a memory, a milestone, or a feeling into a fully-produced song — vocals, artwork, and a shareable gift page, in seconds.

name: Pedal Book - Guitar Pedal Settings Saver
tagline: Save your guitar pedal settings before they're gone forever.
description: For decades guitarists have been using masking tape on their pedals and marking knob configurations with a sharpie. That changes now. Pedal Book allows musicians to save their favourite guitar pedal settings, replacing outdated, barbaric practices. Users can add what guitar, amp, and other gear that was used to achieve the sound they want to save. When they want to recreate that sound (i.e. for a gig, album, song, etc...), they open the app and match their pedals to the settings they've saved.

name: Pasiv
tagline: Your idle gaming PC earns crypto while you sleep
description: Pasiv turns an idle graphics card — or a spare CPU — into crypto. One button, no account. The pool pays your wallet directly (non-custodial), Auto mode picks whichever coin pays most, and the only fee is 4% on Monero. macOS, Windows and Linux.

name: Pascal by Pinnacle AI
tagline: Meet Pascal, the only AI coach that lives where work happens
description: Pascal by Pinnacle is an AI-powered leadership coaching platform that embeds coaching directly into the workflow. Unlike most "AI coaches" that sit behind a chat interface waiting for you to type a question, Pascal joins your actual meetings on Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet. It builds an understanding of your team's dynamics and working patterns over time, and delivers personalized coaching exactly when you need it; before a difficult conversation, during a meeting, or after a critical decision.

name: PaisaProof
tagline: Stops impulse UPI & card spends before they happen
description: PaisaProof catches impulse spends the moment they happen — UPI or card — and shows what that money becomes if invested instead. No bank login, no manual entry, runs fully on-device. Earn rewards for the spends you actually skip.

name: Paisa Tracker-Automatic Expense Manager
tagline: It tracks itself, so you can live yours
description: Paisa Tracker turns your bank's transaction SMS into clear spending insights, budgets, and reports — automatically. Private by design: only bank transaction alerts are read; personal messages, OTPs, and promotions are ignored. Free on Google Play.

name: Page Rage
tagline: Turn any web page into a destructible playground
description: Page Rage is a game that allows people to reclaim the joy of the internet through visceral destruction of any page. Page Rage embraces the unique form and variety of the web to create a near unlimited amount of physics sandboxes for people to be creative with. The goal of the project is to allow people to be able to obtain moments of catharsis and levity into their usage of the web

name: Overlook Live Wallpapers

Key features include: 33 free animated wallpaper scenes Search integration using your existing Chrome default provider Customizable quick links and shortcuts Optional clock, date, and mouse movement effects Adjustable frame rate, sizing, and legibility controls

name: OptaLead

We’re offering the complete project and source code for acquisition, giving SaaS, AI, CRM, and sales-tech companies the opportunity to acquire, rebrand, integrate, and commercialize the technology.

name: Omni Line

It unifies every major package registry—npm, PyPI, Docker, Go, Cargo, Maven, and more—into one platform. By bringing all your dependencies into one UI and API, Omni Line gives you complete visibility to catch risks early and protect your supply chain for both human developers and AI agents.

name: OffgridStem
tagline: Split any song into 6 stems — fully on-device, no cloud
description: 🎹 Stems expanded from 4 to 6 — added Piano and Guitar isolation. Isolate individual instrument parts for practice, transcription, or sampling, not just vocal removal. 🎨 New reactive waveform visualizer for exports — multiple styles (Bars, Mirror, Wave, Dots, Neon) and color themes. A shift from vocal remover to a full music deconstruction tool for musicians and producers. Fully on-device, zero cloud uploads, verified by an independent network audit.

name: Neiliro — your family's home base
tagline: Tasks, calendar, money and mail — encrypted in your browser
description: Every family app is a calendar with chores bolted on, and every one of them can read what you write. Neiliro is the whole household in one place: tasks, calendar, money with budgets, notes, shared lists, and a real mailbox (yourfamily@mail.neiliro.com) where a letter becomes a task in one click. What your family writes is encrypted in the browser with a key we don't have. One price per family, not per seat. Export everything in one click, or run the exact same app on your own server for free.

name: Natyv
tagline: Native desktop apps with no bundled browser engine
description: Natyv is a native desktop app runtime with no bundled browser engine. Your app logic runs as a WebAssembly module via Extism inside a native host, no Chromium, no DOM, no JS runtime required. Benchmarked against Electron building the same real app: 27MB disk and 58MB idle RAM for Natyv vs 244MB and 331MB for Electron. WASM's linear memory only grows, so Natyv's host also recycles guest instances automatically to keep long-running apps lean. v0.1.0 and early. Go SDK live on pkg.go.dev.

name: MyFridge AI
tagline: Food always good bad in my fridge, I built an app to fix it
description: I’m so lazy, and I can’t be bothered to input things manually, along with that, I can’t remember on Friday what is going bad in my fridge when I went shopping on Monday. So I built an app to fix all of that. MyFridge AI tracks your groceries, predicts expiry dates, reminds you before food spoils, and turns what you have into recipes. Download free on the App Store.

name: My Cleaning Company
tagline: SaaS Software for cleaning companies to see the real picture
description: There is team management apps / software out there but none specific for an actual cleaning company. This is tailored directly to that market. Allowing properties / employees / reporting / navigation tracking etc all in one tidy package.

name: Muxlyve
